Using his faulty Animate Dead spell, he manages to resurrect the long-dead dinosaur skeleton, but is unable to control her. Having fully expected the player to stop him from resurrecting her,…

getting_there.heading: Travel
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring code CIP will teleport players west of the mine on Miscellania. The code only works on completion of The Fremennik Trials, otherwise the rings treat the code as unrecognised and teleport you just a few spaces from the main ring.
• There is a boat run by the Sailor on the second westernmost dock in Rellekka which can be used to travel to Miscellania. The enchanted lyre teleports in Rellekka, a short distance from the boat to Miscellania.
• The ring of Wealth or higher tier luck rings can be used to teleport next to Advisor Ghrim, which is useful for those who do Miscellania Management, but requires completion of Throne of Miscellania.
• A Miscellania Teleport scroll can be used to teleport to the square of Miscellania. They can be bought from the Grand Exchange or obtained from clue scrolls. These scrolls can only be used upon completion of The Fremennik Trials.

(Managing) Miscellania mine.summary: Rockertunities do not spawn and geodes cannot be obtained here.

Abandoned Mine.title: Abandoned Mine

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
Map:Abandoned Mine surface 
The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.

getting_there.heading: Accessing the crystal mine
getting_there.text:
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
• Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.

Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.

To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.

To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).

To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K…

Abandoned Mine.summary: The mine has six levels. It has many ore veins, which yield mithril, coal, luminite, drakolith, and phasmatite in addition to the crystal mine. In the quest, you cut a piece of crystal to make a salve amulet, and you can do so again any time after the quest.

Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede.title: Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to desert strykewyrms with a Mask of the Yellow Wyrm/Helm of the Parched Wyrm, then run east to the Citharede.
• From Al Kharid lodestone, head out of the east exit of the city, and run east till you reach the Citharede.
• Teleport to Archaeology Guild using Archaeology journal or to Kharid-et Dig Site via Dig sites map, run east.

Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede.summary: It is the location where St. Elspeth's remains were found. The Ripper's remains are also found here, though the abbey's inhabitants are seemingly unaware of it. Unlike Elspeth, The Ripper survived and is lingering beneath the abbey, having corrupted several miners and turned them into a pack of ripper demons.

Abyss.title: Abyss

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
To enter the Abyss, the player needs to complete the Enter the Abyss miniquest. Once players have completed the miniquest, they can use the 'Teleport' option on the Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville in level 4 to 6 Wilderness to enter the Abyss.

Strategy

For convenience, players can make the Mage of Zamorak teleport them straight away with a left-click by going through his 'Configure' option; this only has to be done once. Completing the Wilderness achievements increases the rate of gathering magical thread by 5% (easy), 10% (medium), 15% (hard), or 33% (elite).

Other notes

Inside the Abyss, the player is no longer in the Wilderness and cannot be attacked by other players. However, if a player attacks immediately before a player enters the Abyss, the attack can hit after the player has been teleported inside due to lag. If the player is teleblocked by another player before entering, using the 'Teleport' option on the Zamorak Mage will not work.

getting_there.heading: Using the Abyss as a method of transportation
getting_there.text:
Altars are located throughout the world, often near points of interest. If no other teleports are available, the abyss is useful as an alternate method of teleportation. Some useful locations include:
• Air altar - Cooks' Guild, west of Varrock
• Astral altar - Lunar Isle, switching spellbooks on the altar
• Blood altar - Master clue skill riddle, mutated bloodvelds for slayer, 
• Body altar - Barbarian Village
• Cosmic altar - Elite clue Zanaris scan spots, mutated zygomites for slayer
• Death altar - Master clue skill riddle, end of the Temple of Light from the quest Mourning's End Part II, re-entering the Underground Pass to get Iban's staff 
• Earth altar - East of Varrock elite clue spots
• Fire altar - Mage Training Arena, Het's Oasis, Al Kharid
• Law altar - Entrana
• Mind altar - Goblin Village, Black Knight's Fortress elite clue spot
• Nature altar - Gleaming wisps, Karamja, Shilo Village, hard and elite clue spots
• Soul altar - Far west of Menaphos Imperial district for City Quests and elite clue scan spots, fairy ring
• Time altar - Access to venomous, feral, and brutish dinosaurs for slayer
• Water altar - Lumbridge Swamp, Zanaris

To use a teleport, enter the Abyss,…

Abyss.summary: The area consists of two rings; a dangerous outer ring in a multiway combat zone with abyssal monsters, and a safe inner ring with rifts leading to the Runecrafting altars. In appearance, it seems to be oddly organic, with eyes, boils, and strange-looking tendrils, possibly being the organic detritus considered to be mistakes and cast into the Abyss by the Elder Gods.

Abyssal Area.title: Abyssal Area
Abyssal Area.summary: The abyssal area contains abyssal leeches, abyssal guardians, abyssal walkers, and abyssal demons. Here, only the abyssal demons are not aggressive. The other abyssal monsters follow the normal rules of aggressiveness and will attack all players regardless of their combat level. Walkers, guardians, and leeches spawn extremely fast, while abyssal demons take longer to respawn.

Air altar.title: Air altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• An air talisman
• An elemental talisman
• An omni-talisman
• An air tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• An air talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break an air altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use a skills necklace to teleport to the Cooking Guild, then go south-west to the altar.
• The skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village, then go east across the bridge to the altar.

Al Kharid.summary: In the past, Al Kharid was ruled by the Emir Shah, although the vast majority of the work had been taken over by Chancellor Hassan since the Emir's son was kidnapped in Stolen Hearts. After his rescue, the prince Ali Mirza became the current Emir of Al Kharid. The city is independent from both Misthalin, or any government in the Kharidian desert. Al Kharid was built in the early Fifth Age, by settlers from outside the desert. The dominant religion of Al Kharid is the Menaphite Pantheon with…

A ranger stationed near the bridge warns that several travellers who headed east recently never returned. The trading caravans to Wendlewick have also not arrived for some time, as noted by Candle-maker Zeeva in Wendlewick who is originally from Amberfell.

Amberfell can be accessed after repairing the bridge south of Hollow Hill during the Secrets of Amberfell quest. After the village is visited for the first time, it can also be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP. Further, after repairing the canoe station with 6 maple planks and 20 steel nails, it can be accessed from any other station. [Chat: 4 Amberfell]

getting_there.heading: Location and getting there
getting_there.text:
The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)

Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
• A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
• A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
• A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome…

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Ancient Prison is located in the dungeon, by going through the Frozen Door and big door.

Travel methods include:
• Any travelling methods getting to the dungeon
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing Nex at least once
• Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires killing Nex at least once and access to the guild

Ancient Prison.summary: The boss room is locked behind two doors, an area behind the Frozen Door, another area behind the big door. Achieved Gielinor's Most Expensive Doorstop, the players can freely travel to Ancient Prison.

Andrew.title: Andrew
Andrew.summary: Andrew and the other Gower brothers have a small cameo in the Back to the Freezer quest.

Ape Atoll.title: Ape Atoll
Ape Atoll.teleport:
• Ape Atoll Teleport
• Fairy ring CLR

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are four ways of getting to Ape Atoll:
• Travelling via Daero at the floor 2 of the Grand Tree (east next to Blurberry), then talking to Waydar who will take you to Crash Island, and then sailing to Ape Atoll by talking to Lumdo.
• The teleportation spell Ape Atoll Teleport, requiring level 64 Magic (after completing the King Awowogei part of Recipe for Disaster).
• Teleporting to the Agility course using the fairy ring code CLR (after completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift). A small ninja monkey greegree is required to get through the log shortcut to the agility course and the rest of the island.
• Superior locator Special log teleport (1/8 chance, requires visiting Ape Atoll once, during Monkey Madness)
• Using a spirit tree to teleport to an evil tree on the south part of the island, which is not recommended due to its unreliability.

Ape Atoll.summary:
The patrolling prison guards can be blocked by other players standing in their path, in order to help players escape the prison.
Clear

Ape Atoll Dungeon.title: Ape Atoll Dungeon
Ape Atoll Dungeon.summary: It is advised to have level 43 Prayer when exploring this dungeon, in order to pray Protect from Melee from the monsters inside.

Apprentice Clerval.title: Apprentice Clerval
Apprentice Clerval.summary: During a period of distraction, he had the idea to build a rune guardian from scratch, hoping it would earn him a bit of respect. However, he wasn't able to approach any of the wizards who had rebuilt the guardians, so he asked a passing adventurer to ask on his behalf. They gained the knowledge and the tools necessary to construct the golem while he unsuccessfully tried to prepare the workshop. The adventurer sorted out the problematic while he tried to carve out a body for the golem, again…

Arandar.title: Arandar
Arandar.summary: In addition to the Underground Pass, the Temple of Light is also located beneath the mountain range. The gnome city of Arposandra is also thought to be located somewhere in the mountains, but cannot be accessed by players outside of a small segment during The Prisoner of Glouphrie.

Araxyte Hive.title: Araxyte Hive
Araxyte Hive.summary: Once inside the lair, it is required to cross a small river of acid. To start a fight with Araxxor, players must attempt to open a "webbed entrance" at the end of the path, and are given the options on whether or not to create an instance or enter the non-instanced version of the fight.

Arboretum (location).title: Arboretum (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: • After completion of the Branches of Darkmeyer quest, via the Drakan's medallion.

Arboretum (location).summary: During The Branches of Darkmeyer, the Arboretum is guarded by Lord Drakan's brother, Ranis Drakan, who eventually discovers the player's identity and traps them inside this building.

Archaeology Campus.title: Archaeology Campus
Archaeology Campus.teleport:
• Archaeology teleport
• Archaeology journal
• Dig Site pendant
• Master archaeologist's outfit
• Senntisten Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Walking to the east from Varrock lodestone.
• Using Ancient Magicks player can teleport to the entrance of the Senntisten Temple.
• Dig Site pendant can teleport player to various locations around the Campus.
• Archaeology teleport and Master archaeologist's outfit can both teleport the user to Campus.
• Archaeology journal teleports the user directly to the Archaeology Guild.

Archaeology Campus.summary: Central to the Archaeology skill, it hosts Varrock Dig Site in the north, Archaeology Guild in the west, and Exam Centre in the south.

getting_there.text:

Arctic Pine.summary: Arctic pines are trees that can be found growing on the Fremennik isle of Neitiznot. They can be cut down using the Woodcutting skill, giving arctic pine logs and 145 Woodcutting experience, requiring level 54 Woodcutting. Arctic pine logs can be split, yielding an extra 42.5 Woodcutting experience per log. There are several pines north of the south-western-most bridge in Neitiznot, with a woodcutting stump for splitting the logs, and a pile of logs to deposit the split logs.

Ardougne.title: Ardougne

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
East Ardougne
• The Ardougne lodestone is located just north of the city, directly southwest of Manor Farm.
• The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the player to the centre of Ardougne market, requiring completion of the Plague City quest.
• The Ardougne cloak 1 can be used to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, just south of the city.
• Once per day, the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm, just north of the city.
• The Ardougne cloak 4 provides unlimited teleports to Manor Farm.
• A spirit tree is located on the Battlefield south of West Ardougne, requiring completion of the Tree Gnome Village quest.
• A lever in the Deserted Keep in level 51 Wilderness teleports the player to the Ardougne lever, near the gates to West Ardougne, and vice versa. The lever can be accessed by teleporting to the Keep from Edgeville, although doing so will momentarily put the player in deep wilderness.
• There is a ship that will take the player to Ardougne from Brimhaven for the low price of 30 coins. The ship takes you to the south eastern docks near Captain Barnaby. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a)…

Ardougne Castle.title: Ardougne Castle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the Ardougne lodestone and running south-west.
• Using the Ardougne Teleport to teleport to the Ardougne market and running west.
• Using the Kandarin monastery teleport and running north.
• Using the Spirit tree located in the Battlefield of Khazard area and running north-east.

Ardougne Castle.summary: Ardougne Castle is a castle in East Ardougne near the border to West Ardougne. King Lathas was king of Kandarin until the Plague's End. After the quest transpires he is replaced by his cousin, King Thoros, who resides on the floorno | 2 . Players can start the quest Underground Pass here. Aside from the king, many Paladins wander the area around it.

Ardougne Monastery.title: Ardougne Monastery
Ardougne Monastery.teleport:
• Ardougne cloak 1/2/3/4
• Kandarin monastery teleport
• Completionist cape

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Kandarin monastery teleport allows for unlimited free teleports directly to it after completion of the easy Ardougne achievements.
• Teleport to the Khazard Battlefield with a Spirit tree and run east past the clocktower.
• Take a charter ship to Port Khazard, run northwest.

Ardougne Monastery.summary: The Ardougne Monastery in the kingdom of Kandarin is a building, located south of Ardougne Zoo and north of the Fight Arena. It is made up of two two-storeyed towers (east and west) joined by a single-storey WP | foyer . It is dedicated to the god Saradomin and named after the tower to the north-west.

Ardougne Sewers.title: Ardougne Sewers
Ardougne Sewers.summary: The sewers are not as widely used or known as the Varrock Sewers, but quests require the player to visit some parts of the sewers.

Ardougne Zoo.title: Ardougne Zoo
Ardougne Zoo.teleport:
• Ardougne Teleport
• Ardougne lodestone
• Ardougne cloak 1

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players who have completed the easy Ardougne achievements can use the Ardougne cloak 1 to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north
• Players with access to the Fairy ring network can use the code DJP to teleport near the Tower of Life and run north-west
• Players with access to Spirit trees can teleport to the Khazard Battlefield and run east
• Ardougne teleport and run south-west from the city centre
• Charter a ship to Ardougne (run south-west) or Port Khazard and run (north-west)
• Ardougne lodestone and run south

Ardougne Zoo.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (11 September 2017) | date=11 September 2017 
• A floor tile near the zoo in Ardougne has been fixed.

Ardougne castle.title: Ardougne Castle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the Ardougne lodestone and running south-west.
• Using the Ardougne Teleport to teleport to the Ardougne market and running west.
• Using the Kandarin monastery teleport and running north.
• Using the Spirit tree located in the Battlefield of Khazard area and running north-east.

Ardougne castle.summary: Ardougne Castle is a castle in East Ardougne near the border to West Ardougne. King Lathas was king of Kandarin until the Plague's End. After the quest transpires he is replaced by his cousin, King Thoros, who resides on the floorno | 2 . Players can start the quest Underground Pass here. Aside from the king, many Paladins wander the area around it.

Ardougne lodestone.title: Ardougne lodestone
Ardougne lodestone.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (29 May 2018) | date=29 May 2018 
• An oak tree next to the Ardougne lodestone once again has its canopy attached to the tree trunk.

Ardougne market.title: Ardougne market

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the caster into the centre of the Ardougne Market.
• Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and proceed south

Ardougne market.summary: If a stall is stolen from, and players attempt to talk to or trade with the owner, they will call for a guard to come and attack the players. This may be a guard, knight, paladin, or hero, depending on which gets to players first. To avoid this, players can keep a vial of stench (a), which allows players to talk to or trade with shopkeepers instantly after stealing from their stalls.

Ardougne north bank.title: Ardougne north bank
Ardougne north bank.summary: There is a deposit box in the bank. It is a convenient place to access the bank before the bank chest in Manor Farm is unlocked.

Ariane.title: Ariane

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
Ariane can be found in many places throughout RuneScape.

Fixed

Places that the player can find Ariane at any time include:
• In the Champions' Guild with Xenia, Ozan, and Sir Owen (before Heroes' Quest).
• On the balcony of the Heroes' Guild with Xenia, Ozan, Sir Owen, and Linza (before Legends' Quest).
• On the floor 2 of the Legends' Guild with the rest of the Signature Heroes.
• In the Burthorpe Troll Cave fighting Troll Brute.

Roaming

Ariane will often teleport in and out of various locations. Places she has been seen roaming include:
• At the east entrance to the Grand Exchange.
• On Ice Mountain.
• Near the bank on Lunar Isle.
• Near some ruins south of Draynor Village.
• Near the crossroads just north of Falador.
• In Oldak's laboratory in Dorgesh-Kaan.
• In the Runecrafting Guild.
• In the Wizards' Tower.
• At the four magic trees at Sorcerer's Tower.
• In the ruins of Uzer.
• On the top floor of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille.
• Speaking to Aris in her tent.
• In the Jaldraocht Pyramid where the player switches between normal spellbook and Ancient Magicks.

One-time

Some places Ariane will appear only once, or until the player speaks to her for the first time. These…

Ariane.summary: She seems to have a split personality, as during the Fremennik Sagas Three's Company, she literally spoke to herself, then responded. This may have been simply humour, or an actual trait. Wizard Ellaron suggests she also has social issues.

Arianwyn.title: Arianwyn
Arianwyn.summary: Arianwyn plays large roles in the quests Mourning's End Part I, Mourning's End Part II, Within the Light, Plague's End, and The Light Within. After being initially but briefly met at the end of the Regicide quest, he may be found on the floor 1 of the large house in the east of Lletya. After the events of Plague's End, he may be found within the Cadarn district of Prifddinas, near the Cadarn herald, in addition to Lletya.

Aris.title: Aris
Aris.summary: She is involved in Recipe for Disaster and Dimension of Disaster, and has great knowledge about the history of Gielinor. She also has vast magical powers; for example, she casts a Tempus Cessit spell in the beginning of Recipe for Disaster to stop time. She serves as a member of the Secret Council of Gielinor, but arrives late to the latest meeting.

Armadyl's Eyrie.title: Armadyl's Eyrie
Armadyl's Eyrie.teleport:
• Boss portal attuned to Kree'arra
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Armadyl's Eyrie is located in the south-western section of the dungeon, which can be accessed by the shortcut leading to the encampment.

Travel methods include:
• Any travelling methods getting to the dungeon
• Boss portal at War's retreat - Requires killing Kree'arra at least once
• Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires Max cape and killing Kree'arra at least once

Armadyl's Eyrie.summary: Armadyl's Eyrie is the encampment of Armadyl in the south-west of God Wars Dungeon. It requires 70 Ranged to enter.

Artisans' Workshop.title: Artisans' Workshop

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Three times a day, players can use the modified blacksmith's helmet to teleport directly to the Artisans' Workshop.
• Teleport to the Mining Guild using the skills necklace, then go east.
• Teleport to the Mining Guild resource dungeon using the dungeoneering cape, climb up any of the 4 ladders, and go east.
• Teleport to the Falador Mole Lair using a boss portal attuned to the giant mole in War's Retreat, then go south-east.
• Teleport to Falador using the Lodestone Network or by casting Falador Teleport, then go south-east.
• Teleport to the southern Falador gate using a 'Chipped' Falador teleport created with Evil Dave's Spellbook, then go north-east to the workshop.
• Teleport to the Falador farm using the Explorer's ring 3 or 4 cabbage-port or South Falador Teleport, then go north-west into Falador, then east to the workshop.

Artisans' Workshop.summary: The workshop is divided into two rooms. The western part of the building is a general purpose smithing area. It contains forges and furnaces. Egil and his rewards shop can also be found here.

Asgarnia Ice Dungeon.title: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim Jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.

For faster transportation, players can use:
• A Dungeoneering cape (0,8) to instantly teleport right into the dungeon, just outside the resource dungeon's entrance.
• Fairy ring code AIQ , which goes to Mudskipper Point.
• A Home Teleport, to teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, which is located in the central Port Sarim.
• House Teleport, if the player has a player-owned house (members only) located in Rimmington.
• An Explorer's ring, which can teleport to the cabbage field north of Port Sarim.
• An amulet of glory, which can teleport to Draynor Village, the village east of Port Sarim.
• A skills necklace, which can teleport to the Crafting Guild north-west of Port Sarim.
• The Captain's log, which can teleport to the player-owned port portal. Then, just run south.

Asgarnia Ice Dungeon.summary:
For faster transportation, players can use:
• A Dungeoneering cape (0,8) to instantly teleport right into the dungeon, just outside the resource dungeon's entrance.
• Fairy ring code AIQ , which goes to Mudskipper Point.
• A Home Teleport, to teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, which is located in the central Port Sarim.
• House Teleport, if the player has a player-owned house (members only) located in Rimmington.
• An Explorer's ring, which can teleport to the cabbage field north of Port…

Asgarnia Smith.title: Asgarnia Smith
Asgarnia Smith.summary: Smith was originally from a humbler background, as he recounts fishing for bass in Catherby. His discovery of an ancient casket, which contained a meager amount of coins, struck an epiphany within him and he applied to be a field agent to the Varrock Museum. In this capacity, he has earned great wealth through corrupt means by withholding some of the valuable artefacts he discovered, but continues his job out of genuine thrill and satisfaction.

Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.title: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim Jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.

For faster transportation, players can use:

• The Captain's log, which can teleport to the player-owned port portal. Then, just run south.

Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon.title: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon
Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon.summary: The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon is a members-only resource dungeon located inside the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. It is located in an offshoot area of the dungeon just before the area with ice warriors. Level 85 Dungeoneering is required to enter, and doing so for the first time awards 15,000 Dungeoneering experience.

Ashdale Caves.title: Ashdale Caves
Ashdale Caves.summary: The cave is accessed during the quest via a hidden entrance in a house built by an architect of the Fourth Age known as Ogden Plainview, who discovered the caves. The entrance is opened by investigating a bust of his head, revealing a centrepiece on the floor to actually be stairs. Players may use a games necklace to get here quickly once the quest has been completed.

Aster.title: Aster
Aster.summary: Players can talk to Aster to change their royal title to either Duke, Duchess, or Dux. They'll also teach the player the concept of rested XP and the importance of proper sleep.

Astram Farm.title: Astram Farm
Astram Farm.summary: A tree patch is found in the southern part of the farm, which will be tended to by Alain if he receives the correct payment. A potato patch is found to the north of it, which is tended to for free by Head Farmer Jones. This is the only potato patch in the game, and can be useful for low-level farming, as Jones hands out free potato seeds. Jones also owns a Farming Shop, which sells a number of low level seeds and basic farming supplies such as compost and plant pots.

Aubury's Rune Shop.title: Aubury's Rune Shop
Aubury's Rune Shop.summary: Despite the shop's small size, it is often quite crowded, especially on non-members worlds. This is due to the fact that apart from being a popular rune shop, it is the only convenient way for non-members to teleport to the Rune Essence mine except with Archmage Sedridor in Wizards' Tower, which is far from Draynor bank.

Auguste.title: Auguste
Auguste.summary: Auguste has the honour of being the inventor of the first hot air balloon and convinces players to help him in this quest to fly around Gielinor in the quest Enlightened Journey. Once the quest is completed, players who have sufficient Firemaking levels can make use of the balloon transport system to travel to various locations.

Austri.title: Austri
Austri.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Latest RuneScape News (28 May 2002) | date=28 May 2002 
• Added to game.

Ava.title: Ava
Ava.quest: Animal Magnetism, Do No Evil, Flashback
Ava.summary: She can upgrade the attractor to an accumulator for 75 steel arrows, provided the player's Ranged level is at least 50. During Do No Evil, the device is further upgraded to the alerter, which has a higher magic, ranged, attack and defence bonus while retaining the same level requirement. It is used to detect buried metal items in the desert.

Azalea Oakheart.title: Azalea Oakheart
Azalea Oakheart.summary: When spoken to, Oakheart will give the player one taijitu in thanks for the rescue. Rescuing Oakheart will unlock the gnome glider on Tuai Leit.

Azzanadra.title: Azzanadra
Azzanadra.summary:
Pontifex Maximus
• Bunny Ears

Baba Yaga.title: Baba Yaga
Baba Yaga.summary: During the sixth Winter Weekend of 2015 (running into 2016), Baba Yaga sold 40 instead of 20 battlestaves.

Banana plantation.title: Banana plantation

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Charter a ship from Port Sarim to Karamja and head west
• Amulet of glory Karamja option teleports the player just north of the plantation.

Banana plantation.summary: Players can collect bananas for Luthas; when they've filled the crate outside his hut with 10 bananas, Luthas will pay them 30 coins. However, it is better to bank the bananas and sell at the Grand Exchange for a much higher price.

Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert).title: Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)
Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert).teleport:
• Bandit camp teleport
• Bandit camp lodestone
• Enlightened amulet

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use a Bandit camp teleport scroll
• Use the Enlightened amulet teleport to arrive north of the camp
• Use the Bandit camp lodestone and run north-west (this requires completion of Desert Treasure)
• Take a Magic carpet ride to Bedabin camp and run south
• Players with access to the Fairy ring network can use the code BIQ to the Kalphite Hive and run south-west
• Use the camulet or cramulet teleport to arrive outside Enakhra's Temple and run north

Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert).summary: The town is also home to a simple general store which is used to "bank" for Bandit killers (sell noted food and buy back food unnoted). The shopkeeper there is simply called Bandit shopkeeper.

Bandit Camp (Wilderness).title: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and head northwest.
• Use the Wilderness obelisk network to teleport to the level 27 obelisk, then moving south.
• Use the Forinthry Dungeon teleport of Wilderness Sword 2, exit the dungeon using the staircase, then head west.

Bandit Camp (Wilderness).summary: Prior to entering the camp, it is recommended to have Vala help you opt into PVP. In addition to keeping the bandits tolerant of the player, it also allows them to use Noterazzo's shop.

Bandos' Arena (Yu'biusk).title: Bandos' Arena (Yu'biusk)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Teleport to the Falador lodestone and run north until the entrance to Goblin Village is reached, east of it is a big green Yu'biusk portal which can be used to teleport to arena.

Bandos' Arena (Yu'biusk).summary: During the quest The Mighty Fall, the Kyzaj Tournament between Bandos' followers to decide who will become the new leader of the Bandosian faction was held in there.

Bandos's Stronghold.title: Bandos's Stronghold
Bandos's Stronghold.teleport:
• Boss portal attuned to General Graardor
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Bandos's Stronghold is located in the north-western section of the dungeon.

Travel methods include:
• Any travelling methods getting to the dungeon
• Boss portal at War's retreat - Requires killing General Graardor at least once
• Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires Max cape and killing General Graardor at least once

Bandos's Stronghold.summary: Bandos's Stronghold is the encampment of Bandos in the north-west of God Wars Dungeon. It requires 70 Strength to enter.

Bandos's throne room.title: Bandos's throne room
Bandos's throne room.teleport:
• Bandos throne room sphere
• Strange box

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players can return to the throne room after The Chosen Commander by one of two ways:
• Teleporting with a Bandos throne room sphere made by Oldak from two law runes and one piece of molten glass.
• Using the fairy ring code BLQ to go to Yu'biusk and opening the strange box to be teleported into the throne room.

Bandos's throne room.summary: The throne room is a large room with Bandos's throne on the east wall and a portal to Dorgesh-Kaan on the west wall. The room is filled with Goblin statues, Ork statues, Ogre statues, and Ourg statues. Some of these can be climbed on, some are only decorative, and some of them come to life and attack any player who attempts to climb them.

Bank vault.title: Bank vault
Bank vault.summary: The vault features six coins spawns, a gold ore, a gold bar, a gold necklace, a brass necklace, and a ruby ring behind a locked gate. Players cannot access directly through the gate. Players who have a Magic level of 33 or higher may use the Telekinetic Grab spell to obtain all the items except for the ruby ring. There is also a spawn of three coins on the floor to the north-east of the basement, directly in front of the stairs.

Barbarian Outpost.title: Barbarian Outpost

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Barbarian Outpost is located north-east of Baxtorian Falls, north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, and south of the Lighthouse. There are four main methods of getting to the Outpost:
• Teleport using a games necklace
• Walk from Seers' Village
• Use the shortcut to the north-east of the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold (requires level 37 Agility and completion of The Grand Tree)
• Teleport using Barbarian Teleport spell (requires level 75 Magic and the Lunar spellbook)
• Teleport using the Nature's sentinel outfit (to willow trees) or any of the Oaken, Willow and Maple counterparts.

Barbarian Outpost.summary: The Barbarian Outpost is a fenced stronghold in northern Kandarin, near the border of the Fremennik Province. It was released on 25 March 2002, along with the Bar Crawl (miniquest). The Outpost is comprised of two main structures.

Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.title: Barbarian Outpost Agility Course

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Barbarian Outpost Agility Course is located within the Barbarian Outpost, north-east of Baxtorian Falls, north-east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, and south of the Lighthouse. There are five main methods of getting to the Outpost:
• Teleport using a games necklace
• Walk west from the Seers' Village lodestone
• Walk north-west from the Ardougne lodestone
• Use the shortcut to the north-east of the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold (level 37 Agility)
• Teleport using Barbarian Teleport spell (requires level 75 Magic and the Lunar spellbook)

Once at the Barbarian Outpost, the player must pass by the barbarian guards (Bar Crawl (miniquest) requirement) and then squeeze through an obstacle pipe (35 Agility requirement, boostable) to reach the actual Agility course while also giving 10 Agility experience.

Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.summary:
• Teleport using a games necklace
• Walk west from the Seers' Village lodestone
• Walk north-west from the Ardougne lodestone
• Use the shortcut to the north-east of the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold (level 37 Agility)
• Teleport using Barbarian Teleport spell (requires level 75 Magic and the Lunar spellbook)

Barbarian Village.title: Barbarian Village

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The skull sceptre offers unlimited direct teleports to the centre of Barbarian Village
• Teleport to Falador lodestone and head east
• Teleport to Varrock lodestone go through the city and exit on the west side and continue west
• Teleport to Edgeville lodestone and head south

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Barbarian Village has two main entrances; east and west, and a few smaller ones. The western entrance has a road leading to Falador, while the eastern one leads to Varrock.

Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.

Gunnarsgrunn east entrance.png | Gunnarsgrunn eastern entrance
Gunnarsgrunn west entrance.png | Gunnarsgrunn western entrance

Barbarian Village.summary: Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.

Barendir.title: Barendir

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: • Accessed via an entrance in the southeastern corner of the Keldagrim deep south mine after partial completion of King of the Dwarves quest

Barendir.summary: During King of the Dwarves, players must go to the Barendir caves in order to confront Colonel Grimsson. A battle will ensue, and once Grimsson is defeated he will retreat farther into the caves. Players must then convince Pretty Flower, a troll general, to aid them from the troll settlement that is also located in the caverns.

Barker's Haberdashery.title: Barker's Haberdashery
Barker's Haberdashery.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009) | date=9 November 2009 
• Various gloves have been added (in small amounts) to a shop in Canifis.

Barlak.title: Barlak
Barlak.summary: Unlike most "extra" experience sources, the experience from Barlak is doubled by bonus experience.

Barrows.title: Barrows

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Drakan's medallion, obtained from the The Branches of Darkmeyer quest, has a teleport directly to the Barrows and it can be used to teleport directly south of the Burgh de Rott bank.
• Use games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott and run north-east (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale and combined 500 companion levels from Temple Trekking).
• After completing the Nature Spirit quest, the swamp boat can be taken for free to the bridge between Mort'ton and the Barrows.
• There is a fairy ring in Mort Myre Swamp that can be used to reach the swamp boat. It can be accessed by code BKR. 
• After completion of In Search of the Myreque you can use the trapdoor south of the Hair of the Dog in Canifis to access a faster shortcut to the boat.
• Once you have completed the encounter of the Barrows Brothers at least once, players can use the boss portal or reaper portal at War's Retreat. Players can also use the combat portal in the Max Guild, which does not require them to have previously killed the boss.
• Use the Canifis lodestone or Kharyrll teleport and walk through Mort Myre Swamp – the slowest method is walking through the swamps from Canifis.

Map:Routes to Barrows

Barrows.summary: This village may be the remains of the camp of the Saradominist army that invaded Morytania on their crusade to free the region, known as the Morytania Campaign. When the six brothers succumbed to their wounds, their men made a camp here and buried them at the barrows.

Basement of Doom.title: Basement of Doom
Basement of Doom.summary: Players have to visit the dungeon during Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Evil Dave to obtain spices for, what Evil Dave calls, his "EVIL STEW OF DOOM". The player must use their cat to kill the hell-rats. The hell-rats will drop special coloured spices that they had stolen from Evil Dave's mother. The spicy stew with the correct amount of each of the four spices is needed to unfreeze Evil Dave from the Culinaromancer's spell.

Battered book.title: Battered book
Battered book.summary: It can be found in the shelves in the building south of the building with the anvils in it in Seers' Village. After the quest, searching the shelves in Seers' Village will result in a slashed book, but a battered book can still be found by searching the shelves in the bookcase in your house.

Battlefield.title: Battlefield
Battlefield.teleport:
• Spirit tree (Battlefield of Khazard)
• Kandarin monastery Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and head south
• Teleport to Tree Gnome Village and head north
• Use the Kandarin monastery Teleport and head west
• Teleport to the Battlefield of Khazard using a Spirit tree and head west

Battlefield.summary: The Battlefield is separated by a small river (with three bridges), with the Gnomes on the south side (by Tree Gnome Village), and the Khazard troopers on the north side. This area plays a large role in Tree Gnome Village quest. The gnomes and troopers are often seen to be engaged in battles with each other. Players are free to support either side in the battle.

Battlefield of Khazard.title: Battlefield
Battlefield of Khazard.teleport:
• Spirit tree (Battlefield of Khazard)
• Kandarin monastery Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and head south
• Teleport to Tree Gnome Village and head north
• Use the Kandarin monastery Teleport and head west
• Teleport to the Battlefield of Khazard using a Spirit tree and head west

Battlefield of Khazard.summary: The Battlefield is separated by a small river (with three bridges), with the Gnomes on the south side (by Tree Gnome Village), and the Khazard troopers on the north side. This area plays a large role in Tree Gnome Village quest. The gnomes and troopers are often seen to be engaged in battles with each other. Players are free to support either side in the battle.

Baxtorian Falls.title: Baxtorian Falls
Baxtorian Falls.location: East of the Tree Gnome Stronghold
Baxtorian Falls.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Barbarian Teleport
• Games necklace

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the Dungeoneering cape teleport to Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon (Waterfall Fire Giant dungeon) located directly inside the falls.
• Use dragon trinkets to teleport to brutal green dragons (Select Green Dragons (option 1), then Brutal Green Dragons (option 2)), then dive into the whirlpool.
• Use a games necklace to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, then run south. 
• Use the balloon transport system to travel to the Grand Tree, run north, and use the shortcut requiring 37 Agility.
• Players with level 20 or higher Agility can run from Seers' Village west past the coal truck mine and through the fence where the Dwarf Cannon quest starts.
• Players who have their house at Rellekka or have access to Rellekka tablets can teleport to Rellekka's POH portal and run to Baxtorian Falls via the lighthouse peninsula.

To enter the Waterfall Dungeon, the player must have a rope and Glarial's amulet with them, unless they have built a rope rack. In this case, they may grab a rope from the rack, but still require the amulet.

Baxtorian Falls.summary: To enter the Waterfall Dungeon, the player must have a rope and Glarial's amulet with them, unless they have built a rope rack. In this case, they may grab a rope from the rack, but still require the amulet.

Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon.title: Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon
Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon.summary: The Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon is a resource dungeon located within the Waterfall Dungeon of Baxtorian Falls. It requires level 35 Dungeoneering and the Waterfall Quest to enter. Players will be granted 3,000 Dungeoneering experience upon first entrance to the dungeon.

Bedabin Camp.title: Bedabin Camp
Bedabin Camp.teleport:
• Bandit Camp Teleport
• Enlightened amulet
• Magic carpet

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use a Bandit Camp Teleport scroll and run north
• Use the Enlightened amulet teleport to arrive south of the camp
• Use the Bandit Camp lodestone and run north-west
• Take a Magic carpet ride to Bedabin camp and run south
• Players with access to the fairy ring network can use the code BIQ to the Kalphite Hive and run south-west
• Use the Camulet or Cramulet teleport to arrive outside Enakhra's Temple and run north

Bedabin Camp.summary: Notable NPCs are Al Shabim, leader of the Bedabin nomads, archaeologist Asgarnia Smith, and a Bedabin nomad guard protecting the entrance to the northern tent. The anvil in this guarded tent can only be used during the Tourist Trap quest. A deposit chest can be found the northwest of the camp after completing the quest Deadliest Catch.

Beehive.title: Beehive
Beehive.location: West of Catherby, south of Wendlewick

Beehive.summary: A beehive is a piece of interactive scenery where players can obtain buckets of wax and to gather honeycombs, provided they have insect repellent in the backpack or on the tool belt. If the players do not have the repellent, they will take 20 life points of damage and not receive the item they were going after.

Benedict.title: Benedict
Benedict.summary: To complete the tour, players have to follow a scrapbook of clues which will lead them to stand in specific locations and collect objects. Players will have to be using the NXT client to take part in the tour. A loot beam will shine over each item.

Berylbrook.title: Berylbrook

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Stonevein amulet Key press | Tree and go east.
• Home teleport to Wendlewick and take a canoe to either:
• Amberfell Key press | 4 , head east over the barrier (next to Ash).
• Heathervein Key press | 5 , head south.
• Fairy ring code DLP to Amberfell, head east.
• Travel to the Moonrise Dig Site, walk east through Amberfell.
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell.
• # Head east.

Berylbrook.summary: Berylbrook is a ruined fishing village in Havenhythe that was destroyed by the Sanguine. A barricade separates the village from Amberfell, preventing the feral werewolves that inhabit the area from reaching it.

Big Wolf.title: Big Wolf

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Big Wolf.summary: Big Wolves are level 20 wolf pack leaders. A lone Big Wolf is found on the White Wolf Mountain near the gnome glider. Other Big Wolves can be found in the Chaos Tunnels.

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.summary: He was previously known as the sawmill operator, and he owned the Lumber Yard. He still appears as the sawmill operator during a court case, Sawmill Man v. The People.

Bill Teach.location:

• The Green Ghost
• Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'
• Mos Le'Harmless

Bill Teach.summary: Bill Teach is a pirate captain from the southern island of Mos Le'Harmless. He can be found in multiple places: Port Phasmatys on the ship at the east end of the pier or in The Green Ghost Inn; in Mos Le'Harmless on the ship at the east pier, in The Other Inn, or in the basement of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'. For maps of his location see here.

Black Arm Gang.title: Black Arm Gang
Black Arm Gang.summary: The Black Arm Gang are the arch rivals of the Phoenix Gang and are currently at war with them. It is led by Katrine Raven. The gang itself has one side of the Shield of Arrav.

Black Guard headquarters.title: Dwarven Black Guard

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
The hidden locations of most dwarven settlements makes the Black Guard a rarely seen force in most of Gielinor. However, in their territories, their power of authority can easily be seen. The Black Guard can be found in the following areas:
• Keldagrim
• Keldagrim Watchtower
• Coal truck mining site
• Ice Mountain

Black Guard headquarters.summary: The organisation has two main purposes; to fight and to govern. Backed by the Consortium's financial success, the Black Guard is able to use vast amounts of weapons and soldiers. The dwarves' problems with the trolls and goblins often require the use of military force, and in these cases, the Black Guard is called upon. The dwarves are best suited to fighting in underground tunnel systems, such as the one that exists just outside of Keldagrim. However, when forced to fight on the surface, the…

Black Knight.summary: They can be killed to increase a player's White knight rank after completing the Wanted! quest. This allows greater access to the White Knight Master Armoury run by Sir Vyvin. The Black Knight location within Taverley Dungeon is ideal for gaining these kills.

Black Knights' Base.title: Black Knights' Base

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the Master archaeologist's outfit or the Archaeology teleport to teleport directly to Isaura (Key press | 0 → Key press | 4 ). 
• Using a Dungeoneering cape, Dungeoneering master cape or Hoardstalker ring to teleport to the Taverley blue dragon resource dungeon (Key press | 0 → Key press | 1 ) and walk east through the gate, then south.

Black Knights' Base.summary: To access the base the player must climb down the steps south of Taverley and run past numerous monsters including chaos dwarves and hill giants. Because of this, it is advised that lower levelled players take food. The base plays a part in the Wanted! quest, where the player must interrogate Lord Daquarius about the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar. It also is the main location for The Void Stares Back, in which the player has to explore an area next to the base to find the Pest Queen.

Black Knights' Catacombs.title: Black Knights' Catacombs

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: To enter, players must enter the Black Knights' Fortress and climb down the ladder in the southwestern corner of the floor 1. Either a bronze med helm and an iron chainbody, full Dagon'hai robes, full elite black armour, full black armour, Black Knight captain's armour, or the Dulcin armour are needed to enter the fortress. Alternatively, the Skull of Remembrance teleports players into the fortress's top floor after The Death of Chivalry. From here, climb down the staircase immediately below the portal to the floor 3. Go south and climb down more stairs in the southeast corner to access floor 2. Go north to the dining area, turn west and climb down the staircase to the northwest to reach the floor 1. Go east through the second door from the north side, head south to the lobby and then climb the ladder in the southwest room. Once down the ladder to the basement, players must cast any Charge Orb spell on the strange tile during While Guthix Sleeps, or go down the trapdoor after the quest.

Black Knights' Catacombs.summary: The dungeon contains Elite Black Knights, warriors, rangers, and mages. They all use Prayer when battling. Players may range or mage the knights and warriors as there are some safespots. To stop them from being aggressive, the player must wear elite black armour or Dagon'hai robes.

Black Knights' Fortress.title: Black Knights' Fortress

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport directly into the castle using the Skull of Remembrance
• Mind altar teleport to teleport to the mind altar and run east
• Players with access to the Ancient Magicks spellbook can use Lassar Teleport to reach Ice Mountain and run north
• Teleport to the Monastery of Saradomin using a combat bracelet and run through Ice Mountain 
• Teleport to Edgeville using the Edgeville lodestone and run North of Ice Mountain

getting_there.heading: Equipment that allows access to the fort
getting_there.text:
Players who do not have defence level 10 cannot wear the Guard uniform, however they can obtain the Black Knight captain's armour which has no level requirements by starting The Death of Chivalry (no need to finish the quest).

• Bronze med helm

• Black Knight captain's boots
• Skull of Remembrance, which teleports the player directly into the castle

;Notes:

Black Knights' Fortress.summary: The fortress can be used as a training ground for players, but is almost always empty. On the floor 2, several Black Knight characters can be attacked by players. This is also true for the Black Knights on the roof of the Fortress. On the floor 1 of the fortress, a chapel is located, containing several Monks of Zamorak and Clerics of Zamorak. These cannot be killed, as is the case for Knights on the floor 2. The fortress is a great place to get the Black knight kill count up after the players…

Blasidar the sculptor.title: Blasidar the sculptor
Blasidar the sculptor.summary: When The Giant Dwarf statue of King Alvis, Keldagrim's final king and the founder of the Mining Consortium was accidentally destroyed, Blasidar was selected to rebuild the statue perfectly. However, as dwarves are more adept at art using stone rather than paint, he was struggling to proceed, lacking a physical guide to base his new statue on. He asked an adventurer, who had been commissioned to help him due to their role in destroying the original statue, to obtain some clothes, boots and King…

Blast Furnace.title: Blast Furnace

getting_there.heading: Travelling to Keldagrim
getting_there.text:
Map | mapID=21 | plane=0 | 115,149 | mtype=square | align=right | caption=Location of the Blast Furnace 
The Blast Furnace is located in south-east Keldagrim, north of the Keldagrim minecart system station. There are many ways to reach Keldagrim, including:
• Riding the train carts for free. 
• Using the Keldagrim trapdoor just north-west of the Grand Exchange (you must have visited Keldagrim before you can use this shortcut).
• From the passage under White Wolf Mountain (requires Fishing Contest).
• Riding the train from the first level of Dorgesh-Kaan.
• Walking to Keldagrim's entrance from Rellekka or Seers' Village.
• Fairy ring code DKS transports players to the north-east of the Keldagrim entrance.
• Using the Keldagrim teleport on the Luck of the Dwarves ring. This will teleport players to the west side of Keldagrim, south-east of the bank.

Blast Furnace.summary: Although the Blast Furnace does not involve combat, players may take damage while using the pump if the furnace's heat level rises to an extreme level, as indicated by the red zone on the furnace's temperature gauge.

Blighted Cave.title: Blighted Cave

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: • Fairy ring Fairy code | BKS and walk north-east

Blighted Cave.summary: The Blighted Cave refers to both the cave below and the area above it, that hosts sanguine crawlers. The soil patch for the tainted seed is in the above-ground area. The cave is where Silverquill, the Dreadhog is located.

Blooming Burrow.title: Blooming Burrow

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The following teleports lead to the northern island with Easter Bunny's house:
• Blooming Burrow entry in the Calendar interface
• Blooming Burrow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network for the first time
• Holiday portal in Prifddinas
• Town criers

The following teleports lead to the western island with the Egg Plant:
• Entering the Blooming Burrow portal in the event hub north of the Grand Exchange in Varrock
• Blooming Burrow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network after the first time
• Event noticeboards
• Button in the Event tab in the Community interface
• Tree of Balance

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
Beehives

The beehives in the southern part of Blooming Burrow are used in the beekeeping activity for Farming.

Easter Bunny's house

Easter Bunny's house is located in the northern part of Blooming Burrow. Easter Bunny lives there, and the burrow leads here. The house features a cooking range.

Egg Plant

The Egg Plant is a factory that can be found in the western part of Blooming Burrow. It features two skilling activities: foil smithing and factory line, which is unlocked upon completing the seasonal Great Egg-spectations quest.

The two reward shops and the bank chest in the area are located outside the Egg Plant.

Farm

The farm in the southern part of Blooming Burrow features Fizzy Bunny who can be used to hand in chocolate rabbits as part of the cocoamancy activity.

Mines

The mines in the south-western part of Blooming Burrow can be used for the chocolate mining activity. The mine produces chocolate for the Egg Plant factory.

Blooming Burrow.summary:
The following teleports lead to the western island with the Egg Plant:
• Entering the Blooming Burrow portal in the event hub north of the Grand Exchange in Varrock
• Blooming Burrow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network after the first time
• Event noticeboards
• Button in the Event tab in the Community interface
• Tree of Balance

Blue Moon Inn.title: Blue Moon Inn

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Teleport to the Varrock lodestone, the inn is a short distance to the north.

Blue Moon Inn.summary: Several non-player characters inside play a role in several quests.

Bolkoy.title: Bolkoy
Bolkoy.summary:
He is the answer to the clue scroll anagram "BY LOOK". He gives players a challenge scroll asking, "How many flowers are there in the clearing below this platform?" The answer for this challenge is 13.
clear | left

Boneyard.title: Boneyard
Boneyard.teleport: Wilderness Crater lodestone and run east

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use Carrallanger Teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows and run east
• Teleport to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and run east
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and run north
• Players with 57 woodcutting can make a waka just outside the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange and ride it to the lake in level 35 wilderness. Run south-east around the volcano to reach the boneyard

Boneyard.summary: Non-members find this area helpful when training Prayer, but most members move on to other methods such as the Ectofuntus and POH Altars.

Boneyard Hunter area.title: Boneyard Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Wilderness lodestone or use Carrallangar Teleport and run east.
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and run north.
• Players with level 57 woodcutting can make a waka canoe just outside the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange and ride it to the lake in level 35 wilderness. Run south-east around the volcano to reach the boneyard.

Boneyard Hunter area.summary: To trap black salamanders, use a small fishing net and rope on one of the 4 young trees. Harralander tar may used to bait the trap and a lit torch may be used on it to reduce the player's scent, slightly increasing chances of catching a salamander.

Boni (rewards).title: Boni (rewards)
Boni (rewards).summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (10 October 2016) | date=10 October 2016 
• Boni has been feeling generous and now gives flags out for free.

Boric.title: Boric
Boric.summary: Boric took over the supply chain of the business, but the increase in demand took a heavy toll on their supplies. He began tasking their new business partner with gathering coal and mithril ore, protecting their mining sites from living rock brawlers, and securing a contract with the Mining Guild.

Boris Barrington.title: Boris Barrington
Boris Barrington.summary: Boris used to be a citizen of Meiyerditch before he was taken by Vyrewatch and forced to play in Darkmeyer forever, even after his death. He says vampyres don't like his music, but they do like to see him suffering.

Getting there

Bork is located in the Chaos Tunnels. He can only be reached by completing the miniquest The Hunt for Surok, otherwise the player will receive a chat notice that says, "This portal does not appear to be working."

After following Surok through the tunnels and defeating Bork the first time, players can revisit Bork's chamber by:
• Using the Varrock armour 4 to teleport directly to the portal for Bork's chamber.
• Using a hoardstalker ring or Dungeoneering cape (or master cape) to teleport to the chamber of black demons, 2 chambers away from Bork's portal. 
• Using a mask of dust to teleport to the chamber of dust devils, in the north-west part of the Chaos Tunnels.
• Using a mask of granite to teleport to the chamber of gargoyles, in the south-west of the Chaos Tunnels.
• Attuning the boss portal in the Max Guild to Bork (costs 100,000 coins per attunement).
• Players can also reach the gargoyle chamber by entering the entrance to Chaos Tunnels in level 6 Wilderness. Players cannot use the rope to exit the Wilderness if they have been in combat in the last…

Bosun Higgs.title: Bosun Higgs
Bosun Higgs.summary: She is the elder sister of Jacob Higgs, whom she has a close relationship with, even transferring to Draynor Village so they could be close to each other. She is knowledgeable about boats, claiming she knows them better than Jacob.

Boulder (Hunter).summary: Boulder is a scenery used in deadfall trapping, requiring 23 Hunter, a knife and logs to set up a deadfall trap.

Braindeath Island.title: Braindeath Island
Braindeath Island.teleport:
• Pirate spell sheet
• Big Book o' Piracy

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Partial completion of Rum Deal is required to access Braindeath Island.
• Ectophial teleport to the Ectofuntus. Run northeast and talk to Pirate Pete to travel to Braindeath island.
• Big Book o' Piracy teleport directly to the island
• Pirate spell sheet teleport from Mos Le'Harmless
• Dungeoneering cape or Hoardstalker ring teleport to the Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon

Braindeath Island.summary: The island isn't shown on the Gielinor surface on the world map, although its climate and culture suggest it is somewhere in the Eastern Sea. To find it on the world map, players must choose Braindeath Island from the drop-down menu, or click the dungeon icon in Port Phasmatys.

Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon.title: Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon
Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon.summary: Players will need a diving apparatus and fishbowl helmet to access this dungeon. Because of its underwater state, dwarf multicannons and summoning familiars are not allowed into the dungeon.

Brian Twitcher.title: Brian Twitcher
Brian Twitcher.location: South-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony
Brian Twitcher.summary: In the year 119 of the Fifth Age, Brian found the phoenix's lair and attempted to observe her from concealment, though he was left alone as he was not considered a threat. He studied the phoenix's lair, creating an altar to her, which she appreciated, and taking some artefacts to be evaluated, which she did not appreciate.

Brimhaven.title: Brimhaven
Brimhaven.teleport:
• Brimhaven tablet
• House Teleport, if house is in Brimhaven, 
• Karamja lodestone
• Spirit tree

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Brimhaven is located immediately north of the Karamja lodestone.
• Brimhaven has a ship ride that will take the player to Ardougne for the low price of 30 coins. This ship is located in the northern part of Brimhaven. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
• The charter ships also dock in the Brimhaven Harbour. They provide rides to several other locations, for a fee.
• If you have completed the Shilo Village quest, then Hajedy will take you for a ride in his cart to Shilo Village for the fee of 10-200 coins.
• The House Teleport spell can be used if player-owned house is in Brimhaven. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Brimhaven tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Brimhaven house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
• The amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.
• If the Holy Grail and A Fairy Tale Part II quests are completed, the Fisher Realm can be reached through the fairy ring system by using code BJR. Use the magic whistle, found at the northwest corner…

Brimhaven.summary: Dead Man's Chest exterior.png | The Brimhaven bar

Brimhaven Dungeon.title: Brimhaven Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
• It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
• Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven. 
• Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins). 

Teleportation is also practical:
• Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means. 
• House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
• Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
• Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
• Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run…

Brimhaven Dungeon.summary: In order to access the dungeon, players must pay 875 coins to Saniboch who guards the entrance to the dungeon. Saniboch will let players enter free of charge if the player has completed the Hard Karamja achievements.

Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon.title: Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The fastest way to travel is to use metallic dragon trinkets to teleport to iron dragons (Brimhaven dungeon), placing you one tile away from the resource dungeon. 

Otherwise players will need 875 coins to enter the Brimhaven Dungeon, unless they have completed the hard Karamja achievements, which will grant free access. A hatchet is required to chop through the roots along the way. The hatchet in your tool belt will work. The resource dungeon can also be accessed via a charged hoardstalker ring or a Dungeoneering cape. 

The resource dungeon is at the end of the dungeon, within the room featuring iron and steel dragons.

Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon.summary: The Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon is a resource dungeon found in the room with iron and steel dragons in the Brimhaven Dungeon. A Dungeoneering level of 80 is required to enter. Players will be granted 12,800 Dungeoneering experience upon first entrance to the dungeon.

Brimstail.title: Brimstail
Brimstail.summary: Brimstail is one of the few gnomes that uses magic. He dabbles in the gnomish art of illusion spells, and is actually in possession of the machine that Oaknock used to prove the death of Argento the spirit tree.

Brimstail's home.title: Brimstail's home
Brimstail's home.summary: Brimstail's home is a small cave found in the south-western section of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. The entrance is marked by the icon on the minimap. It is the home of Brimstail, a gnome wizard. It is the starting point of, and plays a large role in, The Eyes of Glouphrie quest. From here, by talking to Brimstail, players can travel to the rune essence mine (however, this is not commonly used due to its distance from a bank).

Brine Rat Cavern.title: Brine Rat Cavern
Brine Rat Cavern.location: Southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province. There are multiple ways to travel to the cavern. One of the quickest ways is to use the fairy ring, code DKS. Alternatively, a player may use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run northeast. Mask or helm of the Frozen Wyrm twice a day to teleport into the Ice strykewyrm cave. From there, exit the cave and you will emerge close to the windswept tree.

Brine Rat Cavern.summary: The Brine Rat Cavern is a series of caverns which feature heavily in Olaf's Quest, and cannot be accessed beforehand. It can be entered after starting the quest by digging deep snow south of the windswept tree. The entrance is located on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area. After digging the deep snow, the player will be stunned for a few seconds and emerge in the southwestern section of the cavern.

Brother Kojo.title: Brother Kojo
Brother Kojo.location: Clock Tower south of West Ardougne
Brother Kojo.summary: At some point, the cogs required for the clock to function went missing, left strewn throughout the Clock Tower Dungeon. Fearing the townspeople's anger and being too weak to lift the cogs by himself, he asked a passing adventurer to retrieve the cogs. He provided them with rat poison to help retrieve the white cog. Once the clock was fixed, he paid the adventurer 500 coins for their aid.

Brother Samwell.title: Brother Samwell
Brother Samwell.summary: He begged a passing adventurer to help him and his slain brethren investigate the attack, which had left his brothers as spirits, incapable of passing onto the afterlife. He gave them his notebook to record evidence. Although all the evidence pointed towards an elf, they continued to investigate further, finding the elf's body also bound as a spirit, and evidence to suggest the work of a Saradominist wizard. He asked the adventurer to go to the Wizards' Tower, who gathered more evidence. They…

Brundt the Chieftain.title: Brundt the Chieftain
Brundt the Chieftain.summary: Brundt also plays a role in Lunar Diplomacy. He provides players with a seal of passage which will allow them to visit Lunar Isle as a peaceful ambassador. Without a seal of passage, players will not be able to go to Lunar Isle, and talking to anyone on the Isle without a seal of passage will result in the player being teleported off the island. After completing Lunar Diplomacy, players are able to visit the island without the seal of passage, but will still be unable to talk to anyone. This…

Bryll Thoksdottir.summary: Interacting with her at the Dragonkin Laboratory entrance for the first time will give three Dragonkin Laboratory lucky charms, three shifting tombs reward enhancers, and five vital spark drop enhancers.

Burgh de Rott.title: Burgh de Rott
Burgh de Rott.teleport:
• Burgh de Rott Ramble
• Games necklace
• Drakan's medallion

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The games necklace can be used to teleport to Burgh de Rott with the completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale quest and having 500 companion levels in Temple Trekking.
• After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
• Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• A Swamp Boat can be taken nearby to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
• Run south from Canifis (with a shortcut via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern after In Search of the Myreque).
• Fairy ring code BKR to Mort Myre Swamp.
• Players with at least 1 Barrows kill can use a Boss portal, attuned to the Barrows to teleport there, arriving at the Northeast of Burgh de Rott.
• Running from Canifis, while slow, has no requirements.

getting_there.heading: Cave entrance
getting_there.text:
A cave entrance, south of the town's bank, leads to a small underground tomb. This area is used as part of the quest The Branches of Darkmeyer, and cannot be accessed beforehand. Inside is a sarcophagus, with the floor nearby marked with the symbol of Drakan. This tomb is where Drakan's medallion is originally found, and the medallion can be recharged by dipping it into the pool of blood found within the tomb.
Clear

Burgh de Rott.summary: Places of interest include the bank, the furnace, the general store, fishing spots, and the bar. The woods to the east of the town are full of Vampyre juveniles, Vampyre juvinates, and Vyrewatch. A boat on the east side of town can take players to Meiyerditch if they have reached a certain point in The Darkness of Hallowvale.

Burnt Lobster Tavern.title: Burnt Lobster Tavern
Burnt Lobster Tavern.summary:
