Burntmeat.title: Burntmeat
Burntmeat.quest: Eadgar's Ruse, My Arm's Big Adventure, The Mighty Fall
Burntmeat.summary: Most trolls are named after the first thing they eat, but Burntmeat says that burnt meat was the first thing he tried to cook. Burntmeat enjoys cooking as well as eating humans and goutweed. He is also illiterate.

Burthorpe.title: Burthorpe
Burthorpe.teleport:
• Burthorpe lodestone
• Games necklace
• Ring of respawn

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
All players
• Teleport directly to the Burthorpe lodestone.
• Teleport to the Taverley lodestone or use the House Teleport spell to the Taverley POH portal (if the player has a house there) and walk north.
• Teleport to the Troll Invasion Distraction and Diversion by using the games necklace.

Members only
• Teleport just outside the Warriors' Guild by using the combat bracelet.
• Players with 99 Slayer can use the Slayer cape perk to teleport to Turael (or Spria, after While Guthix Sleeps), who stands directly north of the Burthorpe bank near the Warriors' Guild.

Burthorpe.summary: The Troll Country is immediately north of Burthorpe, and due to that, the city has come under constant attacks, raids, and invasions by the trolls, having led to the Burthorpe - Troll Country War. Death Plateau in particular seems a threat, as many heavily armed trolls have a permanent camp there. The Imperial Guard, with help of adventurers, has been taking measures to reduce this threat. Trolls are often seen invading the town, slaughtering families and soldiers alike. If the trolls were to…

Burthorpe Castle.title: Burthorpe Castle
Burthorpe Castle.summary: Previously, the castle's main use to many players was as gateway to Burthorpe, since the games necklace teleported to the Games Room. However, with the addition of the Troll Invasion distraction, the teleport was moved out of the castle. It also played a role in the Death Plateau quest, before the area was updated.

Burthorpe Games Room.title: Burthorpe Games Room
Burthorpe Games Room.summary: The games can be played globally on an Instance shard world. This is accessible from any normal world and allows players on different worlds to join in the same game. You need two players to start a game. One player challenges the other, and chooses options. The second player can accept the challenge, and cannot change the settings.

Burthorpe Slayer Cave.title: Burthorpe Slayer Cave

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Players can enter the dungeon through the cave entrance located in Eastern Taverley, immediately south of Ewean's Grove.

Burthorpe Slayer Cave.summary: Attempting to collect water before or after this quest, however, yields the message "You don't have any use for this water."

Burthorpe lodestone.title: Burthorpe lodestone
Burthorpe lodestone.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (21 May 2018) | date=21 May 2018 
• Lodestones have been graphically updated, alongside this blocking has been removed from around the lodestone.
• Removed any force walk areas that used to exist on lodestones.

Burthorpe training camp.title: Burthorpe training camp
Burthorpe training camp.teleport:
• Burthorpe lodestone
• Games necklace
• Ring of respawn
Burthorpe training camp.summary: Commander Denulth, the leader of Imperial Guard can be found training soldiers in the camp. They are all keeping Burthorpe secure, and are responsible for the maintenance and defence of Burthorpe Castle which stands between Burthorpe and Trollheim.

Cabin Fever.title: Cabin Fever
Cabin Fever.summary: In Cabin Fever, you learn to become a pirate by aiding the shifty Bill Teach in running his ship, being finally rewarded with access to the island of Mos Le'Harmless.

Cairn Isle.title: Cairn Isle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use Spirit Graahk teleport to the Karamja Hunter area and run south
• Players with access to the Fairy ring network can use the code CKR and run south-west
• Use the Karamja gloves 3 teleport to the underground portion of the Shilo Village mine exit the ladder above and head north through the shortcut below the wall (wall shortcut requires completion of Karamja Elite Achievements to use).
• Use the Wicked hood to teleport to the Nature altar exit and run south-west
• Use the Elder divination outfit teleport to the Gleaming wisps colony then run south-west
• Use the Karamja lodestone teleport and run south

Cairn Isle is an island on the south-west of Karamja, south of Tai Bwo Wannai and west of Shilo Village. To access the island, players must scale a small promontory stood on the Karamjan coastline by climbing up a rocks (requires 15 Agility), and then walk across the wooden bridge linking up the two islands. In case the player stumbles while climbing the rockslide, they will slide back down and take…

Cam the Camel.title: Cam the Camel
Cam the Camel.summary: Players following hard Treasure Trails clues are sometimes directed to her with the anagram 'Ace Match Elm', 'Me Am The Calc' or 'Them Cal Came'. She then asks them to complete a puzzle box. The Camulet or Cramulet is not required in order to do this.

Camel Warriors island.title: Camel Warriors island

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Agility Pyramid (Jaleustrophos) using the Pharaoh's sceptre or the sceptre of the gods, then run south towards the stepping stones.
• Use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet, run north and then east towards the shortcut out of Sophanem, then run south towards the stepping stones.

Camel Warriors island.summary: The island plays a small role in Crocodile Tears, one of the oases is found here.

Camelot.title: Camelot

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The spell Camelot Teleport can be cast at level 45 Magic with 5 air runes and 1 law rune, teleporting players directly in front of the castle assuming the teleport destination has not been changed.

Camelot.summary: Camelot was once the home of the Sinclair family. However, when the Knights of the Round Table came to Gielinor, Lord Sinclair gave the castle to them and moved to Sinclair Mansion.

Canifis.title: Canifis
Canifis.teleport:
• Canifis lodestone
• Fairy ring CKS
• Kharyrll Teleport
• Portal Chamber

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
• Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
• The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
• Focussing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
• Fairy Ring code CKS.
• After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
• After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

Canifis.summary:
• Kharyrll Teleport
• Portal Chamber

Canifis is a village that lies to the east of Paterdomus, across the River Salve, in Morytania. It is the village of the werewolves and is accessible only to members.

Canifis lodestone.title: Canifis lodestone
Canifis lodestone.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (21 May 2018) | date=21 May 2018 
• Lodestones have been graphically updated, alongside this blocking has been removed from around the lodestone.
• Removed any force walk areas that used to exist on lodestones.

Cap'n Ekahi.title: Cap'n Ekahi
Cap'n Ekahi.quest: Head of the Family, Jed Hunter
Cap'n Ekahi.summary: Sometime in the past, Jed saved Ekahi's life, and Ekahi decided to serve Jed after this incident. After becoming the lookout, Ekahi leads the player to Jed, knowing that they are kinder than Jed, under the promise that they do not kill him. Ekahi "kills" the player to get coordinates to Jed, and when the Thalassus eats Jed when he attempts to bail ship, Ekahi still stays by the player, believing that Jed was killed by the will of the sea and not the player.

Cap'n Izzy No-Beard.title: Cap'n Izzy No-Beard
Cap'n Izzy No-Beard.summary: Cap'n Izzy is the destination for a hard clue scroll with the anagram "O BIRDZ A ZANY EN PC". The parrot will give players a challenge scroll, asking how many banana trees are in the banana plantation, the answer to which is 33.

Captain Klemfoodle.title: Captain Klemfoodle
Captain Klemfoodle.summary: During The Grand Tree, a player can be redirected from the original glider that first crashes on Karamja to land south of the Shipyard safely.

Captain Lawgof.title: Captain Lawgof
Captain Lawgof.summary: Lawgof answers to Supreme Commander Bisi, who leads the Black Guard from Keldagrim. His status as captain likely puts him right below the commanders who typically oversee larger settlements in the Dwarven Realm.

Captain Ninto.title: Captain Ninto
Captain Ninto.summary: He is a hard customer of the Gnome Restaurant minigame and is one of the two customers that can reward the gnome scarf and gnome goggles, the other being Captain Daerkin.

Captain Rovin.title: Captain Rovin
Captain Rovin.summary:
The captain can be found on the floor 3 of the north-west tower of the castle, at the top of a spiral staircase. But other than quests and dialogue, he has no use.
clear | left

Captured Temple.title: Captured Temple
Captured Temple.teleport:
• Bandosian token
• Falador lodestone
• Goblin village sphere
• Master archaeology outfit

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Bandosian token allows 10 teleports per day to the Bandos camp, just east of the Captured Temple, if the player sided with Bandos during the Bird and the Beast event.
• Using Falador lodestone and walking to the north.
• Using Master archaeology outfit to teleport to the Generals Bentnoze & Wartface and then walking south.
• Mind altar teleport to teleport to mind altar and then running south-west.
• Goblin village sphere can also be used to teleport to Goblin village which is just short way north from the Temple.

Captured Temple.summary: The Captured Temple is a temple of Zamorak located north of Falador, south of Goblin Village. It contains four level 46 and two level 43 Monks of Zamorak, and one Wine of Zamorak on a table as well as an altar.

Carnillean family.title: Carnillean family
Carnillean family.summary: In Hazeel Cult, the player has the option of siding with either the Carnillean family in order to put a stop to the Cult of Hazeel, or a group of fanatics devoted to the ancient Mahjarrat lord Hazeel, who once ruled over the area now known as Ardougne. The Carnillean family is descended from the man who originally defeated Hazeel and freed Ardougne from his reign of terror. If the player chooses to side with them during Hazeel Cult, they must help them take back the family armour, known as…

Caroline.title: Caroline
Caroline.summary:
NPC map | npcname=Caroline | npcid=7181 | plane=1 | x=2710 | y=3282 | r=4 | caption=After Sea Slug 
id: 696

Caroline is a woman who lives in Witchaven with her husband Kent and son Kennith. She can initially be found near the northern shore of the village, worried about the disappearance of her family.

Cassie's Shield Shop.title: Cassie's Shield Shop
Cassie's Shield Shop.summary: The floor 2 has a cooked chicken respawn.

Castle Wars.title: Castle Wars

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Map | x=2407 | y=3103 | zoom=1 | align=right | caption=Castle Wars on the map 
Castle Wars is found in the south-west corner of Kandarin and can be accessed via a number of ways:
• Use a ring of duelling to teleport directly to Castle Wars.
• Teleport to the Yanille lodestone and go west.
• Use the Balloon transport system to Castle Wars, which lands north of the entrance.
• The fairy ring codes BKP (south of Castle Wars), CIQ (north-west of Yanille), and ALP (near Gu'Tanoth) teleport to locations near Castle Wars, but are considerably farther away than other teleports.

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: GU | subject=location | GUL | date= | update= | img=Castle Wars scoreboard old.png | name=Castle Wars scoreboard | GUL | date= | update= | img=CW-Scoreboard.png | name=Castle Wars scoreboard

Castle Wars.summary: Castle Wars is a combat-based, members-only minigame similar to Capture the Flag but with a RuneScape twist.

Catherby.title: Catherby
Catherby.teleport:
• Camelot Teleport
• Catherby lodestone
• Catherby Teleport
• Tele-group Catherby

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• From Taverley, venture west across White Wolf Mountain or take the tunnel below (requires completion of the Fishing Contest quest).
• Teleport to Catherby directly by using the Catherby lodestone.
• Teleport to Seers' Village lodestone and walk south-east.
• Cast Camelot Teleport or use a Camelot teleport tablet and walk south-east.
• Sail to Catherby's port using a charter ship.
• Use the modified botanist's mask to teleport to the Catherby herb patch (up to 3 times per day).

Catherby.summary: There is a range in Catherby to cook fish and some farmed produce. Catherby is also a convenient place to train Herblore after completing Druidic Ritual, as limpwurt roots and tarromin can be planted with a Farming level of 26 to make strength potions. There are also unicorns to the west, whose horns are used in making antipoison. Vials can be filled with water using one of the town's water sources. Useful objects can be caught with a big net bought from the fishing shop. With level 41…

Catherby lodestone.title: Catherby lodestone
Catherby lodestone.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (21 May 2018) | date=21 May 2018 
• Lodestones have been graphically updated, alongside this blocking has been removed from around the lodestone.
• Removed any force walk areas that used to exist on lodestones.

Cauldron of Thunder.title: Cauldron of Thunder
Cauldron of Thunder.summary: The cauldron used to be guarded by two level 19 suits of armour that were right outside the gate. Due to the Drudic Ritual update, they no longer appear in the game. Between the cauldron and the entrance are level 22 skeletons. Players with lower combat levels should be aware of this.

Cave entrance (Toban's island).title: Cave entrance (Toban's island)
Cave entrance (Toban's island).summary: After entering the cave, the player makes a humorous remark that the tunnel leads a long way.

Chaeldar.title: Chaeldar
Chaeldar.summary:
Chaeldar's special task is for the player to test an experimental fungicide spray against ten zygomites and survive to return to her and tell her the results of the test. The player uses the spray in place of the normal Fungicide spray, when the zygomite the player is attacking has been reduced to 20 life points or less. When applied, the experimental spray will have one of the following effects, chosen randomly:
• "The experimental spray has sent the zygomite into a furious rage!" The zygomite…

Champions' Guild.title: Champions' Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Varrock lodestone and run south-west.
• Use the canoe to reach the station attended by Tarquin located directly behind the guild.
• Rub a combat bracelet and teleport directly outside the guild.
• Activate a Quest Cape or master quest cape and use the third teleport option.

Champions' Guild.summary: There is a small area on the eastern side of the guild where several chickens can be found and the small southern room contains a range. This makes the guild a good place for players with low Cooking levels to train Cooking and combat, as the chickens' raw chicken drops can be cooked on the range.

Chaos Druid Tower.title: Chaos Druid Tower

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to East Ardougne using the Ardougne Teleport spell or tablet and run north-west.
• Teleport to the Fishing Guild using a skills necklace or Fishing Guild Teleport (requires level 85 Magic and Lunar Diplomacy) and run south-west.
• Teleport to the Outpost using a traveller's necklace and run east.
• Teleport to the Manor Farm using the Manor farm Teleport and run west.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, then run west.
• Teleport to West Ardougne using 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport tab and running east through the gate into East Ardougne and then north.

Chaos Druid Tower.summary: On the floor 2 of the tower, there are three chests. These chests can be unlocked with level 75 Thieving. These chests give 1,282 experience and reward various herbs, herb seeds or a small amount of coins upon successful looting.

Chaos Dwarf Battlefield.title: Chaos Dwarf Battlefield

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Cleanup | The following methods all refer to the same boatman/ferryman; please restate them concisely. 
• Start at the Grand Exchange, go north-west and travel to Keldagrim through the Keldagrim trapdoor. Then run north until seeing a bridge. Cross it and go south past the Kelda hops patch in front of the Consortium's western entrance until getting to the Stonemason's hut, then go east until reaching a small tower-like building. Open the door, go through, and follow the southern path and cross the bridge. Once over the bridge, run west until seeing a tunnel (completion of Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf is needed). Enter the tunnel and arrive at the battlefield with level 48-92 enemies. The chaos dwarves will only become aggressive if you initiate combat against one of them, excluding the non-aggressive dwogres.
• Using the Grand Exchange method listed above, one can also take a shortcut by utilising the palace that gaps the river. Simply enter the palace, go up the stairs, run over the river, go down the stairs, then leave the palace. This shortens the walk/run by about 30 seconds to a minute.
• Using the Grand Exchange method there is actually a shorter way than the above method.…

Chaos Dwarf Battlefield.summary: The main attraction of this dungeon is the dragon pickaxe, which players can obtain from killing the Red Axe dwarves as a very rare drop. Other items that attract players are the hand cannon, a powerful 2-handed ranged weapon, and its ammo, the hand cannon shot.

Chaos Elemental.title: Chaos Elemental

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Ardougne teleport lever or Edgeville teleport lever, which both teleport the player to the nearby Deserted Keep.
• A Wilderness obelisk is near the Rogues' Castle for fast access, with obelisk shards or a portable obelisk as viable alternatives, though obelisks send players to random locations until the hard Wilderness achievements are completed.
• Annakarl Teleport brings players to the Demonic Ruins to the south.
• Teleport to the Dragonkin Laboratory and run through the gate to the north west.

The Reaper portal cannot be used to teleport to the Chaos Elemental, nor can a boss portal be attuned to it.

Chaos Elemental.summary: The Reaper portal cannot be used to teleport to the Chaos Elemental, nor can a boss portal be attuned to it.

Chaos Ridge.title: Chaos Ridge
Chaos Ridge.summary: The Chaos Ridge is an area located around levels 28-32 Wilderness, where many abyssal creatures can be found.

Chaos Temple (Wilderness).title: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
Chaos Temple (Wilderness).teleport:
• Carrallangar Teleport
• Obelisk (Wilderness)
• Obelisk shard
• Portable obelisk

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players may enter the Wilderness from the wall just north of the Varrock Palace and simply run north.
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone then head west, jump over the Wilderness wall and walk north.
• Archaeology journal teleport to Archaeology Guild, then teleport to Infernal Source Dig Site and walk north.
• The Wilderness obelisk located in level 18 wilderness (players with Wilderness sword 3 may select this obelisk rather than have the obelisk network randomly teleport them to a location) is located just north of the altar. It is surrounded by level 98 abyssal demons (not aggressive).
• Carrallangar Teleport from the Ancient Magicks takes the player next to the Graveyard of Shadows. From there they should run south to reach the altar.
• Running east after teleporting to the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
• The enlightened amulet will teleport the player to the north of the temple.

Chaos Temple (Wilderness).summary: Inside the temple is a chaos altar which offers extra Prayer experience.

Chaos Temple (hut).title: Chaos Temple (hut)
Chaos Temple (hut).teleport:
• Ghorrock Teleport
• Obelisk shard
• Obelisk (Wilderness)
• Portable obelisk

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest method of reaching the temple is via the spell Ghorrock Teleport from the Ancient Magicks, which is a short distance north-east of the temple. 
• Alternatively, the level 44 obelisk is very close to this teleport spot which players who have obtained the Wilderness sword 3 may specifically select while using the obelisk network (the teleport locations are random otherwise).
• Wilderness sword 1 or higher and by teleporting to the Herb patch and running West beyond the Lava Maze (This involves running past aggressive Abyssal Beasts which can be easily done with Surge).

Chaos Temple (hut).summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Double XP & Retro Dragon Claws - This Week In RuneScape | date=20 February 2023 
• The 'Offer' option has been removed from the western Wilderness Chaos Altar.

Chaos Temple Dungeon.title: Chaos Temple Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Talk to Hartwin in the north-west tower of Varrock Palace and he will teleport players right next to the trapdoor leading into the dungeon. Although it is nominally located at the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness, there is no way to access the dungeon from the true Wilderness, nor any way to return to the Wilderness from the safe area. If the player has opted into PvP, standard restrictions apply (coins cannot be put in the money pouch, disassembly is disabled, etc.), but player killing will not be possible, as the instance is not shared but unique for each player. If players walk to the edge of the safe area, they will be given the option of returning to Varrock Palace.

The entrance to the dungeon is behind (south of) the Chaos altar within the temple. Players must have completed at least part of the Defender of Varrock quest to enter the dungeon.

Chaos Temple Dungeon.summary: The entrance to the dungeon is behind (south of) the Chaos altar within the temple. Players must have completed at least part of the Defender of Varrock quest to enter the dungeon.

Chaos Tunnels.title: Chaos Tunnels
Chaos Tunnels.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
• North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
• East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
• North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
• North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
• North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

Chaos Tunnels.summary:
or l/o Crocodile Tears | the building | Clock Tower (building)

Chaos Tunnels resource dungeon.title: Chaos Tunnels resource dungeon
Chaos Tunnels resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
A hoardstalker ring or a Dungeoneering cape can be used to teleport directly outside of the resource dungeons entrance.

The Dungeoneering cape teleport to the dungeon requires the miniquest The Hunt for Surok before it unlocks the ability for you to be able to teleport to the resource dungeon.

Otherwise, players can reach the black demon room by entering the rift north of the Edgeville Monastery which leads to the gargoyles. From there players should head for the larger of the two mummy rooms which leads on into a Monk of Zamorak room, then head past the dust devils (be careful not to misclick and attack them without a facemask or slayer helmet), and finally to the black demon room.

Chaos Tunnels resource dungeon.summary: The teleports to the dungeon cannot be used if the player possesses a dwarf multicannon or its variants in their inventory, to prevent players from bypassing the no-cannon requirement to enter.

Chaos altar.title: Chaos altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A chaos talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A chaos tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A chaos talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a chaos altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the portal in the Tunnel of Chaos to get to the chaos altar without travelling through the Wilderness. It places the player at the third level. From there, the player should go east and then clockwise to the west ladder to reach the fourth level. After that, they should head east to reach the altar.

Chaos altar.summary: The players need a Runecrafting level of at least 35 to craft chaos runes. Crafting a chaos rune grants 8.5 Runecrafting experience. Using protean essence on it grants 100 experience per essence.

Charlie.title: Charlie
Charlie.summary: After Eagles' Peak is complete players can use a ferret on Charlie to offer him another, but he will refuse as taming one ferret is already enough trouble for him.

Charm sprite Hunter area.title: Charm sprite Hunter area
Charm sprite Hunter area.location: South of the Tree Gnome Stronghold

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Arctic, desert, jungle, or volcanic trapper outfit teleport to Yaktwee
• Traveller's necklace to teleport to the Outpost, which is south-east from the hunting area.
• Sixth-Age circuit to teleport to the World Gate and walk north-east (requires completion of The World Wakes, Ritual of the Mahjarrat, The Chosen Commander, The Void Stares Back, The Branches of Darkmeyer, The Firemaker's Curse and Fate of the Gods).
• Eagles' Peak lodestone and walk south-east to the hunter area. 
• Spirit tree teleport to Tree Gnome Stronghold and walk south out of the gate and south-west to the hunter area.
• Book of Char teleport, then walk south-east. (Requires completion of The Firemaker's Curse and only works once a day.)

Charm sprite Hunter area.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Charm Sprite Hunting | date=12 October 2010 
• Added to game.

Chasm of Tears.title: Chasm of Tears
Chasm of Tears.teleport:
• Games necklace
• Quest Cape
• Master quest cape

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Tips
• Wear a spiny helmet or slayer helmet for protection against the wall beasts and fumes.
• Carry the Seers headband or Bullseye lantern to prevent gases in the caves from exploding on you, causing heavy and rapid damage.

Ways to get there
• Use a charged Games necklace, Quest Cape, or Master quest cape to instantly teleport you to the cavern
• Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves in the western part of the swamp; you may need to attach a rope to climb into the caves, if you haven't done so already.
• Keep heading south-east from the cave entrance until you find a small stream, where you must use a stepping stone to cross over.
• If you fail the stepping stone shortcut and have a candle lantern, it will be smashed into a few broken glasses, even if it wasn't lit. On the other side are non-aggressive giant frogs, alongside another cave entrance.
• Go through it and you will find yourself in an area with a huge pit in front of you, with countless, shimmering light creatures flying over it.
• Walk along the east path to find Juna.
• If The Lost Tribe has been partially completed, to the part where you get the Brooch, you may go south from that spot and open a passage to the Lumbridge…

Chasm of Tears.summary: The cavern has an immense chasm in its centre. Light creatures can be seen flying about the chasm. To ride the light creatures, however, players must use lit Sapphire lanterns to attract the creatures, and then they have the option of going across to the magic stone ores or down into the chasm. Going down to the entrance of the Ancient Guthix Temple, the players may enter the temple during While Guthix Sleeps as part of the quest and afterwards seek to slay tormented demons.

Chicken Shrine.title: Chicken Shrine
Chicken Shrine.quest: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze
Chicken Shrine.summary: By offering a raw chicken to the shrine (a raw undead chicken won't work), players can travel to the Evil Chicken's Lair, home of the Evil Chicken at a certain point in Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze. The raw chicken is consumed when the player enters the lair. A normal chicken egg spawns in front of the shrine – not to be confused with the Evil chicken's egg for the Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze subquest.

Chief Tess.title: Chief Tess
Chief Tess.summary: According to most, she is the best hunter in Oo'glog. During As a First Resort, she will teach you how to hunt the creatures in the village. She also knows why the ogres are very protective of the platypodes but she will refuse to tell the player since they interrupt once too often.

Christmas Village.title: Christmas Village

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Christmas Village Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network.
• Christmas Village portal north of the Grand Exchange.
• Holiday portal in Tower of Voices.
• Using the teleport option of Christmas wrapping paper, letter to Santa, or town crier.
• Using the teleport option in the Calendar or event interfaces.

Christmas Village.summary: Every Sunday during a Christmas event, Santa Claus will arrive in the village at his lodge.

Chuck.title: Chuck
Chuck.summary: During Hunt for Red Raktuber, Larry is taken away forcibly to the motherland by Pescaling Pax. Pescaling then abandons the player on a deserted island. This is the island where the player first encounters Chuck, poorly disguised as a palm tree. After Chuck is spotted and told about his ineptitude at disguises, he remarks Hmmm... We may need to have a meeting about that. To escape the island, Chuck allows the player to ride on his belly to East Ardougne.

City of Um.title: City of Um
City of Um.teleport:
• City of Um Teleport
• City of Um lodestone
• Underworld Grimoire

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
To reach the City of Um use:
• Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.
• Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.
• Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
• City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.
• City of Um Teleport to teleport directly to the ritual site, which requires five spirit runes and completion of Rune Mythos.
• Underworld Grimoire offers a variety of teleports for completing corresponding tiers of the Underworld achievements:
• The Underworld Grimoire 1 has 10 daily teleports to the City of Um smithy.
• The Underworld Grimoire 2 adds unlimited teleports to the City of Um…

getting_there.heading: Other locations
getting_there.text:
Outside of the main district there is a number of other points of interest:

The dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple, used to craft the necrotic runes at level 24 Necromancy.

South of the main district and east of the docks is the graveyard, which is where the priestess Selene resides and is able to teach the adventurer necromancy prayers. The graveyard is full of shrines to honour the living; some City of Um residents light candles in these shrines to watch over their living loved ones as they wait for them to pass to the Underworld.

In the graveyard area there's also a troll cave where a variety of ghostly trolls can be killed. The cave also contains the entrance to Trollgrav.

There is a bakery owned by Dominique who sometimes is in town. They ask the player for a century egg, bonemeal, and curdled milk to create a deathday cake as part of a City of Um achievement.

The City of Um is located on Lake Mnemosyne. Players are able to rent boats or get a free boat tour from Ed to explore the lake or learn more about the City of Um. During a boat tour, it is revealed that the many shipwrecks surrounding Um among the jagged rocks in the lake were imagined into existence by…

City of Um.summary: While the city is only meant for the deceased, the living are able to visit Um under special circumstances. The player is the first human to visit Um after being taken there by Death, Malignius Mortifer was allowed to visit in order to help them train Necromancy, Frank additionally works as an administrator, and Philipe Carnillean was invited for educational purposes after Frank asked Death.

Clan Camp.title: Clan Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Luck of the Dwarves ring can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.
• Teleport to Varrock Lodestone and run north, turning northwest at Varrock Square.
• Players may run east from the Edgeville Lodestone, using the agility shortcut to enter the Grand Exchange (Requires 21 Agility)
• Use the teleport option of the clan flag located east of the Burthorpe lodestone
• A clan vexillum offers a direct teleport to the Clan Camp

Clan Camp.summary: Within the day of release on the 12th of April 2011, more than 250,000 players had pledged their allegiance to a clan using the Clan Camp. According to Jagex, there were over 33,000 new clans formed within the first 24 hours of release. After posting this information on their Facebook group, the number was changed from 33,000 to 47,000 15 minutes later.

Clock Tower.title: Clock Tower
Clock Tower.summary: Clock Tower is a quest that takes place in the Ardougne Clock Tower. The tower's mechanism has stopped working, and you are asked to retrieve its missing parts from the dungeons.

Clock Tower (building).title: Clock Tower (building)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The quickest way to get there is to use a Clocktower Teleport scroll. 

Other ways to get there include the Kandarin monastery Teleport, as well as using the spirit tree transportation system, and traveling to the Battlefield of Khazard, which teleports the player to slightly north-west of the tower, across a bridge.

Clock Tower (building).summary: The Clock Tower is a tower south of Ardougne. There are four floors, with the fourth one being the basement. During the quest of the same name, players have to find four cogs in different colour.

Clock Tower Dungeon.title: Clock Tower Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Map of entrances
getting_there.text: Map:Clock Tower surface

Clock Tower Dungeon.summary: The dungeon is divided into three zones. The zones look interconnected on the map, and even in the dungeon itself you can occasionally see from one zone into another through walls of iron bars. The zones, however, are completely separate. To pass between zones, the player must exit the dungeon and travel on the surface world to the entrance of the next zone.

Closure.title: Closure
Closure.summary: After thousands of years, Closure realised that the existence of all life itself would eventually end. He came to believe that after he finishes documenting the final person's story, finally fulfilling his promise, no one would remain to write his own, nor would there be anyone left to read it. He resigned himself to an endless, hopeless existence, forever alone.

Coal truck mine.title: Coal truck mine
Coal truck mine.location: North of the Fishing Guild, west of McGrubor's Wood

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring teleport to the Dwarven Outpost once the Dark Facet of Luck enchantment has been unlocked.
• Combat bracelet teleport option to 4. Ranging Guild then walk across the log balance (Agility shortcut, level 20 Agility required).
• Seers' Village lodestone to Seers' Village Key press | S then run west past McGrubor's Wood on the south side and Walk-across log balance (Agility shortcut, level 20 required).
• Ardougne lodestone to West Ardougne Key press | ALT + A then run north-west past the Fishing Guild

Coal truck mine.summary: The coal truck mine (also known as Dwarven Outpost) is located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood. There are 13 coal rocks and 2 Coal Trucks. However, it is rarely used as Gunnarsgrunn mine is more convenient. In addition, higher Mining level players may find concentrated coal deposit to be more efficient.

Combat Training Camp.title: Combat Training Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Traveller's necklace to the Outpost and run east.
• Home teleport to Ardougne and run west across either the Agility shortcut (requires 33 Agility) or across the wooden bridge next to the farm from the Meeting History quest. The continue to run west, keeping north of the West Ardougne wall.
• Use a Spirit tree to teleport to the Gnome Stronghold. Exit the stronghold through the southern gates and run east.

Combat Training Camp.summary: The ogres can also be attacked by magic and long-range melee weapons like halberds. Since the cage blocks the effect of Ava's accumulator or attractor when attacking from the outside, some rangers go inside and use a different ogre to stand in between them and their target to have Ava's devices retrieve their arrows or use other ranged weapons.

Commander Denulth.title: Commander Denulth
Commander Denulth.summary: He tells you that the most important thing you can do is fight off trolls. Speaking with him also reveals political tensions between the Imperial Guard and the White Knights.

Cook (Lumbridge).title: Cook (Lumbridge)
Cook (Lumbridge).summary: The Cook also has a brother who appeared in the 2008 Thanksgiving event and the 2009 Thanksgiving event. In addition, he has four children, a goat, and a wife who is easily seasick.

Cooking.title: Cooking
Cooking.summary: Generally a player who is gathering their raw items will cook their food items on a local campfire created through the Firemaking skill near where they are gathering, or take the items they have obtained to a range and cook there. Ranges (which provide a lower burn rate) can be easily located and are labelled on the map using this icon. ()

Cooking Guild.title: Cooks' Guild
Cooking Guild.summary: The guild is marked on the world map with a cookery shop icon (), a windmill icon (), a water source icon (), and a bank icon (), with a cooking range icon (), and a dairy churn icon () located on the floor 2.

Corporeal Beast's Lair.title: Corporeal Beast's Lair
Corporeal Beast's Lair.teleport:
Games necklace
Boss portal (Max Guild)
Boss portal (War's Retreat)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Via Gielinor surface
• By far the fastest way to reach the Corporeal Beast's Lair is teleporting directly to the boss via games necklace, boss portal (Max Guild) or boss portal (War's Retreat).
• The enlightened amulet or Carrallangar Teleport can be used to teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows, then walking north to the main entrance of the lair.
• Similarly any means of accessing the Wilderness Obelisk (obelisk shard, portable obelisk or manually) to teleport to the level 35 obelisk and running east or level 18 obelisk and running north.

Via Spirit Realm

Head to the eastern ruins in level 28 Wilderness and operate Jennica's ring on the weak portal to the Spirit Realm. Then go north to the entrance.

Map | mtype=pin | x=3232 | y=3736 | height=200 | width=200 | caption=Location of the weak portal

Corporeal Beast's Lair.summary: As the entrance to the lair is the Wilderness, players cannot enter the cave whilst in combat; however, players can safely reach the lair by teleporting using the games necklace, as the lair itself is not in the Wilderness.

Cosmic altar.title: Cosmic altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the cosmic rift in the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A cosmic talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A cosmic tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A cosmic talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a cosmic altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use any fairy ring or a portable fairy ring to teleport to Zanaris and go south to the ruins. There are jutting walls that can be traversed with level 46 or 66 Agility to get to the ruins faster.

Cosmic altar.summary: Players need a Runecrafting level of at least 27 to craft cosmic runes. Crafting cosmic runes grants 8 Runecrafting experience per pure essence used. Using protean essence on the altar grants 70 experience per essence.

Council of Burthorpe.title: Council of Burthorpe
Council of Burthorpe.summary: Once all the dignitaries arrived, she began with an impassioned plea to the council, begging them to set aside their differences and work towards the common goal of saving all life in the universe. She asked to first appease the elder goddess Bik, who was particularly fond of nature. Her idea of a grand garden on Gielinor, free from civilisation and godly interference was shot down multiple times, due to different factions refusing to cooperate.

Councillor Halgrive.title: Councillor Halgrive
Councillor Halgrive.summary: He can be seen alongside other residents of East Ardougne in a mansion during the quest Rat Catchers.

Crafting Guild.title: Crafting Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are several methods of reaching the Crafting Guild. In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
• A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
• Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
• Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
• Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.

getting_there.heading: Useful nearby locations
getting_there.text: While the guild itself does not stock sheep, there is a handy flock wandering free immediately to the north, just outside the Makeover Mage's house.

getting_there.heading: Bank access
getting_there.text: All players can use the bank deposit box in the guild itself. This turns into a bank chest upon the completion of the hard Falador achievements. Players retain access to the bank chest even after their membership expires.

Crafting Guild.summary:
• A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
• Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
• Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
• Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.

Crandor.title: Crandor

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Partial completion of Dragon Slayer is required to access Crandor.
• Crandor can be accessed via a secret passage in Elvarg's lair. This passage must be unlocked from the Crandorian side before using.
• Sail from Port Sarim to Crandor on the Lady Lumbridge. This is only available if the player has not unlocked the secret passage.

Crandor.summary:
• Crandor can be accessed via a secret passage in Elvarg's lair. This passage must be unlocked from the Crandorian side before using.
• Sail from Port Sarim to Crandor on the Lady Lumbridge. This is only available if the player has not unlocked the secret passage.

Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.title: Elvarg's lair
Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (24 June 2010) | date=24 June 2010 
• Removed some blocking from the dungeon under Karamja’s volcano.

Crash Island.title: Crash Island

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are two ways to get to Crash Island:
• Waydar in Tree Gnome Stronghold's secret hangar will take you there:
• Talk to Daero on the floor 2 of the Grand Tree, near Blurberry's bar. He will blindfold you and take you to an underground hangar where you will find Waydar, who will fly you to Crash Island.
• Lumdo via Ape Atoll (Ape Atoll Teleport)

Lumdo and Waydar remain on the island after the quest, and they can transport the player to Ape Atoll and Tree Gnome Stronghold, respectively.

Crash Island.summary: All attackable NPCs on this island are aggressive, poisonous, and lack drops. As such, it is an unpopular place to train.

Croesus Front.title: Croesus Front
Croesus Front.teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Croesus Front is located in the eastern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through the eastern cathedral door. Passing through the eastern door for the first time will trigger a cutscene.

Travel methods include:
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Croesus) or the boss portal in the Max Guild (doesn't require a kill) can be attuned to teleport the…

Croesus Front.summary: The Croesus Front features the third assault on the cathedral in Senntisten, where united forces of young gods keep the eggs of the Elder Gods from hatching and destroying Gielinor in the process. The attack to the east of the cathedral is led by Croesus, the game's first skilling boss, revived by Bik after being buried beneath the city's graveyard since the Second Age. The fungal spread has killed most of the forces on this front, with Gorvek leading the defence.

Crypt (Wilderness).title: Crypt (Wilderness)
Crypt (Wilderness).location: South-east Wilderness and north of Fort Forinthry
Crypt (Wilderness).summary: Players enter into the dungeon in the eastern part of the crypt, through the Wilderness Crypt Entrance. The crypt contains eight risen ghosts in the eastern segment, requiring level 85 Slayer, and six armoured phantoms in the western segment, requiring level 113 Slayer. Fetid zombies and bound skeletons roam outside the crypt entrance, and have no Slayer requirement.

Cyclosis.title: Cyclosis

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can unlock the ability to travel to Cyclosis by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals and has completed the Cyclosis voyage within the player-owned port.
• Cyclosis teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to the merchant district of Cyclosis. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes.

Cyclosis.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (31 October 2016) | date=31 October 2016 
• Each ox on Cyclosis is now correctly referred to in the singular.

Cyrisus.title: Cyrisus
Cyrisus.summary: Cyrisus became level 99 in all melee skills while being terrified of combat. It was revealed in the Postbag from the Hedge in August 2007 that he got his high combat level by doing nothing but killing 300 chickens a day for 30 years, which actually does come out to around the experience needed for the melee skills (over 39 million experience), with burying the bones adding up to the experience needed for 99 Prayer.

Daemonheim.title: Daemonheim
Daemonheim.teleport:
• Ring of kinship
• Tower of Voices

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
• Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
• Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.
• Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
• Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
• War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

Daemonheim.summary: Most of Daemonheim's history is told through the Chronicles of Bilrach, which are discovered as a player trains the Dungeoneering skill. Currently, an army of Fremenniks have set up a campsite in the area to prepare for their next expedition into the enormous labyrinths below the castle.

Daffyd.title: Daffyd
Daffyd.summary: Level 95 Hunter and completion of the Rocking Out quest are required to fully complete his challenge. Implings in jars obtained from the Grand Exchange or from other players will not count towards his list. Impling jars received from the Motherlode Maw do count as having caught that type of impling for the checklist. If a player receives a type of impling that counts towards Daffyd's list from the Maw they will be notified with the message "Daffyd has been notified of the impling you…

Dagannoth (Waterbirth Island, ranged).title: Dagannoth

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Dagannoth (Waterbirth Island, ranged).summary: Dagannoth are monsters that live in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon and the Chaos Tunnels. There are two types of dagannoth: those who use melee and those who use ranged, also differing in appearance and examine text. Furthermore, both types of dagannoth are separated into level 78 and 79 versions. Dagannoth are extremely weak to Balmung and its enhanced counterparts, but may nevertheless be fought with other weapons.

Dagannoth guardian dungeon.title: Dagannoth guardian dungeon
Dagannoth guardian dungeon.teleport:
• Enchanted lyre
• Tele-group Waterbirth
• Waterbirth Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players may teleport to the island using the the Waterbirth Teleport or Tele-group Waterbirth spells.
• Using enchanted lyre to teleport to the Waterbirth Island.
• Jarvald at the Western most dock in Rellekka can sail the player to the Waterbirth Island.

Dagon'hai Monk.title: Dagon'hai Monk

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Dagon'hai Monk.summary: Dagon'hai Monks are members of the Dagon'hai found in the Chaos Tunnels. The monks can be found by entering the Chaos Tunnels via the entrance near the Mage of Zamorak, and then using the south portal.

Dagon'hai monk.title: Dagon'hai Monk

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Dagon'hai monk.summary: Dagon'hai Monks are members of the Dagon'hai found in the Chaos Tunnels. The monks can be found by entering the Chaos Tunnels via the entrance near the Mage of Zamorak, and then using the south portal.

Dancing Donkey Inn.title: Dancing Donkey Inn
Dancing Donkey Inn.summary: Several non-player characters inside play a role in several quests. Chancy, Hops, and Da Vinci are involved in the Biohazard quest. During the subquest Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Fortunes, Relomia can also be found there.

Dark Warriors' Fortress.title: Dark Warriors' Fortress

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Enter the Wilderness from the wall north of the Goblin Village and run north until you reach the bridge over the moat.
• Enter the Wilderness from the wall north of the Edgeville Monastery and run north until you reach the southern portion of the moat that surrounds the fortress. Then run west and then north until you reach the bridge that allows access.
• The fastest route is to exit the Chaos altar via the portal next to the rune altar. 
• Players may also opt to use the Ancient Obelisk or a portable obelisk to teleport to the location north of the Bandit Camp (level 27 Wilderness) and run south. Caution: the NPCs in the Bandit Camp are aggressive to any player that is not skulled.
• Dareeyak Teleport from the Ancient spellbook teleports the player to the ruins north-west of the fortress.

Dark Warriors' Fortress.summary: The Dark Warriors' Fortress, formerly called the Dark Knight Fortress, is a castle in levels 19, 20, and 21 of the Wilderness. It is populated with level 32 skeletons, who were formerly dark warriors.

Dark Wizards' Tower.title: Dark Wizards' Tower

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Taverley lodestone and run south past the Witch's House.
• Teleport to the Falador lodestone (or cast Falador Teleport with level 37 Magic) and climb over the crumbling wall next to the western bank (requires level 5 Agility).
• A free, one-way teleport to this tower exists on the second floor of the Wizards' Guild. The south portal on that floor goes to the Dark Wizards' Tower. A player must have level 66 Magic to enter the Wizards' Guild. Please note that once you enter the portal, it will not be able to send you back.

Dark Wizards' Tower.summary: There is a flock of 10 black sheep immediately south of the tower.

Darkmeyer.title: Darkmeyer

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Darkmeyer is hard to reach and one is required to wear the full Darkmeyer disguise to not be caught and thrown out, or the House Drakan outfit, acquired part way through The Lord of Vampyrium. 
• Climb into a hole in the very north-east of Meiyerditch. 
• Drakan's medallion teleport to the Arboretum after Vanescula Drakan enchants it during The Branches of Darkmeyer.

Darkmeyer.summary:
• Climb into a hole in the very north-east of Meiyerditch. 
• Drakan's medallion teleport to the Arboretum after Vanescula Drakan enchants it during The Branches of Darkmeyer.

Darren Lightfinger.title: Darren Lightfinger
Darren Lightfinger.summary: He is rather charismatic and dramatic, prone to giving big and speeches to inspire his followers. Despite his grandeur, the Guild itself has been in operation a mere fortnight, attracting a total of three members, including himself. He describes himself as a scofflaw, thief and brigand, proudly boasting of his rebellion against what he claims are oppressive forces. However, he was unable to convince Ozan, a fellow master thief, to join, which he considers a missed opportunity.

Dead Man's Chest.title: Dead Man's Chest
Dead Man's Chest.summary: Dead Man's Chest is featured in the Bar Crawl miniquest, which can be started at the Barbarian Outpost by talking to one of the barbarian guards near the outer entrance to the agility course.

Death.title: Death
Death.summary: He also acts as a "Death Tutor" when players die for the first time and explains death, item losses, and gravestones. In his office, players may select his "Death event" option to change the animation shown when they die.

Death Plateau (location).title: Death Plateau (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: To reach the plateau itself (where the trolls are located), follow the main path up the plateau. Due to a large amount of Thrower trolls guarding this route it is recommended to use Protect from Ranged. Alternatively, if you do not have access to this prayer, you can use a Fremennik Round Shield to lower damage to about 10-20 life points.

Death Plateau (location).summary: In the Death Plateau quest, a safe passage into the troll lands is found within Sabbot's cave, which is basically an agility dungeon leading to the cave entrance north of the thrower trolls.

Death Rune Temple.title: Death Rune Temple
Death Rune Temple.teleport:
• Abyss
• Wicked hood
• Death altar teleport
• Tirannwn quiver 3 or 4

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the death ruins to the temple with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A death talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A death tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A death talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a death altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• The Tirannwn quiver 3 or 4 can teleport to the ruins 5 times a day.

Travelling from the Temple of Light

Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light and using the following directions.
# Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
# Go south and up the ladder.
# Go to the centre of the temple.
# Climb down the next stairs twice.
# Rotate the mirror to open the light door.
Note: When leaving, remember to rotate the mirror again for future visits.

getting_there.heading: Travelling from the Temple of Light
getting_there.text:
Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light and using the following directions.
# Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
# Go south and up the ladder.
# Go to the centre of the temple.
# Climb down the next stairs twice.
# Rotate the mirror to open the light door.
Note: When leaving, remember to rotate the mirror again for future visits.

Death Rune Temple.summary:
Players could enter the death ruins to the temple with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A death talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A death tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A death talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Death's office.title: Death's office

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• When players die outside of the Wilderness, they will be transported here.
• Teleport to the Draynor lodestone, then run north and interact with the green Death's Hourglass to the left of the mirror-like Underworld portal.
• Teleport to War's Retreat using War's Retreat Teleport then exit through the floor portal to Death's office.

Death's office.summary: The office is part of Death's mansion, appears to be on an island suspended by chains in a void, and is decorated by murals depicting Harold becoming Death. Although it is part of his mansion, due to magic, the rest of the mansion cannot be seen, although a door can be seen leading to it. As its name would imply, Death himself can be found sitting at his desk inside the centre of the office. His pet skeletal hellhound Muncher can be found sleeping in a basket in the corner behind him.

Deep Wilderness Dungeon.title: Deep Wilderness Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Mandrith, then run south.
• Wilderness sword 4 to the Wilderness Agility Course, then run east.
• Ghorrock Teleport to the Ice Plateau and run north through the gate and then east past the Wilderness Agility Course.
• Players may teleport to Deserted Keep east of the Mage Arena using the lever west of the Ardougne Castle or the one-way lever in the Edgeville Mausoleum. After cutting the web blocking the exit from Deserted Keep, run west past the Mage Arena.

Deep Wilderness Dungeon.summary: The dungeon can only be traversed in a clockwise direction, as at the end of the dungeon there is a dead end. There are gates separating each monster. The dungeon is populated by gemstone dragons.

Demonic Ruins.title: Demonic Ruins

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to get here is to use the Annakarl Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook.
• Use an Obelisk (Wilderness) to teleport to the obelisk located near the Rogues' Castle in level 50 Wilderness, then run south east through the gate and continue west. Those with a Wilderness sword 3 or better may choose to be teleported to this obelisk directly. Otherwise, teleports are random and it may take several tries to reach this specific obelisk.
• An alternative is to teleport using a boss portal or the chest found at any of the elite dungeon locations to the Dragonkin Laboratory and then walk out from there, this also provides quick banking in a safe area by Edward, but this area cannot be re-entered if in combat.

Demonic Ruins.summary: The Demonic Ruins are the remains of Annakarl, located deep in the Wilderness. The Ruins are inhabited by greater demons and several burnt bone spawns. In members' worlds, Kal'gerion demons and a lone blood rune spawn are present. A large horde of Ripper Demons are also present west of the ruins, and to the east a large number of Greater demon berserkers and Greater demon ash lords.

Denulth.title: Commander Denulth
Denulth.summary: He tells you that the most important thing you can do is fight off trolls. Speaking with him also reveals political tensions between the Imperial Guard and the White Knights.

Deryn.title: Deryn
Deryn.summary: After the quest, she can be spoken to again to track down owls for the Birds of Prey achievement.

Desert Mining Camp.title: Desert Mining Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
You can reach the camp by walking directly south from Shantay Pass.
Alternative routes to the camp include:
• Teleporting to the Bandit Camp lodestone and then walking northeast.
• Teleporting to Pollnivneach using a Slayer ring or Slayer cape (to Sumona), House Teleport (if the player's house is in Pollnivneach), a Pollnivneach tablet, or a Pollnivneach Teleport, and then walking west to the camp.
• Using fairy ring code BIQ to teleport to the Kalphite Hive and then walking southeast.

When travelling the desert to the camp, players are advised to bring a water source, or special items such as the Tome of Frost, to avoid the effects of desert heat. Once inside the camp (including the underground mines), water is not needed.

A gate and troop of mercenaries bar the entrance to the camp. To enter, you need to have the metal key, which is obtained in Tourist Trap by fighting the Mercenary Captain.

Desert Mining Camp.summary: Inside the camp is a camel cart, a winch, the entrance to the underground mines, and a building that is the headquarters of Captain Siad. Siad's office has a chest and bookcases. If you search the table Siad is sitting at, you find a cell door key, which opens the door to the prison cell on the floor 1. Guards will throw players in the jail if they are wearing equipment (except weapon or ammo). If you are thrown in the cell and do not have the key, you can still escape by bending the bars on…

Desert Mining Camp cave.title: Desert Mining Camp cave
Desert Mining Camp cave.summary: More guards, female slaves, and male slaves are found throughout the mines. A Rowdy slave appear in two places and will attack you if you attempt to talk to them. If you kill a rowdy slave, he drops a slave shirt, a slave robe, and slave boots. However, these are not needed to enter any part of the mine after The Tourist Trap is completed.

Desert Quarry.title: Desert Quarry
Desert Quarry.location: South of the Kharidian Bandit Camp
Desert Quarry.teleport:
• Bandit Camp lodestone
• Camulet
• Pharaoh's sceptre
• Sceptre of the gods

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Bandit Camp lodestone is a quick and free teleport, available after completing Desert Treasure. The quarry is a short run south west of the lodestone.
• After completing Enakhra's Lament, players can use the Camulet to teleport to Enakhra's Temple, which is very near the quarry. The temple's western exit is perhaps the most convenient for granite mining. The Camulet is by a wide margin the quickest way to get to the quarry.
• Players can use a Bandit Camp teleport scroll to teleport to the centre of the Bandit Camp and walk south to the quarry.
• Players can use a Pharaoh's sceptre to teleport to Jaldraocht and walk west to the quarry.
• Players can use Magic carpets to fly to the Bedabin Camp, Pollnivneach, or Menaphos and then walk to the quarry.
• Players with sufficient Slayer ability to have ring of slaying can teleport to Pollnivneach and then walk to the quarry.
• The broomstick (after completing Swept Away) is useful should players choose to bank their granite.

Desert Quarry.summary: Desert heat can affect players in the quarry. Players can counter this by bringing either waterskins or an enchanted water tiara. After Crocodile Tears, the effect of desert heat is removed. Alternatively, using a regen bracelet and desert robes will slow the player's health loss. Enakhra's Lament quest allows access to the fountain featured during the quest, which can be used to refill waterskins. If the player has no other way to cope with the desert heat, it's recommended to bring at least…

Deserted Keep.title: Deserted Keep
Deserted Keep.summary: There are levers in East Ardougne and Edgeville that, when pulled, teleport the players to the Deserted Keep. Likewise, there is a lever in the Deserted Keep that will teleport members to East Ardougne and free-to-play players to Edgeville. If you exit the keep to the right, beware of the Chaos Elemental, and keep an eye out for player killers whichever direction you go, if opted into PvP.

Deserted Mine.title: Deserted Mine

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the canoe station to [Chat: 3 Wendlewick (Grotto)] and then head east.
• Use Fairy ring BKS and run south-east.

Deserted Mine.summary: It contains the Wendlewick Deserted Mine, which has clay and uncommon gem rocks. Giant crayfish fishing spots are found to the north and big net and harpoon fishing spots are located to the south. The Deserted Mine is occupied by both attackable and non-attackable goblins, including Mossbrain, Weakback, Snakearms, Maggotscratch, Frogtongue, Tiptup, and Barkfoot. Kaleb's travel journal - volume I can be found here.

Diango.title: Diango
Diango.summary: Ianto in Prifddinas and Azibo in Menaphos serve the same functions as Diango in Draynor Village.

Diary (Shades of Mort'ton).title: Diary (Shades of Mort'ton)
Diary (Shades of Mort'ton).summary: It can also be found in the bookcase in the player-owned house or on the same shelf of the same Mort'ton house during the Temple Trekking shades event. However, taking part in the Temple Trekking event is not needed to obtain this book. If the player runs north from Burgh de Rott after hopping over the gate, it can be found on the shelf in the first ruined house with vials on the floor.

Dimintheis.title: Dimintheis
Dimintheis.location: South of the Varrock east entrance, beside the fancy dress shop
Dimintheis.summary: He appears on the Varrock Census taken in Year 160, Fifth Age, with his occupation listed as "Former Noble".

Dodgy Mike's Second-hand Clothing.title: Dodgy Mike's Second-hand Clothing
Dodgy Mike's Second-hand Clothing.summary: Players need to have a book o' piracy when trying to trade with Mike, unless they have completed Rocking Out.

Dominion Tower.title: Dominion Tower

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Map | mtype=square | 3374,3108 | r=11 | align=right | caption=Location of the tower 
• Use a Dominion medallion or Super dominion medallion to teleport there. This requires a minimum of being able to compete in the Dominion Tower (at least 20 of the 38 quests completed); if able to compete in the Dominion Tower, one can obtain the medallion on a previous trip to the tower. Both versions of the medallion allows a maximum of three teleports per day to the tower.
• If the player's player-owned house is located in the Menaphos Port district or if by using a Menaphos tablet (requires the Love Story quest), players can teleport to Port district's dock, use right-click "Travel" option on Portmaster Kags and choose Dominion Tower, this is one of the quickest ways to get to Dominion Tower. Using the teleport option on a Slayer codex with at least 50 souls added also gets you within a few steps of the Portmaster. 
• Go through the Shantay Pass, run East-South-East to the River Elid, cross the bridge and go slightly North to reach the tower. The quickest transport to the Pass is by using a broomstick, or a charged Amulet of glory.
• Use the Eagle transport system (requires completing the…

Dominion Tower.summary: The Dominion Tower houses a minigame which gives players the opportunity to re-fight various bosses from 60 quests plus a non-quest Dominion Tower boss - Sunfreet. It is located in the northern Kharidian Desert, near the source of the River Elid. The minigame gives rewards including combat experience, new consumable items, and dominion glove sets. In general players use the tower for prestige or to gain its non-tradeable rewards rather than to make money. The history of the Tower is revealed in…

Dondakan the Dwarf.title: Dondakan the Dwarf
Dondakan the Dwarf.summary: Dondakan has tried many different methods to break the rock, such hitting it with a pickaxe, shooting it with several types of cannonballs (with a cannon obtained from his son), and kicking it with granite boots. None have been successful, and the cost has taken a toll on him.

Dorgesh-Kaan.title: Dorgesh-Kaan

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are multiple ways of accessing Dorgesh-Kaan.
• Players may enter the crack in the eastern wall of the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, through which Kazgar waits to lead players through the Dorgesh-Kaan mine. The entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan is just to the south-east of where Kazgar leaves the player. To follow Kazgar through the mines, the player is required to bring a light source.
• The city can be accessed from the Kalphite Hive through the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon to the south of the city, although a light source is required.
• There is a fairy ring in the dungeon to the south with the code AJQ. This may only be used if players have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen up to the point where the fairy ring network is unlocked. A light source is needed in the dungeon. To exit from the dungeon to the city, go east of the ring, then go north, west and again to north until a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the Dorgesh-Kaan course, and climb down the stairs to the north to reach the southern part of the city.
• The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system may be used to travel to Dorgesh-Kaan from Keldagrim by rail (after Another Slice of H.A.M.), and vice versa. The tickets are free;…

Dorgesh-Kaan.summary: Below the agility course is a large dungeon, the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon. It has a unique Slayer monster called a Molanisk, as well as other beasts such as cave slime, giant frogs, and both large and small varieties of cave bugs.

Dorgesh-Kaan mine.title: Dorgesh-Kaan mine
Dorgesh-Kaan mine.summary: It is possible to enter the mine from Dorgesh-Kaan without a light source. It is even possible to navigate in the mine after doing this by using the darkened image provided. However, players attempting to do this will find themselves swarmed by cave insects that will damage them slowly but regularly (constant 10s, and these hits cannot be blocked by any form of defence, including prayers) until they either light a light source, leave the mine, or die.

Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system.title: Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system
Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system.summary: The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim Train System is a railway link created between the cave goblin city of Dorgesh-Kaan and dwarven capital Keldagrim before and during the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest. It is accessible after the quest is complete.

Dorgeshuun Mines.title: Dorgesh-Kaan mine
Dorgeshuun Mines.summary: It is possible to enter the mine from Dorgesh-Kaan without a light source. It is even possible to navigate in the mine after doing this by using the darkened image provided. However, players attempting to do this will find themselves swarmed by cave insects that will damage them slowly but regularly (constant 10s, and these hits cannot be blocked by any form of defence, including prayers) until they either light a light source, leave the mine, or die.

Dorgeshuun mine.title: Dorgesh-Kaan mine
