However, players attempting to do this will find themselves swarmed by cave insects that will damage them slowly but regularly (constant 10s, and these hits cannot be blocked by any form of defence, including prayers) until they either light a light source, leave the mine, or die.

Doric.title: Doric
Doric.quest: Devious Minds, What's Mine is Yours

getting_there.heading: Early life and relocation
getting_there.text:
Doric was born in the dwarven capital city of Keldagrim some time before humans knew of its existence. Like most dwarves, he was raised a follower of Guthix, although the religion was not actively practiced.

Doric trained to become exceptionally skilled in hand-to-hand combat, his preferred weapon being a battleaxe, although he would use smaller throwing axes as well. At some point, he had a son named Boric, whom he raised by himself after his wife left them while Boric was still young.

Although this placed him near the Ice Mountain Dwarven Colony and the Dwarven Mine, Doric usually avoided contact with his nearby kinsmen. Doric constructed a log cabin south of the Goblin Village, and became largely self-sufficient. To keep himself supplied, Doric raised a number of mountain goats, although he was occasionally forced to trade with nearby settlements and farmers.

Kinshra raids, such as those led by Commander Sulla in 155, tended to focus on more easterly settlements, and the threat of the Kinshra was never cause for extreme worry on Doric's part. As the years progressed, however, small settlements and farms tended to move further west, crowding Doric and causing him to become…

Doric.summary: There is a known bug that the stairs in Doric's hut that lead to Doric's cave may not appear. If the stairs do not appear, try switching textures off and on again to forcefully reload the assets in the area.

Doric's hut.title: Doric's hut
Doric's hut.summary: There is a known bug that the stairs in Doric's hut that lead to Doric's cave may not appear. If the stairs do not appear, try switching textures off and on again to forcefully reload the assets in the area.

Dororan.title: Dororan
Dororan.summary: During his attempt to woo Gudrun, he enlists the help of a passing adventurer to help him by obtaining and delivering an engraved ring to Gudrun. When he learns of her father's attitude, he attempts to come up with a poem to convince Gunthor to change his views. However, he struggles and relies on the adventurer to help him write the poem then convince Gudrun to read it. Upon hearing the poem, Gunthor laughs, declaring the village a settlement and making Dororan the village's poet. They move…

Dr Fenkenstrain.title: Dr Fenkenstrain

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Dr Fenkenstrain.summary: During and after The Great Brain Robbery, Dr Fenkenstrain will appear in Windmill cellar instead of Fenkenstrain's Castle.

Dragonkin Laboratory.title: Dragonkin Laboratory
Dragonkin Laboratory.teleport:
• Dragonkin Laboratory teleport
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)
• Treasure chest (Elite Dungeons)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use a Dragonkin Laboratory teleport, which can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
• Walk east of the Demonic Ruins to the peninsula north of Daemonheim (requires travelling through the Wilderness).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, or the Dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Daemonheim Peninsula Island. From there, run east down the mountain to the treasure chest located by the Fremennik ship. Use the teleport option on the chest and select Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
• Use the Grouping System to teleport.

Dragonkin Laboratory.summary: The Dragonkin Laboratory is the second Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and tokens, located in the Deep Wilderness Castle Ruins. Players may use the grouping system in order to attempt a raid in a team of 2-3.

Dragonkin Lair.title: Dragonkin Lair
Dragonkin Lair.summary: After the completion of Hero's Welcome, players can find three adamant dragons in the dungeon, which drop Sakirth's, Strisath's and Kalibath's journal, as well as Phalaks' experiment log. Adamant dragons in the adamant dragon dungeon also drop these journals.

Dragontooth Island.title: Dragontooth Island
Dragontooth Island.teleport:
• Big Book o' Piracy
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Elder divination outfit
• Hoardstalker ring
• Skill portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Charter a ship to Port Phasmatys, or teleport using ectophial, then speak with the ghost captain standing next to a small row boat at the southern end of the docks. Ghostspeak amulet or completion of the hard Morytania achievements required. The Ghosts Ahoy quest does not have to be started for him to take the player there, but it is required for the ectophial.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Dragontooth Island resource dungeon located on the island. [Chat: 0 More... › 3 Dragontooth celestial dragon dungeon]
• Skill portal in the Max Guild tuned to the radiant wisp colony located on the island.
• Big Book o' Piracy teleport directly to the island (requires completion of Pieces of Hate).
• Elder divination outfit can teleport its owner to the wisp colony three times each day.

Dragontooth Island.summary: During the Rocking Out quest, the idol of many heads is recovered from the Dragontooth Shipwreck accessed via the chain at the northern beach.

Dragontooth Island resource dungeon.title: Dragontooth Island resource dungeon
Dragontooth Island resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Dragontooth Island resource dungeon.summary: The Dragontooth Island resource dungeon is on the southeastern side of Dragontooth Island. It is unlocked during the One of a Kind quest after speaking with the Queen Black Dragon, which requires 67 Dungeoneering. Players can travel to the island for free by speaking to the ghost captain (with a Ghostspeak amulet equipped or hard Morytania achievements complete) at the Port Phasmatys docks. You can also use a hoardstalker ring or Dungeoneering cape to travel there. This resource dungeon is one…

Dragontooth Shipwreck.title: Dragontooth Shipwreck

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• At Port Phasmatys, talk to the Ghost captain with a small boat, at the docks. The ghost will take the player to the Dragontooth Island.
• At the island, travel northeast and locate a chain. This chain can be used to dive underwater to the shipwreck.
• Players should wear the diving apparatus and fishbowl helmet, and dive down using the chain.

Dragontooth Shipwreck.summary: The Dragontooth shipwreck is accessed during the quest Rocking Out by using a chain on Dragontooth Island. This area is inaccessible after the quest has been completed.

Draynor.title: Draynor Village
Draynor.teleport:
• Amulet of glory
• Draynor lodestone
• Explorer's ring (north-west of Draynor)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport using an amulet of glory to the Draynor Market.
• Home Teleport to Draynor lodestone just north of the village (near the portal to Death's office).
• Use War's Retreat Teleport and immediately exit via the ground portal to the north of the village. 
• Use an explorer's ring 3 to teleport to the Falador cabbage patch and then run south then east through the stone wall and then south will teleport to the Draynor Market.
• The master archaeologist's outfit hat's teleport function (collectors menu) to the Wise Old Man.

Draynor.summary: Draynor Bank.png | The Draynor Village bank entrance.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Draynor lodestone teleport. Run north into the manor grounds.
• War's Retreat Teleport. Exit the portal to Draynor and run north.

Draynor Manor.summary: In the south-west corner of the property is a fountain, which is a plot device in the Ernest the Chicken quest. Directly to the west of the manor is a compost heap (also a plot device involved in Ernest the Chicken), and a patch of special cabbages. These cabbages are unique in that they boost Defence 1 to 2 levels temporarily. During the course of the Black Knights' Fortress quest, these cabbages are referenced by the witch brewing the "doomsday potion" (incidentally, one cannot use a cabbage…

Draynor bank.title: Draynor bank
Draynor bank.summary: There is a bank deposit box inside the building.

Draynor jail.title: Draynor jail
Draynor jail.summary: Within the jail compound are a few nettles growing on the eastern and southern sides of the building, which can be picked when wearing some form of gloves. Just west of the jail building, a second trapdoor entrance to the Draynor Sewers can also be found. There is an inaccessible guard tower found on the southern side. Osman's daughter, Leela, can be found north-west just beyond the compound by the wheat field.

Draynor lodestone.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (21 May 2018) | date=21 May 2018

Drezel.title: Drezel
Drezel.quest: Priest in Peril, Nature Spirit, In Aid of the Myreque, The Darkness of Hallowvale, Legacy of Seergaze, The Lord of Vampyrium, River of Blood
Drezel.summary: Drezel is generally helpful and friendly, but can get defensive about his religion, and on more than one occasion during players' escapades involving the Myreque, he is integral to the storyline and very helpful to the player. In behind the scenes it has been said that "Drezel could shed some light into Morytania's gloomy past". He also briefly housed Ivan Strom, a young member of the Myreque who joined Drezel's order of Monks as he was, in Veliaf Hurtz's eyes, too young to see the horror and…

Dwarven Mine.title: Dwarven mines

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador to Gunnarsgrunn road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance.
• Falador entrance: A building in the far northeast of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
• South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required.
• Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim minecart system to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim, it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the quest Fishing Contest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain. Also, the train station in Keldagrim is next to the carts and thus allows access from Dorgesh-Kaan, provided that the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest has been completed.
• After completing the Perils of Ice Mountain quest, a…

Dwarven Mine.summary: Players with level 60 Mining or higher may access the Mining Guild through the door in the southernmost part of the mine. Near the entrance are scorpions and king scorpions, aggressive if players have a combat level below 45.

Dwarven Mine resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Dwarven Mine resource dungeon.summary: An extension to the resource dungeon was added with the release of the Daemonheim achievements. It is accessible only to those who have completed the hard Daemonheim achievements. The extended area contains 4 phasmatite rocks.

Dwarven Tunnel.title: Dwarven Tunnel
Dwarven Tunnel.summary: There is a bar in the tunnel, as well as Holoy's Crossbow Shop. Gnome Glider Captain Ninto, Rohak and Khorvak may also be found here.

Eadgar's cave.title: Eadgar's cave
Eadgar's cave.summary: The player may find Eadgar inside to proceed the quest Eadgar's Ruse, after the player rescuing Eadgar after the quest Troll Stronghold.

Eagles' Peak.title: Eagles' Peak
Eagles' Peak.summary: Eagles' Peak is a quest based on the Hunter skill, where the player helps the Ardougne Zoo procure a ferret as a new attraction. Rewards for the quest includes a new way to train the Hunter skill and a new form of transportation.

Eagles' Peak (location).title: Eagles' Peak (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The quickest route to the entrance is using the Eagles' Peak lodestone.
• Players with access to the Fairy ring network can teleport to the Piscatoris Hunter area using the code AKQ then head south using Kathy Corkat's row boat.
• Use a traveller's necklace to teleport to the south of the Desert Eagles' Eyrie, run north into the cave, grab a rope from the spawn there, and use it on a desert eagle to fly and arrive inside the south-east corner of Eagles' Peak cave next to the desert, jungle, polar, and Karamjan Jungle eagles.
• Additionally, players can teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone, run a short distance north past the Hunting expert, climb the tall vine, grab a rope from the rope rack, and use the rope on a jungle eagle to fly into the inside of Eagle's Peak cave. 
• The vine needs to be grown beforehand for it to remain indefinitely, see: Eagle transport system.
• Players can also use memory strands to teleport to the Memorial to Guthix and run south.

getting_there.heading: Woodcutting locations
getting_there.text:
The woodland surrounding Eagles' Peak is crowded with standard trees and oaks. Most desirable to those training Woodcutting, though, are the many yew trees that border the undergrowth on the north and eastern sides.

Players can use the bank in the Memorial to Guthix, or those that have completed Swan Song can deposit any cut logs in the bank far to the north, in the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. By speaking to Kathy Corkat, the boatwoman near the stream to the east, players can travel to the Colony's entrance free of charge. A Summoning obelisk can also be found near the Colony for those using summoning familiars to aid while woodcutting.

The closest bank for those not finished with Swan Song is in the southern Tree Gnome Stronghold. The walk to the bank is somewhat long, though, making this method far less popular than the one stated above.

Eagles' Peak (location).summary: Because it is fairly far from any civilisation but the gnomes', Eagles' Peak has long been a popular destination for naturalists and researchers. At the same time, though, the subterranean caves that sprawl beneath it have made it the home of thieves and others fleeing the law of Kandarin.

East Ardougne.title: East Ardougne

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Ardougne lodestone is located just north of the city, directly southwest of Manor Farm.
• The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the player to the centre of Ardougne market, requiring completion of the Plague City quest.
• The Ardougne cloak 1 can be used to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, just south of the city.
• Once per day, the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm, just north of the city.
• The Ardougne cloak 4 provides unlimited teleports to Manor Farm.
• A spirit tree is located on the Battlefield south of West Ardougne, requiring completion of the Tree Gnome Village quest.
• A lever in the Deserted Keep in level 51 Wilderness teleports the player to the Ardougne teleport lever, near the gates to West Ardougne, and vice versa. The lever can be accessed by teleporting to the Keep from Edgeville, although doing so will momentarily put the player in deep wilderness.
• There is a ship that will take the player to Ardougne from Brimhaven for the low price of 30 coins. The ship takes you to the south eastern docks near Captain Barnaby. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will…

East Ardougne.summary: Horacio the gardener, is involved in Back to my Roots quest and will take care of player's Jade vine patch unlocked at the end of the quest.

East Ardougne church.title: East Ardougne church
East Ardougne church.summary: The Sheep Herder quest can be started here by speaking to Councillor Halgrive. Doctor Orbon rewards those who completed the Easy Ardougne achievements with the Ardougne cloak 1.

Easter Bunny.title: Easter Bunny
Easter Bunny.summary: Suspicious of Sliske's motives, he tells the player how to get rid of the other tourists without arousing suspicion on themselves. When they reach the T.A.R.A. room, the Easter Bunny is surprised that he never thought of a chocolate duplicator before. When Sliske reveals that he turned the tourists into wights, the Easter Bunny tells the player that they should give them an overdose of the chocolate to return them back to normal. He stays behind with the other tourists after Sliske escapes and…

Eastertime Fete.title: 2019 Easter event

getting_there.heading: Hidden egg locations
getting_there.text:
During this event, there were also hidden eggs scattered around Gielinor which give 50 crystallised chocolate fragments per found egg which could be used at this event. There were 15 eggs for a total of 750 fragments.

Eastertime Fete.summary: The Eastertime Fete (also called the Springtime Fete) was the 2019 Easter event. The event featured the Easter Bunny, who told the player he was celebrating the start of spring with a Springtime Fete in the Lumbridge Crater. During the event the crater hosted a variety of skilling locations.

Eastfold Farm.title: Eastfold Farm

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring Fairy code | BKS and head north-east
• Via option on Wendlewick Teleport to teleport to Marigold Farm and head south-east

Eastfold Farm.summary: The farm has a role in the Hearts of Sanguine quest, during which the player must visit it to investigate missing sheep.

Edgeville.title: Edgeville
Edgeville.teleport:
• Edgeville lodestone
• Amulet of glory
• Paddewwa Teleport
• Wilderness sword

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• A Wilderness sword 1 or its higher variants can be used to arrive slightly north-west of the Edgeville bank
• Use an Amulet of glory to teleport slightly west of Edgeville bank.
• Players with access to a slayer cape can teleport to Vannaka and arrive south of the Edgeville bank.
• Players may use the Edgeville lodestone to arrive west of the General store or the Fairy ring code DKR to arrive east just across the river.
• The Paddewwa Teleport spell can be used to arrive in the south-western section of the Edgeville Dungeon a short distance away to the ladder leading to the Yew trees south of Edgeville bank.

Edgeville.summary: In the early development of RuneScape Classic, Edgeville only had empty buildings. It was originally called Ghost Town on the world map, but when the Wilderness was released it was renamed Edgeville and given a general store and bank.

Edgeville Dungeon.title: Edgeville Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are two entrances to the dungeon. The most common is in Edgeville, in the ruins south of the bank. It is marked by a mark on the minimap.

Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

Edgeville Dungeon.summary: Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon.title: Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon
Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon.summary: The Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon is found north of the gate into the Wilderness of the Edgeville Dungeon. This resource dungeon is available to members only and has a Dungeoneering level requirement of 10, and grants 1,100 Dungeoneering experience upon the player's first entrance. The room contains 12 Chaos druids in a moderately sized cave. The cave also has grimy marrentill, grimy irit, grimy harralander, and grimy ranarr spawns.

Edgeville Dungeon hill giant resource du.title: Edgeville Dungeon hill giant resource dungeon
Edgeville Dungeon hill giant resource du.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Edgeville Dungeon hill giant resource du.summary: Players might also find the hill giant resource dungeon useful for training combat. Additionally, money can be made from the limpwurt roots and if using telegrab some additional Magic experience can be gained.

Edgeville Monastery.title: Edgeville Monastery

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• A combat bracelet teleports directly inside the monastery and is the fastest method
• Teleport to Edgeville using the Edgeville lodestone to arrive a short distance north-east
• Use Lassar Teleport using the Ancient Magicks spellbook to arrive at Ice Mountain and go east
• Teleport to Barbarian Village using a Skull sceptre and head north-west

Edgeville Monastery.summary: In 164, the Edgeville Monastery was attacked by Lord Sulla, who had recently slain his predecessor and gained control of the organisation. The Battle of the Monastery was the first battle of the War of 164, and it saw the first use of Chaos Dwarf Mortars. The Edgeville Monastery's residents suffered heavy casualties in the battle, but the intervention of more well-equipped fighters such as Kara-Meir, Doric, Squire Theodore, Ebenezer, Castimir, and Gar'rth gave much of the order time to escape…

Edgeville bank.title: Edgeville bank
Edgeville bank.summary: On the south wall of the Edgeville bank players can find the Clan Cup plaque erected to commemorate the previous and current winners of the Jagex Clan Cup.

Edimmu resource dungeon.title: Edimmu resource dungeon
Edimmu resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
• Crystal teleport seed
• Attuned crystal teleport seed
Edimmu resource dungeon.summary: The dungeon contains edimmu, and is the only known location in which they exist outside of Dungeoneering. A Meilyr Guard stands watch outside the edimmu room. He will only let players in if they have an edimmu, Creatures of Daemonheim, ghost, or zombie Slayer assignment, unless they have a Slayer Wildcard.

Edmond.title: Edmond
Edmond.summary: When West Ardougne was quarantined, Elena snuck into the city to help, intending to only be gone a few days. When three weeks passed, Edmond made plans to sneak into the city himself to rescue her. However, he was too old to go himself. A passing adventurer offered to take his place and he showed them to the Ardougne Sewers, which he'd gotten access to by digging down through his garden. His wife gave the adventurer a gas mask to protect them from the plague. Their work aroused the suspicion of…

Elder God Wars Dungeon.title: Elder God Wars Dungeon
Elder God Wars Dungeon.teleport:

• Dig Site pendant
• Pontifex shadow ring

getting_there.text:
Senntisten can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift.

Elder God Wars Dungeon.summary: The dungeon does not have any requirements to access. However, specific activities or enemies have skill requirements. Completion of Sliske's Endgame and City of Senntisten is recommended to unlock additional rewards and better understand the story. The bosses do not require a killcount and skill requirement to access unlike the previous God Wars dungeons. Wielding the Shard of Erebus, a post-quest reward from the Battle of the Monolith quest, renders the monsters in the dungeon unaggressive.…

Elemental Workshop.title: Elemental Workshop
Elemental Workshop.summary: There are two workbenches in the central lobby room, which can only be used to smith elemental bars at first. During or after subsequent Elemental Workshop II, III, and IV quests, other bars may be smithed: mind, body, chaos, and cosmic bars. The ladder to the floor 1 and the hatch leading to the level 2 are located here.

Elemental Workshop (dungeon).title: Elemental Workshop
Elemental Workshop (dungeon).summary: There are two workbenches in the central lobby room, which can only be used to smith elemental bars at first. During or after subsequent Elemental Workshop II, III, and IV quests, other bars may be smithed: mind, body, chaos, and cosmic bars. The ladder to the floor 1 and the hatch leading to the level 2 are located here.

The ladder to the floor 1 and the hatch leading to the level 2 are located here.

Elf Camp.title: Elf Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Partial completion of Regicide is required in order to access the Elf camp.
• Tirannwn quiver 3 teleport directly to the camp
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport. Run northwest through the forest. Turn west before the bridge leading up the hill to Prifddinas, then walk across the log balance to enter the camp (45 Agility).
• Same as above, but instead of heading west before the bridge, walk across the bridge and enter the Dense Forest just west of the hill up the hill to Prifddinas.

Elf Camp.summary: The Elf Camp can be found in Tirannwn, the most western part of Gielinor. It is a small camp of elf warriors under the command of Lord Iorwerth. The Regicide quest needs to be started to access it. Although there are fightable elves in the camp, it is highly recommended to fight elves in Lletya instead, since there is both a bank and altar there. Lletya is also much safer and easier to access.

Elf Tracker.title: Elf Tracker
Elf Tracker.summary: Once a player has completed the Easy achievements in the Tirannwn achievements set, upon speaking to the Elf Tracker he will reward the player with a Tirannwn quiver 1 and an antique lamp (granting 10,000 experience in a skill 47 and above).

Eli Bacon.title: Eli
Eli Bacon.summary: He was preparing Gassy Steve, one of his wrestling pigs, for his next competition when the pig went up in flames. The smell of cooked pig attracted people who wanted to see how the meat tasted. When Eli tried it himself, he found it to be delicious and decided to try marketing it. He then registered the food with the Cooks' Guild, making a deal with Chef Morrisane in exchange for 30% of all future earnings, naming it after himself. Meanwhile, the popularity of the food accidentally caused the…

Elid Genie Cave.title: Genie's Cave

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Using the desert amulet 2/3/4 to teleport to Nardah and running west is one of the fastest methods of reaching the cave. Alternatively, the The Heart teleport may be used, as cave is located slightly to the north of Heart of Gielinor.

Elid Genie Cave.summary: Inside the cave are numerous desert snakes, as well as the genie, in a separate room. A light source is required, and if the player attempts to enter the crevice leading to the cave, the player will be warned that they need a light source. This warning can be toggled off at the Doomsayer, or in the Gameplay settings.

Ellis.title: Ellis
Ellis.summary: It takes approximately 9 seconds running to get from him to the bank interface.

Eluned.title: Eluned
Eluned.summary: She has roles in many quests. In Roving Elves, she explains elven burial customs and enchants a seed. She is also the starting point of Mourning's End Part I, informing the player that Arianwyn wants them, and of The Light Within, asking the player for help in reforming the goddess Seren.

Elvarg's lair.title: Elvarg's lair
Elvarg's lair.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Elvarg's lair.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (24 June 2010) | date=24 June 2010 
• Removed some blocking from the dungeon under Karamja’s volcano.

Empyrean Citadel.title: Empyrean Citadel

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The only way to get to the citadel is to use the Invitation box obtained after starting Missing, Presumed Death.

Empyrean Citadel.summary: The Empyrean Citadel was Armadyl's seat of power in Gielinor before the Edicts of Guthix were established and the gods banished. During the Missing, Presumed Death quest, it is taken by Sliske, who uses it to gather the gods (including the citadel's former owner) for his 'Grand Ascendancy'.

Enchanted Valley.title: Enchanted Valley

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The only way to access the Enchanted Valley is with the fairy ring BKQ. If A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has not been completed, either a Dramen staff or a Lunar staff must be equipped.

Entrana.title: Entrana
Entrana.teleport:
• Balloon transport system
• Ethereal outfit
• Law altar teleport
• Wicked hood

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Riding the boat in Port Sarim, by asking the monks on the dock.
• Any way of teleporting directly to the law altar which can be done via the Abyss, law altar teleport, wicked hood or the ethereal outfit.
• The balloon transport system can be used to travel here as well.

Entrana.summary: Players cannot bring weapons or armour to Entrana as ordered by Saradomin and enforced by his monks. Players cannot remove tool belt items while on Entrana. However, players can make equipment on the island, such as making a bow by using a knife on any type of logs and then stringing the bow. Players are also allowed to bring ammunition onto Entrana.

Entrana Dungeon.title: Entrana Dungeon
Entrana Dungeon.summary: There are zombies, greater demons and during the Lost City quest, a Dramen tree spirit.

Essyllt.title: Essyllt

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
Prior to Plague's End, the head mourner can be found in his office in the basement of the Mourner Headquarters in north-eastern West Ardougne. Mourner gear must be worn in order to enter the building. If lost, two keys can be found on his desk: a tarnished key to the jail room next door and a new key to open the western basement door to the tunnel leading to the Temple of Light.

After Plague's End, if he was spared during the quest, he may be found alongside his wife, Mwynen, within the Iorwerth manor in Prifddinas.

Clear | left

Essyllt.summary: Attempting to talk to him during Regicide results in "Nothing interesting happens."

Estate agent.title: Estate agent
Estate agent.location: East Ardougne, Falador, Rimmington, Seers' Village, Varrock

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
TableBottom 

The Prifddinas estate agent can additionally be found in Prifddinas.

getting_there.heading: Player-owned house locations
getting_there.text:
Players must pay 1,000 coins to purchase their first home in either Rimmington or Taverley. Players will earn more options as they level up their Construction skill. Estate agents can move a player-owned house to any of the other house portal locations identified by the portal icon () on the minimap, as long as the player's level is sufficient.

POH Portal Locations

Estate agent.summary: He also runs the Construction Contracts activity, and will give players contracts either in person or if spoken to via the spell NPC Contact. He gives access to the Estate Agents Shop, where players can spend the contract credits earned while doing contracts.

Etceteria.title: Etceteria

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players with level 83 Farming can grow a Spirit tree on Etceteria and then use the spirit trees to teleport to and from the tree on the island. Players must have completed the Tree Gnome Village quest to teleport using spirit trees.
• Fairy ring code CIP teleports the player north of the castle on Miscellania. Players must have progressed through part of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest to teleport using fairy rings.
• Players with a ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, or luck of the Dwarves can teleport directly to Miscellania, then walk across the bridge to Etceteria. Miscellania teleport is unlocked on the rings after completion of the Throne of Miscellania quest.
• Players can travel between Rellekka and Miscellania (and then on to Etceteria) via boat, by talking to or right-clicking the nearby Sailor, who shall let you use the boat only if you have completed The Fremennik Trials quest. In Rellekka the boat is located at the docks just north of the marketplace. In Miscellania the boat is located at the dock on the south-eastern part of the island. When arriving at Miscellania, players wearing Fremennik sea boots 2 or better can jump from the north end of the dock onto…

Etceteria.summary: Etceteria has two usable Farming patches (bush and spirit tree) and three unusable ones. A small obelisk is near the farming patches. There is also a bank and two stores, a green grocer and a fish monger, on the island.

Evil Chicken's Lair.title: Evil Chicken's Lair
Evil Chicken's Lair.summary: It is accessible during and after the Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze subquest during which players must kill the Evil Chicken. Players should note that to access the Evil Chicken's Lair, they must have spoken to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.

Evil Dave.title: Evil Dave
Evil Dave.quest: Shadow of the Storm, Recipe for Disaster, Evil Dave's Big Day Out
Evil Dave.summary: He appears in several quests including Shadow of the Storm and Recipe for Disaster, and is the protagonist of Evil Dave's Big Day Out. He is also the subject of the court case of EVIL DAVE v. The People.

Exam Centre.title: Exam Centre

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The fastest way to get to the Exam Centre is to use a Dig Site pendant. Archaeology journal teleports to a short distance to the northwest. Alternatively, the Varrock lodestone or the gnome glider transportation system could be used, selecting the destination "Lemanto Andra".

Exam Centre.summary: The Exam Centre is a location in Misthalin east of Varrock, in the southern part of Archaeology Campus and is central to several quests. While its access is open to all, it is only involved in members-only content. A bank chest can also be accessed here.

Exiled Kalphite Hive.title: Exiled Kalphite Hive

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are various ways to get to the Exiled Kalphite Hive quickly:
• If Pharaoh's Folly has been completed, use Leela's favour to teleport to Merchant District and go north through the gate.
• If Desert Treasure has been completed, teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone. Run south-east.
• Teleport to the Menaphos lodestone and go north through the gate. This is a bit of a longer walk through the city, but provides bank and Grand Exchange access.
• Ride the Magic carpet to Menaphos and walk north.
• Use the Jaldraocht teleport from the Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the gods, step through the door, and run down the pyramid and round towards its South face.
• Use the Ring of slaying or Slayer Cape ability and teleport to Sumona in Pollnivneach, then walk south-west along the river.
• If your POH is in Pollnivneach, teleport there with a tablet or the spell.
• Use the teleport to Enakhra's Temple from a camulet or cramulet (after the cramulet has been added) and walk south-east from the quarry.
• Use the Bandit Camp Teleport scroll and walk south past the pyramid.

Exiled Kalphite Hive.summary: The hive is home to the fearsome Kalphite King as well as a variety of high-level minions. Even "standard" kalphites like the soldiers and guardians are higher level, and other areas hold new kalphite types that attack with magic.

Experiment cave.title: Fenkenstrain's Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are many ways to travel to this cave:
# Using fairy ring code ALQ to teleport to this fairy ring. This is the fastest method of travelling to the cave.
# Teleport to the ectofuntus using an ectophial.
# Teleport to Canifis using Kharyrll Teleport, or a POH portal.
# Use a charter ship to travel to Port Phasmatys. This is the slowest method and costs between 1,300 - 4,100 coins.
# Travel to the Paterdomus temple and head through the holy barrier into Morytania.
# Travel to the Canifis lodestone using the Home Teleport spell.

Experiment cave.summary: After the quest, players may re-access the cave, however they will only be able to kill the sheep-wolf and spider-man experiments. Attempting to attack a wolf-woman experiment yields the message: "You don't have the heart to kill the poor creature again."

Explorer Jack.title: Explorer Jack
Explorer Jack.summary: Jack pays adventurers in coins for completing Area Tasks achievements to an unspecified specific limit (around 5.3 million coins), which can be received by talking to him or right-clicking Claim-rewards. However, explorer's ring 1 can only be claimed by talking directly to him, and its upgrades cannot be claimed before this is done.

Fairy Nuff.title: Fairy Nuff
Fairy Nuff.summary: Prior to starting A Fairy Tale I, she will offer to heal some of the player's life points in exchange for cut gems. She will heal 40 life points for an opal, 50 life points for a sapphire or a jade, 70 life points for an emerald or red topaz, 90 for a ruby and 110 for a diamond. Because of the expensive price on such a small amount of healing and the fact that there is a bank next door to heal completely, using her to recover health is not recommended.

Fairy Queen.title: Fairy Queen
Fairy Queen.summary: In A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains the player is told that the Tanglefoot took her Queen's secateurs and causing her to be ill; they must defeat the Tanglefoot and hand the secateurs to the Fairy Godfather.

Fairy Resistance Hideout.title: Fairy Resistance Hideout

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players must have at least started A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen and found Nuff's certificate. With the certificate in inventory, players can reach the hideout by using the fairy rings in this sequence:
# AIR (to a small island)
# DLR (to another small island)
# DJQ (to nowhere)
# AJS (to the hideout)

The certificate is not needed after starting A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

Fairy Resistance Hideout.summary: This area is also a major location for A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift, serving as a rendezvous point between the player and the Tooth Fairy.

Fairy shopkeeper.summary:

Falador.teleport:

• Falador Teleport
• Spawning

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
• Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.
• Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
• Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
• Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
• Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
• Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.

Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the…

Falador Farm.title: Falador farm

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The farm is in some ways the crossroads of Asgarnia. It has a convenient location, near Draynor Village, Falador, Port Sarim, and Rimmington. There are several ways to reach the farm.
• The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
• If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
• If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
• Using the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
• Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and run north, or the Draynor lodestone then run west.
• If a player binds their amulet of nature to a patch in the farm, it will teleport the player to the patch when the crops are diseased or fully grown. As this isn't certain, it is rarely used.
• Players can charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.

Falador Farm.summary: If that isn't enough, there is also a large pasture containing several cows, which will all drop raw beef, bones, and their prized cowhides. The meat can be cooked in Falador or on a fire to be used as food, the bones buried, and the cowhides tanned and used for Crafting, or sold on the Grand Exchange to others wishing to train Crafting for a fair price. If players don't wish to cook the meat for food, they can also eat the cabbages that spawn in the patch nearby.

Falador Mole Lair.title: Falador Mole Lair
Falador Mole Lair.summary: The mole is often killed for her drops of mole claws and mole skins, which can be traded with Wyson for bird's nests. These bird's nests are different from those received from Woodcutting, and can also contain lower level Farming seeds.

Falador Park.title: Falador Park
Falador Park.teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)
• Falador lodestone
• Falador teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Max Guild boss portal tuned to the Giant mole
• Falador Teleport and run east
• Falador lodestone and run south, then east

Falador Park.summary: Minerva, who stands near the grave, helps players to understand the history of the ancient hero Meira. A skilled player will be offered a master max cape by Minerva after inserting a blurite keystone into the slot of the pommel on the grave.

Falador east bank.title: Falador east bank
Falador east bank.summary: There are a poll booth and a deposit box in the bank.

Fancy Clothes Store.title: Fancy Clothes Store
Fancy Clothes Store.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (6 April 2020) | date=6 April 2020 
• Modernised the fur shop interface on mobile and re-added the spotted cape to the store.

Father Reen.title: Father Reen
Father Reen.summary: The group have been following Denath for years, never finding an opportunity to confront him, including narrowly missing him during his ill-fated attempt to summon Delrith. After the opening of a portal in Uzer, he led a group of dark wizards to the ruined city in order to summon Agrith Naar. Father Badden followed the wizards while Father Reen sought out the adventurer who vanquished Delrith, with the intent of slaying Agrith Naar for good. He eventually made his way to Uzer, where he learnt…

Father Urhney.title: Father Urhney
Father Urhney.quest: The Restless Ghost, Buyers and Cellars
Father Urhney.summary: He features in The Restless Ghost. Father Aereck describes Urhney as a "ghost expert" and asks the player to enlist his help in dealing with the ghost in Lumbridge cemetery. Father Urhney explains that he cannot return to Lumbridge to exorcise the ghost as he has vowed to remain in the swamp, praying and meditating, for two years. Instead he provides the player with a ghostspeak amulet. During Buyers and Cellars, the player must steal a golden chalice from Father Urhney's house. To do so they…

Feldip Hills.title: Feldip Hills
Feldip Hills.teleport: Ring of duelling (Castle Wars, nearby), Watchtower Teleport (Yanille, nearby), South Feldip Hills Teleport, Spirit Tree, Fairy Rings (code AKS)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Feldip Hills can be accessed using a variety of ways including:
• Gnome glider to Lemantolly Undri, west Feldip Hills
• The ogre boat ride, unlocked after completing Freeing Skrach Uglogwee
• Fairy rings. Ring AKS is near the Feldip hunter area. Ring ALP is in a cave south of Jiggig. After completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift, the player can use a Pickaxe to clear a tunnel to the surface from the cave. Before there, the cave cannot be used to access the surface.
• Travel to Yanille (using, for example, a Home Teleport or the Watchtower teleport) and then walk south.
• Travel to Oo'glog lodestone using Home teleport and walk north.
• Travel to Castle Wars (using, for example, a Duelling ring) and then walk south and east.
• Teleport to South Feldip Hills and walk north and slightly east.

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
• Oo'glog
• South Feldip Hills

Feldip Hills.summary:
)

The Feldip Hills are positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin and southeast of the Castle Wars arena. They are mostly populated by ogres. The capital of the Feldip Hills is the city of Gu'Tanoth; to the west of Gu'Tanoth is Jiggig. Jiggig is filled with Zogres and Skogres (zombie and skeleton ogres, respectively). In the southern areas is a Hunter training area. After completing the quest Big Chompy Bird…

Femi.title: Femi
Femi.summary: Players completing a Treasure Trail may be asked to speak to her if they receive an anagram with the words "ME IF".

Fenkenstrain's Castle.title: Fenkenstrain's Castle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Slayer cape teleport to Mazchna, run east.
• Ectophial teleport to the Ectofuntus, run west.
• Canifis lodestone, run north-east through the town, past Mazchna, then east.

Fenkenstrain's Castle.summary: It once served as the refuge of the man named Charos, the human advisor of Lord Drakan, while the Lordship of the North Coast was ruled by Lady Rolobrae. Charos, after having offended Lord Drakan during the Great Hunt, was sheltered for a time by Lady Rolobrae, hiding in an iron maiden and using his enchantments to appear as a desiccated corpse. In exchange for her hospitality, Charos gifted her his ring, which would be passed down through Rolobrae's family for generations after.

Fight Arena (location).title: Fight Arena (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the Fairy ring code DJP and run south.
• Use the Ardougne lodestone, walk South through the Zoo and past the Monastery.
• Take a charter-ship to Port Khazard and walk West.
• Use the Ardougne Cloak to teleport to Ardougne Monastery and continue South East.
• Use the Yanille lodestone, walk East through the city and continue North.

Fight Arena (location).summary: The Fight Arena plays a large role in the quest Fight Arena. The only useful facilities that can be found here are the 4 water supplies and the bar to the west. Khazard armour can be obtained here by searching the armoury in the northeastern house. Other than this, the area has no other use and cannot be accessed again after completing the quest. If attempted, the doorman will say "You're him/her! The one who beat the General/General's Pet! Begone, murderer!".

Fight Kiln.title: Fight Kiln

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• TokKul-Zo teleport directly to the Fight Kiln
• Fairy ring BLP to TzHaar City, near the Fight Cave. Run east through the city to the Kiln.

Fight Kiln.summary: Entering the Fight Kiln requires completion of the The Elder Kiln quest, as well as a one-time payment of a fire cape, which means players would have to complete the TzHaar Fight Cave as well. After this, the kiln may be played as many times as desired for the rewards - a choice of a TokHaar-Kal or an uncut onyx.

Fisher Realm.title: Fisher Realm

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Access to the realm requires partial completion of the Holy Grail quest. It can be entered using fairy ring code BJR, or by blowing a magic whistle under a tower on the peninsula northwest of Brimhaven. The magic whistle obtained from the quest will be needed to reenter the realm if players can not use the fairy ring.

Blowing the whistle within the realm will teleport the player to the tower northwest of Brimhaven.

The Fisher Realm is a kingdom on a plane alongside to the plane of Gielinor. The realm is ruled by the Fisher…

Fishing Guild.title: Fishing Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Fishing Guild is located south-west of Seers' Village and north of Ardougne, in the village of Hemenster. There are several transportation options:
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run north.
• Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and follow the road south-west past the Ranging Guild.
• Use the Lunar spell Fishing Guild Teleport, or get teleported by someone casting Tele-group Fishing Guild.
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild and head west.
• Break a plain of mud sphere to be teleported to the Goblin Cave (the dungeon area just south-east of the guild), exit through the entrance, and head west. This requires completion of the Land of the Goblins quest, however.

getting_there.heading: Entrance hall
getting_there.text:
Here is a range which players can use to cook food. It is fairly close to a bank. However, many players go to cook next to the bank in the Rogues' Den, since there is an everlasting fire next to the banker, or in the Cooking Guild with varrock armour 3. A lobster pot, harpoon, and big fishing net spawn here. There is also a staircase that leads to the floor 2, which contains a bed for the employee. Clear 

Fishing Guild main entrance.png | The main entrance hall
Fishing Guild entrance hall.png | A view of the interior, showing the harpoon, big fishing net, range, and lobster cage.

Fishing Guild.summary: Right inside the guild is the master fisher. Players can talk to him to receive fishing advice or to purchase a Fishing cape for 99,000 coins.

Fishing Guild bank.title: Fishing Guild bank
Fishing Guild bank.location: In the north-west of Fishing Guild
Fishing Guild bank.summary: There is a deposit box in the bank.

Fishing Platform.title: Fishing Platform
Fishing Platform.summary: The Fishing Platform is located due east of Witchaven, in the ocean. To reach the Fishing Platform, start the Sea Slug Quest and talk to Holgart, who will row the player back and forth. After starting the Slug Menace quest, the NPC Jeb will provide that same service. Holgart resumes service after Salt in the Wound.

Fishing Shop (Wendlewick).title: Fishing Shop (Wendlewick)
Fishing Shop (Wendlewick).summary: The shop notably features a bank deposit box outside with a "Deposit all fish" option. As a result, harpoons for Summoning may be bought from either NPC and quickly deposited at the deposit box outside the fishing shop.

Fishing Trawler.title: Fishing Trawler

getting_there.heading: Getting to the Fishing Trawler
getting_there.text:
The Fishing Trawler is located in Port Khazard. There are several ways to get there:
• Players on the Lunar spellbook can use Khazard Teleport to teleport directly to Port Khazard.
• Fairy ring code DJP is just north of Port Khazard.
• The charter ship has a stop in Port Khazard.
• All 4 types of the Ardougne cloak can teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, and Port Khazard is just a short run to the south.
• Completion of the easy Ardougne achievements offers free, unlimited teleports to the monastery on all spellbooks.
• The Watchtower Teleport spell or Yanille lodestone will get players to Yanille, from which they can run north-east to Port Khazard.

Fishing Trawler.summary: Fishing Trawler is a Fishing minigame run by Murphy that players can access at Port Khazard. The minigame has no requirements to start, but a minimum of level 15 Fishing is required to catch any fish. Players board a trawler boat and try to prevent the boat from sinking as they are sailed for 10 minutes around the sea.

Fishing spot.title: Fishing spot
Fishing spot.summary: Fishing spots will move to a nearby game square after a random period of time, which according to timing ten movements happens on average every 4 minutes and 12 seconds.

Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz resource dungeo.title: Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz resource dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are multiple ways to get the dungeon:
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, run south-west to the guard, talk to him to state that understanding the risk inherent of going into the Wilderness, run south-west past the shipwreck on the Daemonheim peninsula, run north-west to cross the isthmus, run past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Fort Forinthry lodestone and go through the north gate and head north past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Wilderness Crater lodestone (or level 18 Wilderness obelisk) and head north-east past the Graveyard of Shadows and the boneyard. Then head past the soulgazers, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.

Players should talk to Vala to opt out of PvP, thus making the trip to the Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz a safe one, even though the dungeon entrance is in the middle of the Wilderness.

Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz resource dungeo.summary: Once entering the dungeon, players will be in a platform (which is a non-combat zone). Before jumping down the ledge, at which point Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz begins the fight, player should prepare for combat.

Flying Horse Inn.title: Flying Horse Inn
Flying Horse Inn.summary: Lucien is involved in the Temple of Ikov quest and can be found in the inn. After the completion of the quest While Guthix Sleeps, a local thug will replace Lucien.

Flynn's Mace Market.title: Flynn's Mace Market
Flynn's Mace Market.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Massive update! | date=6 April 2001 
• Added to game.

Forinthry Dungeon.title: Forinthry Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
The dungeon has two entrances from the Wilderness.
• At level 17 Wilderness, east of the Bandit Camp and Dark Warriors' Fortress and west of the south-western Wilderness Crater steps. The Wilderness sword 2 (and higher variants) provides free infinite teleports here, and it is a short run west from the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
• At level 31 Wilderness, north of the Bandit Camp, and east of the Forgotten Cemetery.

Forinthry Dungeon.summary: The dungeon also plays a small role in the quest One of a Kind, where the player visits the green dragon chamber to investigate for mysterious markings.

Fort Forinthry.title: Fort Forinthry
Fort Forinthry.location: South-east Wilderness and north-east of Varrock
Fort Forinthry.teleport:
• Fort Forinthry lodestone
• Fort Forinthry Teleport
• Slayer cape (To the Raptor)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone, located just south of the fort.
• Teleport to the fort's courtyard using a Fort Forinthry Teleport scroll.
• Use the Slayer cape to the Raptor, who's located in front of the fort's guardhouse.
• Via the fairy ring BJP leading to the Woodcutters' Grove just outside the east wall, which requires building tier 2 Grove cabin.

Fort Forinthry.summary: The New Foundations quest needs to be nearly completed in order to continue constructing the fort. Players are able to establish nine buildings: the Workshop, Town Hall, Kitchen, Chapel, Command Centre, Guardhouse, Grove, Ranger's Workroom, and Botanist's Workbench. Each building can be upgraded up to tier 3 with the corresponding Construction level, providing various benefits.

Frank (The Horsemen).title: Frank
Frank (The Horsemen).summary: During the Missing, Presumed Death quest, he replaces the absent Death inside his office, serving as death tutor, master of the Soul Reaper and the place to reclaim items on death. Like Death himself, he provides Soul Reaper tasks, gives access to the Soul Reaper reward shop, and can be used to change loot beam settings. He also replaced Death during the Gauntlet of Souls Halloween event.

Fred the Farmer.title: Fred the Farmer

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: GU | subject=location | GUL | date= | update= | img=Fred house old.png | name=Fred's house | GUL | date= | update= | img=Locations Lumbridge Farmerfred.png | name=Fred's house

Fred the Farmer.summary: If the player talks to him and says that they have seen the 'Thing', (which is actually just two penguins but he is mortally afraid of it, thinking it's a "shapeshifter") he will start to go on about grabbing chickens and running to the hills. In the end, the player will say that it is two penguins disguised as a sheep. He will ask the player if they have been "in the sun" too much, a reference to sun madness.

Fremennik Isles.title: Fremennik Isles

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Use any of the methods to get to Rellekka, notably...
• Fremennik sea boots 4 teleport directly to the Rellekka market square
• Use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run west into the town.
• House Teleport or Teleport to house (chipped) to the player-owned house portal just south of Rellekka.
• Enchanted lyre teleport to the town's south entrance
...and then travel via Mord Gunnars or Maria Gunnars on the northernmost dock within the town.

Fremennik Isles.summary: They drop Raw yak meat which can be cooked, yak hair which can be woven into rope, Yak-hide and bones. Yak hair can be spun on the spinning wheel nearby and Yak-hide can be crafted with the crafting equipment which can be bought from Jofridr Mordstatter. They also have a rare but valuable drop of Fremennik yak (unchecked) for use on the Player-owned farm. They are close to the bank on Neitiznot.

Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.title: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players may reach this location by:
• Via the fairy rings, using the code AJR.
• Using the ring of slaying or slayer mask teleport.
• Teleporting to their house (if in Rellekka) or using a Rellekka tablet.
• Using the Fremennik Province lodestone teleport and running south-east.
• The eagle transport system gets the player a bit to the north of the dungeon.
• Using the teleports on the Mask of Stone, Mask of Reflection, Mask of Gelatin, Mask of the Kura, Mask of the Aquanites, or their upgraded helm versions. These teleport players to the cockatrice, basilisk, jelly, kurask, and aquanite areas of the dungeon, respectively. Each mask or helm is limited to two teleports per day.
• Using the pulsing markings inside one of the chambers on the lower floor of the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon (assuming that they have fought at least one of the bosses.)
• Using elder divination outfit to teleport to the sparkling wisp colony.
clear | left 
• Using the delver's anklet to teleport to the middle of the dungeon.

Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=This Week In RuneScape - 03/08/20#patch-notes | date=3 August 2020 
• Modeled light beams have been removed from the Fremennik Slayer dungeon, as they were casting shadows.

Freneskae.title: Freneskae

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Freneskae may be accessed after starting Fate of the Gods, by means of the World Gate, located north of the Arandar and south of the Eagles' Peak. Fate of the Gods takes place almost entirely on Freneskae, and after the quest is completed, Freneskae remains open for exploration. To access Freneskae through the world gate, it must be dialled to . 

The world gate itself may be reached by:
• Sixth-Age circuit teleport to World Gate (option 2).
• Quest Cape or master quest cape teleport to World Gate (option 0).
• Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south.
• Traveller's necklace teleport to The outpost (option 2) and run west.

Freneskae.summary: Once considered a "perfect" world, Freneskae is now a dark wasteland. Its toxic atmosphere is riddled with constant lightning storms, volcanic eruptions and lava flows near its surface of bare rock. Its native life struggles to survive in the harsh climate, and as a result it is a world of constant warfare. In addition to the Mahjarrat, Freneskae was home to the Mahserrat, Mahkorat, and the Chelon-Mah, and is the only world on which muspah and nihil may be found.

Freya Lune.title: Freya Lune
Freya Lune.summary:
They seem to be locked in an argument.
• Now that the planning is over, what will she do?
examine2: * She's looking around with interest.

Frozen Waste Plateau.summary: There are also several spawns of water, cosmic, and law runes.

There are 8 fruit tree patches: at Gnome Stronghold, east of Catherby, west of Tree Gnome Village, Brimhaven, Lletya, Herblore Habitat, Dalia's Tree Nursery and in the Meilyr clan district of Prifddinas. As with tree,…

Players doing Treasure Trails clues are sometimes directed to her with the anagram 'Icy Fe' and gives you your next clue, or the reward.

Gaius's Two-Handed Shop.title: Gaius's Two-Handed Shop
Gaius's Two-Handed Shop.summary: The store can be used as an easy source for the adamant two-handed sword needed in one level 3 clue.

Galahad.title: Galahad
Galahad.summary: During the Holy Grail quest, he will give the player the holy table napkin which is used to get the magic whistle in Draynor Manor. The whistle is used to go to the Fisher Realm. The alternative to go to Fisher Realm is by use of the fairy ring code BJR.

Garden of Tranquillity.title: Garden of Tranquillity
Garden of Tranquillity.summary: Garden of Tranquillity is a quest where the player helps the queen of Varrock tend to her garden.

Gemstone cavern.title: Gemstone cavern
Gemstone cavern.summary: Dragonstone dragons, onyx dragons, and hydrix dragons, which respectively require levels 95, 98 and 101 Slayer to kill, are found in the dungeon. There is a shortcut at the entrance in the gemstone dragon dungeon, which requires level 94 Agility to use and leads to the hydrix dragons.

General Bentnoze.title: General Bentnoze
General Bentnoze.summary: Bentnoze, along with Wartface, constantly picks on Grubfoot, a small goblin inside the general's huts. Despite this, the generals are notably peaceful, for Goblins; they rarely fight against other races, aside from the Dwarves. The generals were originally from different tribes, namely the Thorobshuun and Garagorshuun tribes. This is possibly why they do not agree on many issues.

General Wartface.title: General Wartface
General Wartface.summary: Wartface, along with Bentnoze, constantly picks on Grubfoot, a small goblin inside the general's huts. Despite this, the Generals are notably peaceful, for goblins; they rarely fight against other races, aside from the dwarves. The Generals were originally from different tribes, namely the Thorobshuun and Garagorshuun tribes. This is possibly why they do not agree on many issues.

Gerrant's Fishy Business.title: Gerrant's Fishy Business
Gerrant's Fishy Business.summary: Near the back of the store there is a white apron respawn, potentially useful for those doing the Pirate's Treasure quest.

Gertrude.title: Gertrude
Gertrude.summary: She is the wife of Walter Fairweather, a travelling merchant, and the mother of Shilop, Wilough, Kanel and Philop. She also owns Fluffs, a female cat, and has done so for nearly a decade. She is rather lenient in her child rearing, letting her children run free due to the strain of raising four children. Her children often hang around the marketplace and the sewers. She also has a cousin in West Ardougne. Caleb Fitzharmon also lives with her. She is friends with Doris in Edgeville, inviting her…

Ghorrock.title: Ghorrock

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Ghorrock can only be accessed upon reaching a certain stage of The Temple at Senntisten quest.
• From the Rellekka Hunter area (fairy ring code: DKS) take the canoe (North-West from fairy ring code: DKS) to the Mahjarrat Ritual Site Cavern, then pass the ice block to the east. A heat globe is needed to pass Ice Block. You do not need a heat globe during Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
• After the completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, players may use the Glacor Cave (fairy ring code: DKQ) to access Ghorrock instead, gaining the Stone of Jas damage boost in the process. Run north from the ring to the cavern exit, then north again across the ritual site to the tunnel into the wall that leads to Ghorrock. The north side of the tunnel is enclosed by debris and safe from iron dragons.

There are several other less-recommended ways to access this fairly isolated part of the world:
• Teleport with either a Mask of Gelatin or Jellyhead, each having a limit of two teleports per day.
• Use the Enchanted Lyre to teleport to Rellekka, then run north-east to the Trollweiss Hunter Area then walk north and then west to the canoe, which will take you to Ghorrock Fortress.
• Use the Ardougne/Edgeville…

Ghorrock.summary: The last record of inhabitants was left by Lamarinta, Matriarch of Ghorrock, when she noted that Ali the Wise had brought news of the end of the God Wars. By then, there were barely a hundred residents, and even those had to keep their worship of Zaros a secret.

Ghost (Hopespear).title: Ghost (Hopespear)
Ghost (Hopespear).summary: Hopespear currently resides in the temple under the Plain of Mud on which the battle was fought, an invisible ghost much like those cursed by Zaros in the Second Age. He can only be spoken to with the aid of a ghostspeak amulet; this requirement can be negated with the passive reward obtained from the Morytania achievements. He can be found in the tomb that holds the former high priests of the temple, access of which can only be attained after completing a large part of the Land of the Goblins…

Gideon Bede.title: Gideon Bede
Gideon Bede.summary: Once Silverlight is retrieved, the player fights and defeats Delrith with it. During the battle, Gideon creates a holy barrier to help protect both himself and the adventurer from Delrith's attacks. After the quest, he admits that he is surprised the barrier even worked.

Glacor Cave.summary:

The Glacor Cave, which is referred as Saradomin's hidden cave in world map, is an icy underground cavern located near the Mahjarrat Ritual Site. It can be accessed after completion of the Ritual of the Mahjarrat, either through an entrance to the south of the ritual site, via the fairy ring code DKQ, by using the quest cape or by using the master quest cape. It was the cavern in…

Glacor Front.title: Glacor Front
Glacor Front.teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)
• Pontifex shadow ring

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Glacor Front is located in the southern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild (which can be quickly teleported to with Archaeology journal) and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through southern cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.
• The Master archaeologist's outfit will teleport to near the cathedral.
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
• Using a Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to ancient door.
• The Pontifex shadow ring, awarded by City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The Boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Arch-Glacor) or boss…

Glacor Front.summary: The Glacor Front features the second assault on the cathedral in Senntisten, where united forces of the young gods keep the eggs of the Elder Gods from hatching and destroying Gielinor in the process. The attack to the south of the cathedral is led by an Arch-Glacor and its army of glacors, who have been summoned by Wen in an effort to reclaim the eggs. Azzanadra, along with several mages, are holding Arch-Glacor's powers at bay near the aqueduct.

Glarial's Tomb.title: Glarial's Tomb
Glarial's Tomb.summary: If a player has any of the restricted items and tries to use Glarial's pebble, a message will prompt: "It fits perfectly, but nothing happens."

Glarial's tombstone.title: Glarial's tombstone
Glarial's tombstone.summary: The tomb is involved in the Waterfall quest and Roving Elves.

Gnome Ball.title: Gnome Ball

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: The Gnome Ball field is in the Gnome Stronghold, west of the Grand Tree.

Gnome Ball.summary: If players have level 90+ Ranged, simply clicking on the gnome goal after receiving the ball from the referee is the quickest way to score a goal. Players below level 90 Ranged might find it more reliable to Surge or Dive towards the goal before shooting.

Gnome Coach.title: Gnome Coach
Gnome Coach.summary: He is the answer to a clue scroll with the anagram "C ON GAME HOC". He gives players a challenge scroll, asking, "How many gnomes on the gnomeball field have red patches on their uniforms?" The answer for this challenge is 6.

Gnome Glider.summary:
or l/o Gnome Glider (Gnome glider hangar) | the transportation to the Crash Island | Gnome glider hangar 

Gnome gliders are a method of transportation available after completing The Grand Tree quest. The most common way to quickly access them is by teleporting to Al Kharid with a ring of duelling, an amulet of glory, or the Al Kharid lodestone. Another common way is by teleporting to the overgrown idols using an attuned grace of the elves. They can fly to many locations and can be used in…

Gnome Maze.title: Gnome Maze
Gnome Maze.summary: After completion of the quest Tree Gnome Village, the spirit tree at the centre of the maze becomes the hub of travel when using the spirit tree system, meaning that when using any spirit tree, players are taken there automatically. After the completion of The Path of Glouphrie, players can travel between any two trees.

Gnome Stronghold Agility Course.title: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course
Gnome Stronghold Agility Course.teleport:
• Spirit tree
• Balloon transport system
• Gnome glider

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the spirit tree teleportation (requires completion of the quest Tree Gnome Village).
• Use the gnome glider network to Ta Quir Priw (the Grand Tree) and walk south (requires completion of the quest The Grand Tree).
• Teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone and climb over the stile into the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
• Launch a grand seed pod and a gnome pilot to the Grand Tree.

Gnome Stronghold Agility Course.summary: Completing the basic course earns 130 experience per lap. The base experience per hour is around 13,928.5, based on a lap time of 33.6 seconds including the time taken to run back to the first obstacle.

Gnome Village Dungeon.title: Gnome Village Dungeon
Gnome Village Dungeon.summary: The dungeon features in several quests, as it is the source of Glarial's pebble which is needed in some quests. Players occasionally train on the Hobgoblins found in this dungeon.

Goblin Cave.title: Goblin Cave

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use Plain of mud sphere, requires completion of the quest Land of the Goblins
• Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and head north
• Use skills necklace teleport to Fishing Guild and head north-east
• Manor farm Teleport and head north-west
• Use combat bracelet teleport to Ranging Guild and head south-west

Goblin Cave.summary: The secret Goblin Temple is located in the north part of the cave. The stairs leading to it are guarded by 2 goblin guards who will allow a player to pass only as a goblin after drinking a goblin potion. The temple is heavily involved in the Land of the Goblins quest, as well as the Hopespear's Will miniquest that follows it.

Goblin Temple.title: Goblin Temple
Goblin Temple.summary: Inside the temple there is an altar, which is available to recharge Prayer after completing the quest Land of the Goblins. Six goblin tribes have chambers located around the temple with entry only if wearing the proper coloured goblin mail. None of the goblins within the temple can be attacked.

Goblin Village.title: Goblin Village
Goblin Village.teleport:
• Bandosian token
• Ethereal outfit
• Falador lodestone
• Goblin village sphere
• Master archaeology outfit
• Mind altar teleport
• Wicked hood

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can use a Goblin Village Sphere to teleport directly into the village.
• Using the Master archaeology outfit or Archaeology teleport to teleport to General Bentnoze and General Wartface.
• Using the Falador lodestone and go north to the village.
• Using a Mind altar teleport to teleport to the Mind altar and then go west.

getting_there.heading: Goblin Village Entrance
getting_there.text: GU | subject=location | GUL | date= | update= | img=Goblin Village entrance old.png | name=Goblin Village entrance | GUL | date=17 October 2012 | update=What's Mine is Yours | img=Goblin Village entrance (October 2012).png | name=Goblin Village entrance | GUL | date=21 January 2014 | update=Slayer Helmet and Social Slayer Update | img=Goblin Village entrance (January 2014).png | name=Goblin Village entrance | GUL | date=5 September 2022 | update=Free To Play Area Graphical Updates - This Week In RuneScape | img=Goblin Village entrance.png | name=Goblin Village entrance

Goblin Village.summary: The Goblin Village is ruled by two generals, General Bentnoze and General Wartface, who were originally members of the Thorobshuun and Garagorshuun tribes respectively; hence their inability to co-operate with one another.

God Wars Dungeon.title: God Wars Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength Boostable or 60 Agility Boostable 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged Boostable | n 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength Boostable | n 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility Boostable | n 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution Boostable | n 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic,…

getting_there.heading: Travelling from Fremennik Province
getting_there.text:
Checklist | * Teleport to the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, for example fairy ring AJR, ring of slaying, Fremennik Province lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots to climb the rocks slightly north-east of the entrance (obtain the boots from Freda if the player does not have them).
• Enter the Troll Stronghold from Secret Entrance.
• Go to the upper level and exit the stronghold.
• Go to the north-east and follow the path. Be aware of the attacks from Thrower Trolls south of the boulder.
• Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
• Enter the hole near the knight.

getting_there.heading: Travelling from Burthorpe
getting_there.text:
Checklist | * Teleport to Burthorpe lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots (obtain them from Freda if the player does not have them). Also requires 41 Agility for cliffside.
• Follow the route to get to the dungeon. This route may take damage from Thrower Trolls around Death Plateau.
• Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
• Enter the hole near the knight.

Golden Palace.summary: Prior to the 'Phite Club quest. the Pharaoh can be found alongside Ambassador Jabari. After the quest, it is ruled over by Osman, and upon completion of Pharaoh's Folly, it is ruled by Leela.

Golrie.title: Golrie
Golrie.quest: Waterfall Quest, Roving Elves, The Path of Glouphrie, The Prisoner of Glouphrie
Golrie.summary: Once at the surface, Golrie will introduce the player to his mother, Golrana. He tells her that the player was using the letter as a bookmark for a few years before they realised that it was really a letter from Bolrie. Golrana becomes excited and snatches the letter from Golrie to read it for herself. Eager for the chance to rescue her father, Golrana is resolved to go save him by herself, but after a little bit of prompting, she will allow the player to accompany her as her "questing…
