Gorajo Hoardstalker Dungeon.summary: At the back of the dungeon, there is a single bloodwood tree, along with several pawya and grenwalls.

Gorak Plane.title: Gorak Plane

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The plane is only accessible through the fairy ring DIR.

Gorak Plane.summary: The Goraks constantly draw the life essence from any living being they encounter, as well as the world they live on. In doing so, they have effectively trapped themselves on this small plane, leaving what's left of it noticeably warped.

Gower farm.title: Gower farm

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The farm is located close to a T-junction, with roads leading to Varrock, the Varrock Dig Site and Lumbridge. There are various methods to reach the farm.
• The most convenient method would be to simply utilise the Varrock lodestone and then head south-east.
• If the player's teleportation point to Varrock is at Varrock square, they can cast Varrock Teleport or use a Varrock teletab and subsequently run south-east to the farm.
• Players may also utilise the Canoe to travel to the Champions' Guild, then head east to the farm.

Gower farm.summary:
• The most convenient method would be to simply utilise the Varrock lodestone and then head south-east.
• If the player's teleportation point to Varrock is at Varrock square, they can cast Varrock Teleport or use a Varrock teletab and subsequently run south-east to the farm.
• Players may also utilise the Canoe to travel to the Champions' Guild, then head east to the farm.

Grand Exchange.title: Grand Exchange

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Varrock

Methods for free-to-play players
• Use a clan vexillum to teleport directly to the Grand Exchange.
• Teleport to Varrock (either via the Varrock Teleport spell or the Varrock lodestone) and walk the rest of the way.
• Teleport to the air altar using an air altar teleport, then walk north-east.
• Use a canoe to travel to the Barbarian Village station, then walk north-east.
• Teleport using the skull sceptre to outside the Stronghold of Security, then cross the bridge to the east and walk north-east.
• Teleport to Edgeville using the Edgeville lodestone and run east.
• Teleport to the yew trees in Varrock Palace using the oaken, willow, maple, or Nature's sentinel outfit and run west.

Methods for members
• Use a ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, or a Hazelmere's signet ring, to teleport directly to the Grand Exchange.
• Complete the easy Varrock achievements and set your Varrock Teleport destination to the entrance of the Grand Exchange.
• Teleport to Edgeville via a method of choice (such as fairy ring code DKR), then use the tunnel shortcut (requiring level 21 Agility) to crawl under the Grand Exchange's north-western wall.
• Use the Keldagrim…

Grand Exchange.summary: All coins and items from fully and partially finished trades can be collected at any bank and most bank chests (including Prifddinas clans' chests, Shantay Pass, Burthorpe, Lumbridge Market, Clan Wars, and Castle Wars lobby), but not at bank deposit boxes. Additionally, players will receive a message in their chatbox when the status of a trade offer is updated. Many players find it useful to sell items on the Grand Exchange rather than to a general store, as the profit margin is much larger for…

Grand Library of Menaphos.title: Grand Library of Menaphos

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to get there is to use the Imperial district teleport
• The Imperial district option on Leela's favour (a reward for completing the Pharaoh's Folly quest), or the sceptre of the gods, all of which teleport the player to the entrance of Jalkabir (the Golden Palace), which is just north of the entrance to the library.
• Alternatively, the player may teleport to the Menaphos lodestone and go up the stairs to the west.

Grand Library of Menaphos.summary: A sundial is located in the centre of the library on the lowest level, which was used for completing the Golden Path Challenge. There are bookshelves scattered around the library.

Grand Tree.title: Grand Tree

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can travel to the Grand Tree via the gnome glider on the floor 3.
• Seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame transport instantly to the Grand Tree.
• South of the tree itself is a spirit tree (requires completion of The Grand Tree quest).
• There is a landing spot for the Balloon Transport System just south of the Grand Tree.
• Using a games necklace to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, and then using one of the agility shortcuts on the north side of Grand Tree. The west shortcut requires Agility level 19, the east one requires Agility level 37. Both require the quest The Grand Tree to be complete.
• Hazelmere's signet ring provides unlimited free teleport to the Tree Gnome Stronghold nearby.
• Travel to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and walk south, and then east along the fence until reaching the gate.

clear | left

Grand Tree.summary: The Grand Tree includes two of the three banks in Tree Gnome Stronghold, several shops, and a bar and restaurant. The Gnome Restaurant minigame is on second level, and players who have completed The Grand Tree quest can access the Grand Tree Mine. There is an Agility shortcut north-east of the Grand Tree, which can be very useful for players training Barbarian Fishing.

Grand Vizier Hassan.title: Grand Vizier Hassan
Grand Vizier Hassan.summary:
Hassan is located in the throne room of Al Kharid palace. During and after completion of The Jack of Spades he moves to the south-west corner of the Merchant district of Menaphos, acting as the representative for Al Kharid.
Clear | left

Grave of Scorpius.title: Grave of Scorpius
Grave of Scorpius.summary: The easiest way to access the grave is to cast Ourania Teleport in the Lunar Spellbook, but an alternative to those who have not completed Lunar Diplomacy is to use a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars and run north.

Graveyard (Mazcab).title: Graveyard (Mazcab)
Graveyard (Mazcab).teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)
• Mazcab Teleport
• World window

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Mazcab Graveyard can be found in the south-west portion of the Mazcab overworld. Please see the Mazcab wiki page for methods of reaching Mazcab.

Once through the world window, head north, down the hill. Then, head west at the entrance of the Liberation of Mazcab. Then head south-west to find the graveyard. The graveyard is marked on the world map.

Graveyard (Mazcab).summary: If you are killed in PvP during the Mazcab supply run, you will end up in the Graveyard.

Graveyard of Shadows.title: Graveyard of Shadows
Graveyard of Shadows.teleport:
• Carrallangar Teleport
• Enlightened amulet
• Obelisk (Wilderness)
• Obelisk shard
• Portable obelisk

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can teleport directly to the Graveyard of Shadows by casting the Carrallangar Teleport spell from the ancient spellbook (requires completion of Desert Treasure).
• The enlightened amulet will teleport the player to the graveyard.
• The Ancient obelisk along with the Obelisk shard and Portable obelisk can teleport the user just south of the graveyard.
• The Wilderness lodestone is just southwest of the graveyard.

getting_there.heading: Nearby locations
getting_there.text: To the north of the Graveyard of Shadows lie the ruins of one of the last remaining cities within the wilderness. Players should be wary, however, as they are overrun with gargoyles and deadly red spiders. The Wilderness Crater lies to the west of the graveyard.

Graveyard of Shadows.summary:
• UL | type=hidden | update=Hidden updates/2008 | date=29th September 2008 
• The Graveyard of Shadows has a minor graphical update prior to the new quest. Gravestones are updated with more colours, and the dirt is now 3D. A statue of the Grim reaper is also added.

Grotworm Lair.title: Grotworm Lair
Grotworm Lair.summary: For players wishing to kill the Queen Black Dragon or mature grotworms, there is a slide shortcut down to the bottom level of the lair, requiring 50 Agility. For players wishing to swim through the acid in the entrance, 50 Constitution is required.

Gu'Tanoth.title: Gu'Tanoth

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to get to Gu'Tanoth is to use a Gu'Tanoth Teleport or modified shaman's headdress. It teleports the player directly north of Bogrog and allows fast access to the Summoning obelisk.
• Players can Home Teleport to the Yanille lodestone and run south.

Gu'Tanoth.summary: The second, Grud's Herblore Stall, is, as the name suggests, a store run by Grud that stocks ingredients used in the Herblore skill. Such items include vials and vial packs, pestles and mortars, eyes of newt, and eye of newt packs.

Gudrik.title: Gudrik
Gudrik.summary: He was an adventurer for over eighty years and claims to have explored "every dungeon, ruin and tomb" on RuneScape. He lost his left arm in a kalphite attack when he accidentally disturbed a hive in the Kharidian Desert.

Guildmaster.title: Guildmaster
Guildmaster.summary:
When asked for a quest, he directs players to Oziach, who in turn asks them to become a Dragon Slayer. He gives some backstory relating to the quest and provides the maze key necessary to enter Melzar's Maze. He also suggests asking Duke Horacio for dragonfire protection and asking about Port Sarim for a Crandorian ship.
clear | left

Guildmaster Darren Lightfinger.title: Darren Lightfinger
Guildmaster Darren Lightfinger.summary: He is rather charismatic and dramatic, prone to giving big and speeches to inspire his followers. Despite his grandeur, the Guild itself has been in operation a mere fortnight, attracting a total of three members, including himself. He describes himself as a scofflaw, thief and brigand, proudly boasting of his rebellion against what he claims are oppressive forces. However, he was unable to convince Ozan, a fellow master thief, to join, which he considers a missed opportunity.

Gulvas Mansion.title: Gulvas Mansion

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The quickest way to reach the mansion is with the teleport from the invitation box, which puts players near Maria. 
• Skeletal horror teleport places the player shortly north of the mansion.
• Teleport to Fort Forinthry lodestone and heading south-east to the mansion.
• Use an earth altar teleport and head east will bring players to the mansion.

Gulvas Mansion.summary: Gulvas Mansion is a large mansion on the southern side of Silvarea, serving as the setting for the Broken Home quest with which it was released. It is directly south of the Silvarea quarry.

Gunnarsgrunn.title: Barbarian Village

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The skull sceptre offers unlimited direct teleports to the centre of Barbarian Village
• Teleport to Falador lodestone and head east
• Teleport to Varrock lodestone go through the city and exit on the west side and continue west
• Teleport to Edgeville lodestone and head south

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Barbarian Village has two main entrances; east and west, and a few smaller ones. The western entrance has a road leading to Falador, while the eastern one leads to Varrock.

Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.

Gunnarsgrunn east entrance.png | Gunnarsgrunn eastern entrance
Gunnarsgrunn west entrance.png | Gunnarsgrunn western entrance

Gunnarsgrunn.summary: Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.

Guthix's Cave.title: Guthixian ruins

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the "Guthix's shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit or the modified diviner's headwear. 
• Use the fairy ring BLR or cape of legends to the Legends' Guild and running west.
• The combat bracelet can teleport the player to the Ranging Guild, north of the ruins.
• The master archaeologist's outfit can teleport to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site, north-west of the ruins.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run east.

Guthix's Cave.summary: The upper floor contains a monument to Guthix, attended by the Guthixian High Druid, a druid, and a druidess. Chronicle fragments and elder chronicles can be deposited at the monument for Divination experience. Offering 100 chronicle fragments at the monument unlocks the TitleAnchor | of Guthix title. Offering 100 elder chronicles at the monument unlocks the You're Not My Real Mah achievement.

Guthixian ruins.title: Guthixian ruins

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the "Guthix's shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit or the modified diviner's headwear. 
• Use the fairy ring BLR or cape of legends to the Legends' Guild and running west.
• The combat bracelet can teleport the player to the Ranging Guild, north of the ruins.
• The master archaeologist's outfit can teleport to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site, north-west of the ruins.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run east.

Guthixian ruins.summary: The upper floor contains a monument to Guthix, attended by the Guthixian High Druid, a druid, and a druidess. Chronicle fragments and elder chronicles can be deposited at the monument for Divination experience. Offering 100 chronicle fragments at the monument unlocks the TitleAnchor | of Guthix title. Offering 100 elder chronicles at the monument unlocks the You're Not My Real Mah achievement.

H.A.M. Hideout.title: H.A.M. Hideout
H.A.M. Hideout.summary: The main chamber is filled with both H.A.M. male members and H.A.M. female members, and H.A.M. Guards. The H.A.M. Deacon is on a podium preaching to his congregation about monsters, and other side rooms contain other H.A.M. members. Players can find Johanhus Ulsbrecht to the south-west, and Jimmy the Chisel is locked in a cell.

Hair of the Dog.title: Hair of the Dog
Hair of the Dog.summary: Several non-player characters inside play a role in several quests. The In Search of the Myreque quest can be started here by talking to Vanstrom Klause. Malak is involved in the Desert Treasure quest. Lex is the starting point of the miniquest the Lost Toys. The pickled brain needed in the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest can be found here.

Halia (divine merchant).title: Halia (divine merchant)
Halia (divine merchant).location: The Islands That Once Were Turtles

Hamal the Chieftain.title: Hamal the Chieftain
Hamal the Chieftain.summary: If asked, Hamal will explain that his tribe broke off from Rellekka because the Mountain Tribe wants to be closer to nature, and while the mainland Fremennik share their view of runestones, they still use magic, which Hamal views as a hypocrisy.

Hand (Back to my Roots).title: Hand (Back to my Roots)
Hand (Back to my Roots).quest:
Back to my Roots
One Foot in the Grave (miniquest)
Hand (Back to my Roots).summary: Once all of the parts are collected, they are buried in the open grave behind the Wizards' Guild.

Handelmort Mansion.title: Handelmort Mansion
Handelmort Mansion.summary: During Dishonour among Thieves, the player frees Jerrod from a cellar behind the mansion and recruits him to join Zamorak's team to steal the Stone of Jas from Sliske.

Harmony Island.title: Harmony Island

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Partial completion of The Great Brain Robbery is required to access Harmony Island.
• Speak to Brother Tranquillity on Mos Le'Harmless to teleport to Harmony Island
• Big Book o' Piracy teleport directly to the island

Harmony Island.summary:
• Speak to Brother Tranquillity on Mos Le'Harmless to teleport to Harmony Island
• Big Book o' Piracy teleport directly to the island

Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'.title: Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'
Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'.summary: The only personality of note on the floor 1 is Harpoon Joe himself. Not much is known about how Harpoon Joe lost his arm but players can ask him and he mentions a storm and an albatross before the player's character rudely interrupts him to make a joke.

Harvest Hollow.title: Harvest Hollow

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Casting Harvest Hollow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network
• Teleporting with the Harvest Hollow entry in the Calendar or Community events interface
• Entering the Harvest Hollow portal in the northern Grand Exchange
• Entering the Holiday portal in Prifddinas
• Teleporting with town criers

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
Maize Maze

Main | Maize Maze 
Players must work their way through an ever-changing maze, catching implings for weapons to spook the enemies in the maze while avoiding or defeating skeletons and zombies in order to get to the centre, where a Halloween-themed version of an in-game boss can be fought.

Defeating the boss awards 700 spooky tokens and some Maize Maze spoils depending on the currently active boss and the number of double and triple loot points the player has.

Strange and golden rocks for Agility can be found by jumping over the obstacles in the maze and for Hunter by catching the implings.

Graveyard

Players may find different skilling activities for Archaeology, Farming, Prayer, Summoning and Thieving whilst engaging with the graveyard in the Harvest Hollow.
• Mystery remains primarily for Archaeology
• Pumpkin patches for Farming (after completing Guys and Dolls quest.)
• Coffins and mausoleums primarily for Thieving
• Summoning circle primarily for Summoning
• Handing in Ancient remains for Prayer

Players may obtain spooky tokens from the activities. For hourly rates of obtaining spooky tokens, see Sl | Spooky tokens | #Estimated hourly rates .

Eep can be used…

Harvest Hollow.summary: Defeating the boss awards 700 spooky tokens and some Maize Maze spoils depending on the currently active boss and the number of double and triple loot points the player has.

Hassan.title: Grand Vizier Hassan
Hassan.summary:
Hassan is located in the throne room of Al Kharid palace. During and after completion of The Jack of Spades he moves to the south-west corner of the Merchant district of Menaphos, acting as the representative for Al Kharid.
Clear | left

Haunted Woods.title: Haunted Woods

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring ALQ is located in the middle of the Haunted Woods.
• Ectophial teleport to the Ectofuntus. Run south along the western wall of Port Phasmatys and then head west into the Haunted Woods.
• Canifis lodestone, head southeast into the woods.

Haunted Woods.summary: The Haunted Woods consist of a large, mostly dead and swampy vampyre-infested forest which covers a large portion of Morytania. It is located east of Canifis. It is the home of leeches, vampyres and hollow trees. There is a grave in the woods that must be found as a part of the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest. There is a fairy ring (code ALQ) south of the Port Phasmatys farming patch for quick access to Zanaris.

Havenhythe.title: Havenhythe

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Getting to Havenhythe for the first time requires starting and progressing through the quest Visions of Havenhythe, started at the Rusty Anchor Tavern in Port Sarim. If left prior to completing the quest, Captain Lorris is the only method to return to Havenhythe. After completing the quest, the following become available:
• Wendlewick lodestone located in Wendlewick.
• At level 28 Magic, Wendlewick Teleport can be cast on the standard spellbook, teleporting to the centre of the town.
• Fairy ring BKS takes you to the Shrine of Inanna, south of Wendlewick.
• Boss portals and their variants to Ivar, King of Bones and Silverquill, the Dreadhog.

After the village of Amberfell is visited for the first time, it can be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP.

Havenhythe.summary: In an update released on 1 June, members gained access to Amberfell, a village to the east accessed by repairing a bridge during the new quest Secrets of Amberfell. This was followed by the Moonrise Dig Site, a First Age-themed dig site.

Hazelmere's island.title: Hazelmere's island

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
One can use the fairy ring code CLS for quick transportation to and from the island. The fairy ring is located just behind Hazelmere's house.

Alternatively, use the Yanille lodestone and head east.

Hazelmere's island.summary: There are several Jungle spiders that reside in the small chain.

Head Chef.title: Head chef
Head Chef.summary: During Chef's Assistant the adventurer entered the guild and asks the head chef if he needs anything. The head chef tells them of his new creation and sends them off to collect the ingredients. He teaches the player how to make cheesecake and has them send some to his fellow members, the Lumbridge Cook, Mess Sergeant Ramsey and the Jolly Boar Inn cook as he has to stay in the guild in case someone wants to buy a cooking cape from him. All three members are impressed by his creation and nominate…

Head of the Family (miniquest).title: Head of the Family (miniquest)

getting_there.heading: Transport method
getting_there.text:
Talk to Rosie (supplies) at the Waiko market about the plight of the moai. She tells you to inquire with Sea Witch Kaula on Whale's Maw, who knows an ancient song about the transportation of moai. Visit her on the north-west part of Whale's Maw. The witch tells you the sad tale about the moai of Whale's Maw; out of curiosity about the ocean, he begged the islanders to bring him to the seaside. The islanders made a basket of bamboo, filled it with the island's soil, and placed the moai in it. The workers exhausted themselves pushing him to the edge of the water, only for the high tide to roll in. With the islanders too exhausted to push him back inland, he was swept away by the high tides and drowned, his death screams echoing through the moai network.

Returning to Rosie on Waiko, the two of you realise that moai can be moved as long as they remain in contact with the soil from their native island. She gives you a Soil bag and tells you to fill it with Aminishi soil. Head back to Aminishi, walk to the bottom of the steps and fill the bag (standing on the dock works). Head back to Rosie who asks for 5 bamboo and 150 chimes. From this, she will make a basket filled with Aminishi…

Head of the Family (miniquest).summary: Head of the Family (miniquest) is a part of the Tales of the Arc quest series.

Heart of Gielinor.title: Heart of Gielinor
Heart of Gielinor.teleport:
• The Heart teleport
• Boss portal
• Combat portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
• Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
• Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.
• The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
• Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
• Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
• Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a…

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
• Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
• Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
• Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
• Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros

Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.

Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

Heart of Gielinor.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).

Hefin Cathedral.title: Hefin Cathedral
Hefin Cathedral.summary: The roof of the cathedral is a part of the Hefin Agility Course.

Hefin district.title: Hefin district
Hefin district.teleport:
• Crystal teleport seed
• Attuned crystal teleport seed
Hefin district.summary:
• UL | type=ninja | update=Patch Notes (6 July 2015) | date=6 July 2015 
• Players can now teleport from the bridge and next to the bank chest on the Hefin agility course.

Helwyr.title: Helwyr

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Helwyr.summary: Obtaining all unique drops will unlock the TitleAnchor | t=Shapeshifter | c=#1F449C | loc=p title.

Hemenster.title: Hemenster

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Combat bracelet teleport to the Ranging Guild, go west.
• Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild, run northeast.
• Seers' Village lodestone and run southwest.
• Ardougne lodestone and run north.
• Dig sites map to Stormguard Citadel Dig Site and run northwest.
• Manor farm Teleport and run northwest.

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
• The Fishing Guild is located southwest of the Hemenster.
• The Ranging Guild is located east of the Hemenster. 
• The Goblin Cave and the Manor Farm could be found to the south of the Hemenster.

Hemenster.summary: There is also a Master Farmer near Mill Road Mill and Richard's Farming Shop found to the south of the village, who may be pickpocketed for seeds. Hemenster is also close to the main site for the Battle of Plain of Mud which took place near the modern day Fishing Guild.

Herb patch (Wilderness).title: Herb patch (Wilderness)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Wilderness sword 1 provides unlimited free teleports to the herb patch.
• Use a waka canoe from stations along the River Lum to the Wilderness (requires 57 Woodcutting)
• Use Wilderness Obelisk, obelisk shards, or portable obelisk to level 35 and run north-east
• Lodestone to Wilderness and run north around the Wilderness Crater
• Use the lever to the Deserted Keep and run south

Herb patch (Wilderness).summary: Any herb can be grown on the patch but more importantly this is the only place where players can grow bloodweed seeds. Bloodweed seed requires level 57 Farming to grow and planting it is one of the requirements of the achievements Come At Me, Bro!, Liquid Luck, and What Potion?.

Herblore Habitat.title: Herblore Habitat

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Witchdoctor mask teleport directly to Papa Mambo
• Using a Juju teleport spiritbag to teleport to Papa Mambo
• Remote access using Crop farmer outfit or Master farmer hat when worn and if witchdoctor mask or juju teleport spiritbag are owned in bank.
• Karamja gloves 3 or 4 teleport to the Shilo Village mine. Exit Shilo Village via the south-east entrance and then run east.
• Gnome glider to "Gandius" (Karamja). Run southwest, cross the stepping stones at the waterfall, run east, and then climb over the vine.

Herblore Habitat.summary: There are no level requirements to enter Herblore Habitat. For example, if a clue scroll requires a player to enter Herblore Habitat, they can enter the area and complete the scroll.

Here Be Penguins.title: Here Be Penguins
Here Be Penguins.summary: Here Be Penguins is a cluster of small arctic islands north of Etceteria and Miscellania that are only inhabited by penguins. One of the smaller islands can be accessed using fairy ring AJS, but the others can only be seen from the shore to the north-west of Miscellania and south-east of Etceteria. The island with the fairy ring contains a number of penguins, but no other features.

Heroes' Guild.title: Heroes' Guild

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
The Heroes' Guild is to the north of Taverley and to the south of Burthorpe. Several quick means of transportation are available:
• Players may teleport to their player-owned house in Taverley using the House Teleport spell. It will only work if the player's house is located in Taverley or if the player uses a chipped house teleport.
• Use the Home Teleport spell to teleport to Burthorpe and run south-east, or to Taverley and run north.
• A games necklace can teleport players to the Burthorpe Troll Invasion area. Each necklace has eight charges.
• A combat bracelet can teleport players to the Warriors' Guild in western Burthorpe.
• The balloon transport system can be used to fly to Taverley. Using the balloons requires at least partial completion of the Enlightened Journey quest.
• The Quest Cape or Master quest cape can teleport the player next to the Fountain of Heroes

Heroes' Guild.summary: The player also becomes a member of the guild, after Heroes' Quest.

Herquin's Gems.title: Herquin's Gems
Herquin's Gems.summary: The shop doesn't actually sell gems: it only has a player stock, and used to only sell gems that another player has sold to it. This changed with the Personalised Shops update, where it now only sells back the gems the player sold to the shop.

Het's Oasis.title: Het's Oasis
Het's Oasis.teleport:
• Archaeology teleport
• Dig sites map
• Master archaeologist's outfit
• Ring of duelling
• Volcanic trapper outfit

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
To access the north side and start of the Agility course:
• Teleport directly to Het's Oasis western entrance by using a ring of duelling.
• Teleport to the fire altar using a fire altar teleport tablet.
• Teleport to the Al Kharid mine or Garden of Kharid by using the dungeoneering cape, sand seed, or mystical sand seed and go south.
To access the south side:
• Teleport to the Kharid-et Dig Site by using the master archaeologist's outfit, an archaeology teleport, or using the dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild and go north.
• Teleport to Al Kharid by using the Lodestone Network and go north-east.
It is possible to move between the two areas on arrival, however the area is quite large and it is not possible to move through the middle of the Oasis.

Het's Oasis.summary: The Oasis Restoration time-limited event was released along with the area, and lasted for two weeks until 18 January 2022.

Hickton's Archery Emporium.title: Hickton's Archery Emporium
Hickton's Archery Emporium.summary: Unlike most archery stores, Hickton's Archery Emporium stocks arrowtips for players who wish to create their own arrows using the Fletching skill. For players with level 99 in Fletching, the Fletching cape will be available in the stock.

High Priest (Sophanem).title: High Priest (Sophanem)
High Priest (Sophanem).summary: The priest also and starts and finishes the Contact! quest and is also the starting figure in Dealing with Scabaras, though his role in this is minor.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Wendlewick lodestone or Wendlewick Teleport and walk north
• Stonevein amulet Key press | Spider and go west.

Hild.title: Hild
Hild.summary: She also plays a small part in one of Meg's cases, One Small Theft, where it is revealed that her supply of runes was stolen.

Hill Giant.title: Hill giant
Hill Giant.summary: Edgeville Dungeon and the resource dungeon within is a popular location to fight them, as both a bank and the Grand Exchange are close by. The dungeons may be accessed through the trapdoor in the ruins south of Edgeville, or in a hut west of the Cooks' Guild if the player has a brass key.

Hobgoblin Peninsula.title: Hobgoblin Peninsula

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Skills necklace teleport to the Crafting Guild.
• Home Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and then walk northwest.

Hobgoblin Peninsula.summary: It contains 10 Hobgoblins, all of which are level 15 except for one that is level 18. Players can safely kill them with Ranged or Magic from the raised area just west of the Crafting Guild entrance.

Hollow Hill.title: Hollow Hill

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Take the canoe station to the stop. [Chat: 2 Wendlewick (Farm)] Then run north.
• Use an attuned boss portal in War's Retreat or the combat portal in the Max Guild to teleport to Ivar.
• Stonevein amulet Key press | Spider located north in Hollow Hill.

Hollow Hill.summary: There is a cave in Hollow Hill that contains the new Havenhythe Big Game Hunter activity, a number of shops and a bonfire.

Hops Patch.title: Hops Patch

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: Hops patch locations

Hops Patch.summary: Hops Patches are a type of Farming patches which require 4 seeds (or 3 for jute seeds) to plant, starting at level 3 Farming. Hops patches produce a minimum of 3 hops when fully grown, and once harvested, the patch is clear for re-planting.

Horacio.title: Horacio
Horacio.quest: Tribal Totem, Back to my Roots
Horacio.summary: He starts the quest Back to my Roots, and plays a minor role in the quest Tribal Totem.

Horvik's Armour Shop.title: Horvik's Armour Shop
Horvik's Armour Shop.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Personalised Shops | date=2 September 2009 
• Increased stock of all items to 10.

Ice Mountain.title: Ice Mountain

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players can walk there fairly easily from Falador (go north and north-east) and from the region of the Barbarian Village and Edgeville (go west). Other transport routes to the mountain include:
• Use a Combat bracelet to teleport to the Monastery and go south and west. This is the faster way to reach the ramp to the mountain.
• Cast Lassar Teleport from Ancient Magicks to teleport on top of mountain.
• Enter the Dwarven Mines from Falador (either directly or via the Mining Guild) and travel to the mine's exit on the mountain.
• Use the mine cart system to go to the Dwarven Mines and then exit onto the mountain. Players can enter the cart system in Keldagrim or in the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain.
• Use a Skull sceptre to teleport to Gunnarsgrunn and then walk west to the mountain.
• Use the Wicked hood (or another means) to teleport to the Body altar, then walk a short way northwest, or the Mind altar, then walk east.

Ice Mountain.summary: Beneath the surface, Ice Mountain is filled with a massive underground network that stretches far beyond the mountain's edges. Both the dwarves of Keldagrim and Imcando dwarves have connected the mountain to the Dwarven Realm, leading to the establishment of subterranean Dwarven Mines, Camdozaal, and the Ice Mountain Dwarven Colony. The Kinshra formerly used the area as a slave mine, although today their only subterranean work on the mountain is in the Black Knights' Catacombs. Even further…

Ice Path.title: Ice Path
Ice Path.summary: Because of the extremely cold conditions, players cannot run after passing the ice gate (although this effect can be countered by bathing in salt-water spring in the spa at Oo'glog) and will have their life points periodically reduced by 200. Other stats (except Constitution and Prayer) are also reduced in the same fashion by one while on the Ice Path. Overloads can however be used to preserve combat stats, similarly extreme potions can preserve their respective stats through reapplication.…

Ice Queen's Lair.title: Ice Queen's lair
Ice Queen's Lair.summary: When attempting to defeat the Ice Queen, if a player stands to the eastern side of the Queen's throne, the surrounding warriors will not be able to continue following the player, while the player can still be set in a position to attack the Ice Queen.

Ice Queen's lair.title: Ice Queen's lair
Ice Queen's lair.summary: When attempting to defeat the Ice Queen, if a player stands to the eastern side of the Queen's throne, the surrounding warriors will not be able to continue following the player, while the player can still be set in a position to attack the Ice Queen.

Ice strykewyrm cave.title: Ice strykewyrm cave
Ice strykewyrm cave.teleport:
• Fairy ring DKS
• Fremennik Province lodestone
• Mask of the White Wyrm
• Helm of the Frozen Wyrm

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fastest way to get to the cave is by using either Mask of the White Wyrm or Helm of the Frozen Wyrm
• Using the Fremennik Province lodestone and walking North-east
• Using the Fairy ring DKS to teleport near the cave entrance

Ice strykewyrm cave.summary:
• Fremennik Province lodestone
• Mask of the White Wyrm
• Helm of the Frozen Wyrm
music: The Muspah's Tomb
map: Map | mtype=square | x=2739 | y=3730 

The ice cave, also known as the Ice strykewyrm cave, is an icy cave that is unlocked after The Tale of the Muspah.

Iceberg.title: Iceberg

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Find Larry who is stationed by his boat to the north-east of Rellekka on the pier (outside the fence area), and talk to him.
• After starting Hunt for Red Raktuber, Larry gives players the ability to use the boat for themselves to get to the Iceberg.

Iceberg.summary: The Iceberg is a large piece of ice floating in the sea, and serves as a major location for the quests, Cold War, Hunt for Red Raktuber and Back to the Freezer. It appears to be almost devoid of features, with the only two icons on the world map being "transportation" () and "Agility training" (). While currently, this is the closest location to a "penguin base", it is not their mainland. It is discovered in Hunt for Red Raktuber that penguins have a mainland which they refer to as the…

Ichi.title: Ichi
Ichi.quest: Eye for an Eye, Desperate Times, Desperate Measures
Ichi.summary: He later represents his people as part of Seren's council during Desperate Times.

Icthlarin.title: Icthlarin
Icthlarin.summary:
, The Unceasing, Voice of the Sun, Opener of the Ways, The Dog Lord, Guardian of Souls, Herdsmen of the Dead, The Dog, The Stranger

Icyene graveyard.title: Icyene graveyard

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: It can be reached by using the shortcut in the south of the entrance area of the dig site. Icyene graveyard can also be accessed during and after the quest The Lord of Vampyrium via the boat in Burgh de Rott.

Icyene graveyard.summary: Gravestones and unfinished grave plots can be found scattering the area, with many tombstones depicting the names and a brief description of dead or fallen Icyene. Five of the tombstones are scratched out with animal marking and cannot be read.

Ikadia the Exile.title: Ikadia the Exile

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
mem: yes
mapID: 17
leagueRegion: Asgarnia | npcid:18317,x:2931,y:9853 
LocTableBottom

Ikadia the Exile.summary: She is found and fought during the grandmaster quest Birthright of the Dwarves. She first appears after killing some of the chaos dwarves in Taverley Dungeon and offers information about them if the player has defeated her in combat. She uses a variety of Magic abilities against the player in battle, much like NPCs from Wilderness Warbands.

Invention Guild.title: Invention Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Map | mtype=square | x=2997 | y=3440 | align=right | caption=Invention Guild entrance location 
• A skill portal in the Max Guild garden can be attuned to the Invention Guild. It teleports the player inside. A grace of the elves will teleport the player to the portals' attuned locations.
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Teleporting to the Falador lodestone and running north-east.
• A games necklace can teleport the player to the Gamers' Grotto, by the exit. Upon exiting, the entrance to the Invention Guild will be to the north.

Invention Guild.summary: Players have access to a Human divination workshop with an Inventor's workbench at level 1 Invention and then choose between a Cave goblin technology tree and workshop and a Dwarven technology tree and workshop at level 40 Invention.

Iorwerth Clan.title: Iorwerth Clan
Iorwerth Clan.summary: The Iorwerth Clan is one of the eight elven clans that inhabit Tirannwn. Their former leader, Warmaster Lord Iorwerth, is the initiator of the Elven Civil War due to conquering Prifddinas and seizing the Tower of Voices and the Grand Library, denying access to the city to non-Iorwerth elves. The civil war, which has caused the deaths of thousands of elves, is the reason for the Iorwerth Clan being regarded as an enemy to elven society. Although they were initially followers of Seren, the…

Iorwerth district.title: Iorwerth district
Iorwerth district.teleport:
• Crystal teleport seed
• Attuned crystal teleport seed
Iorwerth district.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (29 September 2014) | date=29 September 2014 
• Dreadnips may no longer be deployed against Cadarn and Iorweth elves.

Irwinsson.title: Irwinsson
Irwinsson.summary: Irwinsson and his father Sigli feature in the miniquest Father and Son.

Isafdar.title: Isafdar
Isafdar.teleport:
• Attuned crystal teleport seed
• Crystal teleport seed
• Tirannwn lodestone
• Tirannwn quiver 1/2/3/4

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Partial completion of the quest Regicide is required to access Isafdar.
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport is located in the south of Isafdar
• Tirannwn quiver 1, Crystal teleport seed, or Attuned crystal teleport seed to Lletya and then exit Lletya to the west into Isafdar
• Tirannwn quiver 2, 3, and 4 offer additional teleport locations around Isafdar — the Tyras Camp and the Elf Camp, respectively
• Players who have not yet unlocked the Tirannwn lodestone will need to begin Regicide and traverse the entire Underground Pass in order to access Isafdar.

Isafdar.summary: Isafdar is located just west of Lletya and south of Prifddinas, the Elven City. It is reachable by the Underground Pass to the east, by Arandar to the north-east, and the Tirannwn lodestone in the southern part of the forest.

Islwyn.title: Islwyn

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
Islwyn can be found roaming the forests around Tirannwn with his companion Eluned, going between the magic trees outside Lletya and the clearing north-east of Tyras Camp (You can go to one of them, if Islwyn isn't there, switch worlds until you find him). One can find him by taking a charter boat to port Tyras, running north, going through a dense forest obstacle, then slightly east and south across a stick trap to reach the clearing or by teleporting to the Tirannwn lodestone, running north-east, through the obstacle, and then run south.

After The Light Within, Islwyn can also be found in the Ithell district of Prifddinas, replacing Eluned. There, he will recharge crystal seeds for players in her stead. If players chose not to sacrifice Eluned in the quest, he will also give players a letter from Eluned.

Islwyn.summary: Upon completion of Roving Elves, he will sell players new Crystal equipment without the need of crystal seeds. He will sell players a new crystal bow for 1,000,000 coins or a new Crystal ward for 1,000,000 coins. The "new" bow or shield can be traded until it is used once. After The Light Within, he will additionally enchant crystal items in Prifddinas and will also enchant crystal teleport seeds to allow travel to the Temple of Light in the event that the player didn't let Eluned enchant it…

Ithell Clan.title: Ithell Clan
Ithell Clan.summary: Not very much is known about the Ithell Clan. They were first mentioned in the Crystal of Seren book: in which it is said that the Ithell Clan are famous for their crystal singing. Most crystal chanters come from this clan, while very few come from any other of the seven clans. Additionally, they are artisans skilled in Construction and Crafting.

Ivy Sophista.title: Ivy Sophista
Ivy Sophista.summary: Her house also contains the crystal chest. If asked, she will tell players about the crystal key, which is used to open the chest and take the loot inside. She also alludes to the crystal triskelion key, which can be used to unlock loot of greater value.

Jade Vine Maze.title: Jade vine maze

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Some modes of transportation are:
• Eagle transport system
• Elder divination outfit - Equip the full outfit, right click the head and select "Colony teleport", then select the Gleaming wisps (50+) option and lastly walk south to the maze.
• Shilo Village - walk east from Shilo Village, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.
• Nature altar teleport and teleport to the nature altar, walk south east.
• Abyss - get to the Nature altar through the Abyss, exit the altar, and walk south-east to the maze. (You can also use a teleport tablet to get to the nature altar.)
• Charter ship to the Shipyard
• Gnome glider to Gandius - south of the Shipyard
• Tai Bwo Wannai teleport and then running south-east from the village.
• Witchdoctor mask or Juju teleport spiritbag to teleport to the Herblore Habitat, walk west, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.

 class="wikitable" | + The entrance to the maze | | Object map | objectname=Vine | objectid:27127,x:2888,y:3006 | group=27127

Jade Vine Maze.summary: The jade vine maze was released on October 2007, along with the Back to my Roots quest. It is located just east of Shilo Village. The maze is heavily featured in the Back to my Roots quest, and the follow-up miniquest One Foot in the Grave. The maze is accessed during the Back to my Roots quest, and completion of the quest is required in order to use the eagle transport system to access the maze.

Jade vine maze.title: Jade vine maze

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Some modes of transportation are:
• Eagle transport system
• Elder divination outfit - Equip the full outfit, right click the head and select "Colony teleport", then select the Gleaming wisps (50+) option and lastly walk south to the maze.
• Shilo Village - walk east from Shilo Village, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.
• Nature altar teleport and teleport to the nature altar, walk south east.
• Abyss - get to the Nature altar through the Abyss, exit the altar, and walk south-east to the maze. (You can also use a teleport tablet to get to the nature altar.)
• Charter ship to the Shipyard
• Gnome glider to Gandius - south of the Shipyard
• Tai Bwo Wannai teleport and then running south-east from the village.
• Witchdoctor mask or Juju teleport spiritbag to teleport to the Herblore Habitat, walk west, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.

 class="wikitable" | + The entrance to the maze | | Object map | objectname=Vine | objectid:27127,x:2888,y:3006 | group=27127

Jade vine maze.summary: The jade vine maze was released on October 2007, along with the Back to my Roots quest. It is located just east of Shilo Village. The maze is heavily featured in the Back to my Roots quest, and the follow-up miniquest One Foot in the Grave. The maze is accessed during the Back to my Roots quest, and completion of the quest is required in order to use the eagle transport system to access the maze.

Jadinko Lair.title: Jadinko Lair

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The fastest method to get to the Jadinko Lair is using the teleport option on the Mask of Vines or Helm of Mutation, bought from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 72 million shattered anima. This mask/helm gives 2 free teleports directly to the Jadinko Lair each day. 

Players can also tune their Skill portal in the Max Guild's garden to the Jadinko Lair, teleporting them next to the Jadinko Queen. This in turn also allows players to use a Grace of the elves which can access the skill portals remotely. Alternatively the Skill portal can be tuned to the Overgrown Idol, which will teleport the player to the Overgrown Idol just north of the entrance to the Jadinko Lair.

There are several other ways to get to the Jadinko Lair quickly:
• Teleport to the Herblore Habitat with a juju teleport spiritbag or witchdoctor mask, crossing the vine in the north, and running west to jump over the waterfall. The entrance to the Lair is north-east of the stepping stones over the waterfall.
• Travel to Shilo Village by either the Shilo Village cart system or Karamja gloves 3/4, crossing over the broken cart in the south-eastern side of the village, and walking east towards the Lair entrance.
•…

Jadinko Lair.summary: You must be able to access the Kharazi Jungle.

Jadinko lair.title: Jadinko Lair

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The fastest method to get to the Jadinko Lair is using the teleport option on the Mask of Vines or Helm of Mutation, bought from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 72 million shattered anima. This mask/helm gives 2 free teleports directly to the Jadinko Lair each day. 

Players can also tune their Skill portal in the Max Guild's garden to the Jadinko Lair, teleporting them next to the Jadinko Queen. This in turn also allows players to use a Grace of the elves which can access the skill portals remotely. Alternatively the Skill portal can be tuned to the Overgrown Idol, which will teleport the player to the Overgrown Idol just north of the entrance to the Jadinko Lair.

There are several other ways to get to the Jadinko Lair quickly:
• Teleport to the Herblore Habitat with a juju teleport spiritbag or witchdoctor mask, crossing the vine in the north, and running west to jump over the waterfall. The entrance to the Lair is north-east of the stepping stones over the waterfall.
• Travel to Shilo Village by either the Shilo Village cart system or Karamja gloves 3/4, crossing over the broken cart in the south-eastern side of the village, and walking east towards the Lair entrance.
•…

Jadinko lair.summary: You must be able to access the Kharazi Jungle.

Jailer.title: Jailer

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Jailer.summary: The Jailer is in the Black Knights' Base in Taverley Dungeon and must be killed if one wants to go deeper into the dungeon. For example, in the Scorpion Catcher and in the Heroes' Quest, you need to kill the Jailer, pick up the jail key he drops, open the jail door with the key and get the Dusty key from Velrak the Explorer. You can do this several times to get more Dusty keys, or you can just do the drop trick (although the player only needs one key and can pick up another Dusty key further…

Jaldraocht Pyramid.title: Jaldraocht Pyramid
Jaldraocht Pyramid.teleport:
• Pharaoh's sceptre
• Sceptre of the gods

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Jaldraocht teleport of the Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the Gods takes players directly there.
• Use a camulet and teleporting just northwest of the pyramid.
• Bandit Camp lodestone teleport to Bandit Camp after completing Desert Treasure and walk south to the pyramid.
• Magic carpet to Menaphos (required Icthlarin's Little Helper) and going north. The magic carpet network can be accessed immediately south of Shantay Pass, which can be teleported to with broomstick or amulet of glory.
• Ring of slaying teleport to Pollnivneach and run southwest.
• Portmaster Kags in the Menaphos Port district.

Jaldraocht Pyramid.summary: After completion of the Desert Treasure quest, players can buy the Ancient staff from Eblis for 80,000 coins. If they happen to lose it, they can buy one from another player or kill mummies inside Jaldraocht for another.

Jalsavrah Pyramid.title: Jalsavrah Pyramid
Jalsavrah Pyramid.teleport:
• Pharaoh's sceptre
• Sceptre of the gods

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The fastest way to get to the pyramid and Sophanem in general, is the using the Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the gods. 
The next fastest way is teleporting to Nardah with the Desert amulet 2 or higher and running down to Sophanem.

Jalsavrah Pyramid.summary: The Jalsavrah Pyramid is the location of the Pyramid Plunder minigame.

Jaraah.title: Jaraah
Jaraah.summary:
Jaraah is the answer to the Treasure Trails anagram clue "AHA JAR".
Clear | left

Jatizso dungeon mine.title: Jatizso dungeon mine
Jatizso dungeon mine.location: Entrance by the north wall of Jatizso
Jatizso dungeon mine.summary: The entrance to the mine is guarded by Gruva Patrull, located just outside the western gates of Jatizso. The mine is inhabited by several miners. Additionally, the northern half of the mine is occupied by several ice troll males (melee), ice troll females (ranged) and ice troll runts. The trolls can and do attack and kill the miners (which have 1 life point and dies to one hit) within their reach.

Jelly.title: Jelly

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Jelly.summary: They are notable for being able to drop hard clue scrolls despite their low level, as they are one of the weakest creatures that drop them. However, at higher levels it is not recommended to kill them for clue scrolls, as hellhounds and glacytes provide better drop rates.

Jerico.title: Jerico
Jerico.location: East Ardougne, in a house south of north-west bank
Jerico.summary:
He has several friends in Ardougne, such as Edmond, Omart and Kilron. When Elena wanted to study the plague, he helped the adventurer who rescued her to sneak over the wall in order to retrieve her distillator, which had been stolen by the mourners. He distracted the mourners watching the gate by releasing several of his pigeons, allowing the adventurer to climb over and into the quarantined city.
clear | left

Jhallan's resting place.title: Jhallan's resting place
Jhallan's resting place.summary: During The Tale of the Muspah, Jhallan the Mahjarrat tells players that this cavern is below a ritual stone involved in the Ritual of Rejuvenation. After releasing him from his previous hibernation spot, the player meets Jhallan here and helps him find a peaceful hibernation area where he can wait, encased in ice, until the Ritual happens.

Jiggig.title: Jiggig

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars. Run south, out of the Castle Wars lobby, to Jiggig
• Fairy ring code ALP leads to a cave near Jiggig. Exit the cave and run north. Requires completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

Jiggig.summary: These ogres are very resistant to normal weapons, which will have a much lower maximum hit and reduced accuracy, but Necromancy and brutal arrows are effective.

Jiggig Dungeon.title: Jiggig Dungeon
Jiggig Dungeon.teleport:
• Ring of duelling
• Fairy ring ALP
Jiggig Dungeon.summary: The main points of interest during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest are the skeleton lying on a broken lectern in the north-west corner, and the entrance to the level below to the west. The locked ogre stone doors can only be opened during the quest, using the ogre gate key given to the player by Grish. The player will find Slash Bash in the bottom level.

Jimmy Dazzler.title: Jimmy Dazzler
Jimmy Dazzler.summary: He is located in the house to the west of the Flying Horse Inn and north of the castle in East Ardougne.

Jolly Boar Inn.title: Jolly Boar Inn
Jolly Boar Inn.summary: Several non-player characters inside play a role in several quests. The Cook is involved in the Chef's Assistant quest and Johnathon is involved in the Family Crest quest. During Ancient Awakening, Bill and Ellamaria are found in the bar.

Jones.title: Jones
Jones.summary: During the quest Deadliest Catch, he requested the aid of a passing adventurer, stating that he had a plan to catch the Thalassus, but he couldn't do it by himself. He asked them to find somebody to create a giant harpoon from his plans, obtain a sea chart from the Master fisher, and recruit his cousin Julian to row the boat. Once these were obtained, the three of them set off north in his boat.

Jorral.title: Jorral
Jorral.quest: Making History, Meeting History, The Slug Menace
Jorral.summary: Players who added the enchanted key to the steel key ring before 24 September 2018, when checking the tool belt options interface, will find that it has been removed, and must be reclaimed from Jorral at the Outpost for 6,000 coins, whose dialogue will act as if the player destroyed it instead.

Kal'gerion resource dungeon.title: Kal'gerion resource dungeon
Kal'gerion resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Using the hoardstalker ring obtained from Sinkholes, or using the Dungeoneering cape perk (0,9), are the most convenient methods of reaching the dungeon. Players can also use the ring of kinship and run south-west of their location to reach the dungeon. It is also very close to the Wilderness entrance to Daemonheim, however players cannot pass into Daemonheim if they are in combat.

Kal'gerion resource dungeon.summary: Inside is a cavern that contains 13 Kal'gerion demons, which players can kill for their valuable drops and most notably, demon slayer equipment. This place is the one of two locations where the demons can be found. Kal'gerion resource dungeon also contains a mine with several rare gem rocks.

Kalphite Hive.title: Kalphite Hive

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring BIQ is quite near the surface entrance to the hive. When travelling through the desert, players should have a water source (like Waterskins) and perhaps wear Desert clothing, to protect against the effects of Desert heat.
• Players will need a rope to enter the hive from the surface the first time they come, and another to enter the area containing the Kalphite Queen. Good food and maybe prayer potions are advised if you are to visit the queen.
• There is an alternative underground entrance to this dungeon from the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon, which avoids the desert heat and the need for one of the ropes. However, players should have a light source when travelling through the south dungeon. Fairy ring to Dorgesh-Kaan dungeon is AJQ.

Kalphite Hive.summary: The upper level has many Kalphite workers and some Kalphite soldiers. Two Kalphite Guardians watch the exit to the second level. Three Potato cactus spawn in a chamber on this level. Kalphite larva, which cannot be attacked except by Cats, roam the level.

Kandarin.title: Kandarin

getting_there.heading: Other notable locations
getting_there.text:
• Baxtorian Falls
• Camelot
• Castle Wars
• Coal truck mining site
• Fishing Guild
• Khazard Battlefield
• Legends' Guild
• Magic Guild
• The Observatory
• Piscatoris Hunter area
• Ranging Guild
• Sinclair Mansion

Kandarin.summary: Kandarin is a wealthy kingdom, and nearly as powerful as the Kingdom of Misthalin. It gathers much of its wealth through industries in places such as Seers' Village and Yanille. It also trades with many of its bordering nations. It is even claimed that Kandarin has connections to lands far to the west where not many humans have ventured to.

Kaqemeex.title: Kaqemeex
Kaqemeex.summary: Kaqemeex is the start point of the quest Druidic Ritual, the quest required to start learning the skill of Herblore. During the quest, players learn that he is the master for Herblore. Members who have achieved level 99 in Herblore may buy the Herblore cape and hood for 99,000 coins (or at 'half price' of only 92,000 coins while wearing the ring of charos (a) or its imbued version). Members who have achieved true skill mastery by reaching virtual level 120 (equivalent to 104,273,167 experience)…

Karamja.title: Karamja

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are many ways to travel to, from, and within Karamja.

Ship

A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim by talking to the men in front of the ship (first ship you come across heading east from the Port Sarim Lodestone), which costs 30gp for the trip. This can be reduced to 15gp, if you're a member, by completing the easy Karamja achievements, and completely free by using the Ring of charos(a). Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.

Karamja.summary: Regular service costs 30 coins to utilise; charter service is significantly more expensive, depending on the route.

Karamja Volcano.title: Karamja Volcano
Karamja Volcano.teleport:
• TokKul-Zo
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• TokKul-Zo teleport to the main plaza of TzHaar City. Run south and exit the city.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to the resource dungeon within the Karamja dungeon. Exit the Karamja dungeon.
• Teleport to house (chipped) to the Brimhaven house portal. Run east through the members gate, to the volcano.

Karamja Volcano.summary: The Volcano appears to be dormant, as no recent activity has been noticed, despite of the balls of lava shooting out of the pool of magma. This may occur because of the TzHaar living inside.

Karamja Volcano resource dungeon.title: Karamja Volcano resource dungeon
Karamja Volcano resource dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
Karamja Volcano resource dungeon.summary: The Karamja Volcano resource dungeon is a resource dungeon located underneath the Karamja volcano in the south-west area after entering. The entrance is located next to the entrance to the Tzhaar City. A Dungeoneering level of 25 is required to enter. Players will be granted 2,100 Dungeoneering experience upon first entrance to the dungeon. This resource dungeon is one of the 5 free-to-play resource dungeons.

Karim.title: Karim
Karim.summary:
When talked to, Karim sells kebabs for 1 coin each. However, he doesn't have an actual store interface, or a buy x option, so it takes 4 clicks to buy 1 kebab; buying one inventory of kebabs using the bank to the south takes about 90 seconds.
clear | left

Keep Le Faye.title: Keep Le Faye

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: Keep Le Faye is located on the east coast of Kandarin. It is built on a peninsula. The fishing town of Catherby is north, the Sorcerer's Tower to the west, and the Legends' Guild to the south. To the south-west is the capital of Kandarin, the large city of Ardougne.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring code BLR to the Legends' Guild and run north.
• Home teleport to Catherby and run south along the coastline.
• Cape of legends teleport to the Legends' Guild, exit through the gate, and run north.
• Elder divination outfit to glowing wisp colony

Keep Le Faye.summary: Keep Le Faye is a keep south-west of Catherby. It plays a relatively large role in the quests Merlin's Crystal and King's Ransom. The keep is the home of Morgan Le Faye. It is the base of the Renegade Knights and sees to a small amount of trade with Catherby.

Keldagrim.title: Keldagrim

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• First time from the Keldagrim entrance tunnel east of Rellekka.
• The Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring provide unlimited teleports to the west side of the Palace floor 1.
• Players with access to Keldagrim can use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to arrive in East Keldagrim. A luck ring such as the Ring of Wealth or higher variants can also teleport a short distance from the trapdoor using the Grand Exchange teleport option.
• The master camouflage outfit provides unlimited teleports to the Consortium (0, 1), the top floor of the palace in the centre of Keldagrim. This allows convenient access to both the east and west side of Keldagrim. Other variants of this outfit will also teleport players to this location five times per day.
• Players may buy a one-way rail cart ticket to Keldagrim from one of the cart conductors in the Dwarven Mine under White Wolf Mountain or a free train ride from Dorgesh-Kaan.
• Players may also use the Fremennik Province lodestone, run north-east, and enter the cave entrance to the east with two statues. Once inside, there is another entrance with two statues directly in front of the player. Enter this,…

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
Dwarven Boatman.png | Dwarven Boatman
Dwarven Ferryman (east).png | The dwarven ferryman on the eastern shore.
Dwarven Ferryman (west).png | The dwarven ferryman on the western shore.
Dwarven Boatman (ore hauler).png | Dwarven Boatman
Cart conductor (Keldagrim).png | Cart Conductor
Ticket dwarf.png | Ticket dwarf

Keldagrim.summary: South of the city is a massive mine, including a mineral vein, where Dwarves carve away at the rock in search of the valuable gems and ore that have allowed Keldagrim to thrive longer than almost any other civilisation in RuneScape. Many ferries service the mines, carrying miners, adventurers, and ore to and from the city by travelling along the ever-flowing River Kelda.

Keldagrim Entrance.title: Keldagrim entrance tunnel
Keldagrim Entrance.summary: The purpose to enter this tunnel is to enter Keldagrim, and leaving from Trollweiss Mountain during the quest Troll Romance after picking trollweiss flowers.

Keldagrim Palace.title: Keldagrim Palace
Keldagrim Palace.summary: The palace is amongst the oldest structures in Gielinor, having been built during the city's early days approximately 6,000 years ago. Today it continues to stand, serving as a constant reminder of the Consortium's power and the ingenuity of the dwarves.

Keldagrim Watchtower.title: Keldagrim Watchtower
Keldagrim Watchtower.summary: The only known major event to have occurred in the Watchtower is seen during the Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf quest. During the quest, a Black Guard patrol led by Colonel Grenda was attacked by a group of chaos dwarves in the mines while on a routine police mission. Six members of the Black Guard were killed before an adventurer and Commander Veldaban arrived. Working together, the two killed the last surviving chaos dwarf hand cannoneer, who was hiding on the top floor of the tower. The event…

Kennith.title: Kennith
Kennith.summary:
Talk-To, Give-orders, Examine 
• Talk-To, Examine

• He doesn't seem very concerned about anything.
• He looks like he's calmed down.
examine2: * He looks a little sinister.
• Very scary!
examine3: He looks taller now.

Kharazi Jungle.title: Kharazi Jungle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• When travelling from Shilo Village, players should stand north of the bush just south-west of the city and then cut two bushes to enter the jungle.
• The fairy ring CJS can be used to teleport to the area. It must first be restored with 5 bittercap mushrooms before travelling to or from it.
• A juju teleport spiritbag or witchdoctor mask can teleport the player to the nearby Herblore Habitat. The player can then reach the jungle by climbing over the vine to the north, heading west along the river, and hacking through the dense jungle to the south.
• Casting the Western Kharazi Jungle Teleport while on the Lunar spellbook will teleport you to the western side of the Kharazi jungle, a short distance west of the small pool located in the center & south-west of the village past the dense forests. This spell requires level 81 Magic and 3 astral runes, 2 law runes and 1 time rune to cast.

Kharazi Jungle.summary: Roughly in the centre of the jungle is a pond with special water with a patch nearby for planting yommi tree seeds. There are also several black totem poles which must be disposed of.

Kharidian Desert.title: Kharidian Desert

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
The main form of transportation in the desert is by Magic carpet. They can take the player to a variety of places in the desert, such as: 

# Al Kharid (south of Shantay Pass)
# North Pollnivneach
# South Pollnivneach
# Nardah
# Bedabin Camp
# Uzer (requires The Golem)
# Monkey colony (requires Do No Evil)
# Menaphos (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)
# Sophanem (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)

The normal cost of such travel is roughly 200 coins. However, doing the Rogue Trader activity or wearing the activated ring of Charos will decrease the price to 100 coins, and combining them both lowers it to 75 coins.

There are also several fairy rings located in the desert.

Wearing armour of any kind is not advisable, as due to its metallic nature the player will overheat faster and thus use up their supply of water quicker.

Kharidian Desert.summary:
Tumeken's Demise

The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. It spans from the city of Al Kharid in the north to Menaphos and Sophanem in the south. Al Kharid is accessible by all players alike, but the desert south of the Shantay Pass is restricted to members only. In addition, the desert becomes a dangerous region south of the pass, requiring players to…

Kharl.title: Kharl
Kharl.summary:
He can assign City Quests.
Clear | left

Kharshai.title: Kharshai
Kharshai.summary:
A powerful Mahjarrat.
• A powerful Mahjarrat, enjoying the history of his adopted people.
• A powerful mahjarrat.

Khazard Fight Arena.title: Fight Arena (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the Fairy ring code DJP and run south.
• Use the Ardougne lodestone, walk South through the Zoo and past the Monastery.
• Take a charter-ship to Port Khazard and walk West.
• Use the Ardougne Cloak to teleport to Ardougne Monastery and continue South East.
• Use the Yanille lodestone, walk East through the city and continue North.

Khazard Fight Arena.summary: The Fight Arena plays a large role in the quest Fight Arena. The only useful facilities that can be found here are the 4 water supplies and the bar to the west. Khazard armour can be obtained here by searching the armoury in the northeastern house. Other than this, the area has no other use and cannot be accessed again after completing the quest. If attempted, the doorman will say "You're him/her! The one who beat the General/General's Pet! Begone, murderer!".

Kili.title: Kili
Kili.summary: She is the city blacksmith and teaches the player how to upgrade Death Skull equipment, deathwarden robe armour, and deathdealer robe armour, starting with the Kili Row quest and continued in the Kili's Knowledge achievements.

Killerwatt Plane.title: Killerwatt Plane
Killerwatt Plane.summary: The plane hosts some killerwatts, and some small storm clouds, like the ones found in Zanaris, are also seen here. Players can exit via the portal going back to Professor Oddenstein's room or by simply teleporting out.

King Arthur.title: King Arthur
King Arthur.summary: After completing the Holy Grail, players can mount a painting of King Arthur on a wall in their Player-owned house.

King Black Dragon's Lair.title: King Black Dragon's Lair
King Black Dragon's Lair.summary: As with all other teleportation methods, if the player is Teleport Blocked, they will be unable to use the lever in Wilderness until the spell effect is removed.

King Bolren.title: King Bolren
King Bolren.quest: Tree Gnome Village, The Path of Glouphrie, The Prisoner of Glouphrie
King Bolren.summary: Bolren is a possible customer (a hard order) in the Gnome Restaurant minigame and players must speak to him for the treasure trail anagram 'Goblin Kern'.

King Gjuki Sorvott IV.title: King Gjuki Sorvott IV
King Gjuki Sorvott IV.summary: King Sorvott plays a large role in The Fremennik Isles quest, which deals with his rivalry with the neighbouring nation of Neitiznot.

King Narnode Shareen.title: King Narnode Shareen
King Narnode Shareen.quest: The Eyes of Glouphrie, The Grand Tree, Monkey Madness, Desperate Times, Desperate Measures
King Narnode Shareen.summary: To help expand the gnomish empire, Narnode has sent many explorers to discover the unknown, along with ambassadors to create relationships with the humans and dwarves.

King Roald.title: King Roald
King Roald.summary:
of the King of Varrock.

King's Axe Inn.title: King's Axe Inn
King's Axe Inn.summary: The King's Axe is one of three bars in Keldagrim, and is by far the most up-scale. The two-storey inn overlooks one of the River Kelda's many tributaries, one which leads from a thus-far unopened portion of the Keldagrim south-west mine into the mines' southern reaches. It is the only pub on the city's west side, and its close proximity to the stonemason, Saro's Quality Armour Shop, and Keldagrim's only public bank puts it fairly close to some of Keldagrim's larger walkways. Apart from being…

Klenter's Pyramid.title: Klenter's Pyramid

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Access to Sophanem, including Klenter's Pyramid, requires partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
• Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport, then run north past the temple to the pyramid.
• Pharaoh's sceptre as well as Sceptre of the gods can teleport player near Pyramid Plunder which is north of the Klenter's Pyramid.
• Bandit Camp lodestone teleport then run southeast to the bridge. Run south across the bridge and enter the gates into Sophanem. The pyramid is southwest of the Crafting Shop, its entrance, a door with a cat on it, is on the north side of the pyramid.
• Menaphos lodestone teleport then across the square enter Sophanem via Coenus. The pyramid is down the stairs to the north.
• Leela's favour teleport option 7 to Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, then run north past the temple to the pyramid.

Klenter's Pyramid.summary:
• Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport, then run north past the temple to the pyramid.
• Pharaoh's sceptre as well as Sceptre of the gods can teleport player near Pyramid Plunder which is north of the Klenter's Pyramid.
• Bandit Camp lodestone teleport then run southeast to the bridge. Run south across the bridge and enter the gates into Sophanem. The pyramid is southwest of the Crafting Shop, its entrance, a door with a cat on it, is on the north side of the pyramid.
• Menaphos lodestone teleport…
