Kuradal's Dungeon.title: Kuradal's Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.

There are four ways to get to the entrance:
• Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
• Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.
• Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).
• Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.

Kuradal's Dungeon.summary: Once in the dungeon, players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. All monsters in the dungeon except dark beasts, greater demons, hellhounds, and gargoyles are non-aggressive. The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the…

Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon).title: Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The entrance to Tarn's Lair is at the northern end of the ground level of the Abandoned Mine.
• The fastest way to reach the end of Tarn's Lair is with a ring of slaying, which can be purchased from a Slayer Master or crafted by the player. This teleport allows the player to skip the entire dungeon.
• Drakan's medallion will teleport players to Burgh de Rott, where a shortcut over a fence to the west leads to the mine.
• Taking the shortcut under the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis and travelling on the swamp boat brings players close to Mort'ton. This shortcut is unlocked as a reward from the Burgh De Rott Ramble minigame.
clear | left

Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon).summary: It is the main base of operations for insane Tarn Razorlor the human necromancer and his undead minions. He had travelled to the area seeking a way to gain more control over the undead, and by enchanting the salve shards found in the nearby mine and making a pendant from it, he was able to do so.

Lakki the delivery dwarf.title: Lakki the delivery dwarf
Lakki the delivery dwarf.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Barbarian Assault Improvements | date=19 January 2010 
• The various dwarves of RuneScape have had a visit from the Makeover Mage, who has given their chatheads a new look.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Land of Holly and Hawthorn is accessed by entering an Easter portal.

clear | left

Land of Snow.title: Land of Snow
Land of Snow.teleport:
• Land of Snow portal
• Explorer Jack
Land of Snow.summary: According to the Queen of Snow, Guthix had created the land of snow to counter Gielinor's heat with the Land of Sunlight. So whenever the winter season arrives, the Queen of Snow would send snow from the land to Gielinor, until spring.

Laniakea.title: Laniakea
Laniakea.summary: Laniakea's unique quirk (being the first to introduce it) is that she can assign "cluster" tasks in place of normal tasks. When assigned these tasks, any monster that falls into that category may be killed for the task; e.g frost dragons, which are not assigned by other slayer masters, can be killed as part of her slayer tasks if given the Creatures of Daemonheim or dragons task. Compared to Morvran, Laniakea does not offer lower-levelled tasks such as grotworms and waterfiends.

Larrissa.title: Larrissa

Larrissa is a Fremennik woman who is found outside of the Lighthouse, north of the Barbarian Outpost. She is the starting point of the Horror from the Deep quest, where she asks the player to help her find her boyfriend Jossik, the Lighthouse keeper.

Larry.title: Larry
Larry.summary: However, Larry will only shrink players in the Lumbridge sheep pen during the quest. He is apparently quite a proficient magic user as he can shrink and tele-other players during the Cold War quest, although he says that teleporting stresses him out, which is probably why he doesn't always use it to get to faraway locations during the quest.

Laughing Miner Pub.title: Laughing Miner Pub
Laughing Miner Pub.summary: On the main floor, players can purchase stew and beer from the barmaid. Occasionally, Postie Pete will appear here and purchase several pints of ale. There are also several seats and a fireplace to cook basic food on.

Launa.summary:
She looks worried.
• She looks tired of waiting.

Launa Talvoy is the wife of Brana Talvoy and the mother of Tolna Talvoy. In the Year 144 of the Fifth Age, her son ran away from home, unhappy with living on the meagre earnings of a farmer. She and her husband went searching for him for 25 years, before she came upon a rift…

Lava Flow Mine.title: Lava Flow Mine

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Lava Flow Mine is located through an opening on the east wall of Keldagrim. The easiest way to get there is by using the mine cart from the Grand Exchange to travel to East Keldagrim, and then run northeast.

Alternatively, players who have level 99 in at least one skill or are able to wear the Quest Cape can tune the skilling portal in Max Guild to the Lava Flow Mine. The portal will teleport the player inside the Lava Flow Mine.

Lava Flow Mine.summary: It is a place for players to train Mining quickly without gaining ores and by pleasing the Liquid Gold Nymph, players may attain pieces of the golden mining suit. Although the in-game skills interface lists the Lava Flow Mine as having a 65 Mining requirement, the quest King of the Dwarves is required to use the mine, giving it an indirect requirement of 68 Mining, 70 Smithing, 77 Strength, and any levels required by quests needed to complete prior to King of the Dwarves. Prospecting the lava…

Lava Maze.title: Lava Maze
Lava Maze.teleport:
• Ancient obelisks 
 (Lvl 44, 35, or 27)
• Canoe
• Lava titan

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Three Wilderness obelisks provide a fairly fast way to reach the maze:
• The obelisk in level 44 Wilderness is the closest, from there run a short distance to the southeast.
• The obelisk in level 35 Wilderness is a bit further, the maze entrance is towards the northwest.
• The obelisk in level 27 Wilderness is the furthest but still practical, run a little distance to the north.

Players can also teleport to the Lava Maze by way of a lava titan's special ability.

Players can also ride a canoe to the Wilderness canoe landing, arriving near the level 35 Wilderness Obelisk.

A Wilderness sword 1 or higher can teleport players to the Wilderness herb patch, then walk west to the Lava Maze.

From the Wilderness Crater lodestone, players should run west then north, around the edge of the Wilderness Crater and up to the Lava Maze.

Lava Maze.summary: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are webs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife. It was previously possible for players to be trapped inside the maze if they did not have a slash weapon to cut webs, but having the tool belt with a knife will always allow you to cut through webs, even without a slash weapon or knife in your inventory.

Lava Maze Dungeon.title: Lava Maze Dungeon
Lava Maze Dungeon.summary: The dungeon is split in two areas. The main western area, accessible only by members, is reached through the eastern entrance in the middle of the Lava Maze and contains several monsters. The smaller eastern area of the dungeon, accessible by free players, is reached through the western entrance found west of the maze, in a metal-fenced area, and contains Poison spiders and the lever to enter the King Black Dragon Lair.

Lava-flow miner Sven.title: Lava-flow miner Sven
Lava-flow miner Sven.summary:
After the cave-in Sven is seen trying to calm the mob which has amassed at the entrance to the mine, and later runs off to tell the Consortium and is not seen again during the quest. He can be chatted to after the quest, found in the same place he was originally.

Lazim.title: Lazim
Lazim.summary: During the quest itself, Lazim attempts to trick the player into thinking he wishes to build a statue commemorating someone or something and, despite the notion that the middle of a desert is an odd place to build a statue, the player must oblige. It is then discovered that the statue was just a ploy, and Lazim was actually attempting to unearth a temple dedicated to the Zamorak-aligned Mahjarrat Enakhra. While the player goes through a series of puzzles, Lazim waits patiently, letting the…

Leaves (trap).title: Leaves (trap)
Leaves (trap).summary: There is also a potential for a poisoned player to be cured by failing the leaf trap.

Leela.title: Leela
Leela.quest: Missing My Mummy, Do No Evil, Diamond in the Rough, Stolen Hearts, Crocodile Tears, Our Man in the North
Leela.summary: If the players have started Stolen Hearts up to the point where Leela is involved, they must finish both Stolen Hearts and Diamond in the Rough before Leela will return to Draynor jail. Otherwise, she will not appear in front of the jail. If both quests are completed and Leela does not appear in Draynor Village, she will be in Uzer Mastaba.

Legends' Guild.title: Legends' Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are several methods of getting to the Legends' Guild:
• The cape of legends teleports the player directly inside the guild on the floor 1 next to the Totem pole, or outside the front gates if toggled by using the cape.
• The Quest Cape and master quest cape will also teleport the player to the same location as the Cape of Legends configuration but cannot change the destination.
• Fairy ring BLR teleports the player to a point just outside the main gates.
• The Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix's Shrine to the west of the guild.
• The Ardougne Teleport or the Camelot Teleport transports the player west or north of the guild, respectively.
• The western most magical portal on the floor 3 of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille teleports the player to the Sorcerer's Tower, slightly to the north-west of the guild.
• The combat bracelet teleports the player to the Ranging Guild, north-west of the guild.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
At the gates of the Legend Guild, there are two Legends guard on duty, only letting players who have started or completed the Legends Quest go through the gates. If a player who is a member of the guild enters the gates the guards proclaim "Legends' guild member approaching!".

In the garden there is a fountain and a Golden Gnome donated by SpecialEffect in 2016.
clear

Legends' Guild.summary:
In the garden there is a fountain and a Golden Gnome donated by SpecialEffect in 2016.
clear

Legends' Guild Dungeon.title: Legends' Guild Dungeon
Legends' Guild Dungeon.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=New - Legends Quest! | date=20 August 2003 
• Added to game.

Legends' Guild south-west mine.title: Legends' Guild south-west mine
Legends' Guild south-west mine.location: North-east of Ardougne, south-west of Legends' Guild.
Legends' Guild south-west mine.summary: A furnace and bank can be found in east Ardougne. A bank can also be found on the floor 3 of the Legends' Guild (after the Legends' Quest) and a bank chest or a bank deposit box at the player-owned farm. There are many grizzly bears around the mining site, which can be dangerous to players with a combat level under 65.

Legends' Quest.title: Legends' Quest
Legends' Quest.summary: Legends' Quest is the 50th quest released in RuneScape, in which the player is sent by Guildmaster Radimus Erkle to explore and map the Kharazi Jungle on the southern part of Karamja. This quest was the first quest to be rated Master, and the last quest to be released before the launch of the RuneScape 2 beta.

Lever.title: Lever
Lever.summary: When players pull the lever in the Deserted Keep in a members' world, they will be teleported from the Wilderness back to Ardougne, unless they have been teleblocked. If a player pulls the lever in a free-to-play world, however, they will be teleported back to the centre of Edgeville.

Liberation of Mazcab.title: Liberation of Mazcab
Liberation of Mazcab.summary: Liberation of Mazcab is the first raid added to RuneScape, and accessing it requires the use of the Grouping System to enter and being in the raid group.

Life altar.title: Life altar

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The fastest way to the life altar is to activate the disk of returning in any bank area and teleport directly there, or use a Quest Cape and teleport to the Behind the Scenes pub. The life altar portals can easily be identified by the lush green grass south-west and south-east of the landing zone. It is east of the teleport location and directly south of Clawdia.

Life altar.summary: Some of the life runes are turned into cabbages by a cabbagemancer and sent to Gielinor's cabbage farms. If a cabbagemancer is not actively tending the Life Altar, there is a danger that it will overload and explode, ending both the flow of cabbages to Gielinor and the supply of respawn-enabling life runes to the inhabitants of Behind the Scenes.

Lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
Lighthouse.teleport:
• Lighthouse Teleport
• Helm of the Dagannoth
• Mask of the Dagannoth

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The lighthouse is in a somewhat remote area. Players can get there from the Barbarian Outpost by jumping across the northern columnar basalt rocks that protrude from the sea. It is possible to slip on the rocks, which results in the player falling into the water, being swept back to shore, and taking damage. It is noted that having an Agility level above 35 increases the likelihood of successfully jumping across the rocks. Players seem to have a lot of trouble getting over the rock as the character "fails" to jump over it several times.

Another route of access is via a bridge, which is fixed during the quest. The bridge is located in the south-western part of the Fremennik Province. If the bridge has not been fixed, the player can jump across it, but this will cause damage.

There are several teleports that arrive near the lighthouse:
• Lighthouse Teleport which teleports the player directly to the lighthouse.
• Helm of the Dagannoth/Mask of the Dagannoth have a teleport option to the lighthouse (twice per day).
• A games necklace teleport to the Barbarian Outpost.
• Barbarian Teleport in the Lunar spellbook, which teleports to the Barbarian Outpost.
• House Teleport, if the…

Lighthouse.summary: Another route of access is via a bridge, which is fixed during the quest. The bridge is located in the south-western part of the Fremennik Province. If the bridge has not been fixed, the player can jump across it, but this will cause damage.

Lighthouse (Wendlewick).title: Lighthouse (Wendlewick)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Walk south of the Wendlewick lodestone or after using the Wendlewick Lodestone (spell).
• Walk west of the Canoe station (Havenhythe) if getting off from the [Chat: 1 Wendlewick (Burnt Lobster Tavern)] stop from another stop.

Lighthouse (Wendlewick).summary: This location is visited during Visions of Havenhythe, when Esther tells the player where to build the Wendlewick lodestone. Esther is also part of the quest Hermit Permits, along with Zeke and Adam where each must sign off on planning permission to build the driftwood houses for the crabs.

Lighthouse Dungeon.title: Lighthouse Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is found under the lighthouse and can only be accessed after completion of the Horror from the Deep quest. The player must descend the iron ladder to the basement, proceed through the strange wall and descend another ladder to reach the chamber.
clear | left

Lighthouse Dungeon.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (6 September 2011) | date=6 September 2011 
• Some old-style dripping sounds have been removed in the lighthouse dungeon.

Linza.title: Linza

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
Like the other Signature Heroes, Linza can be found in many different places. However, after Kindred Spirits, she no longer appears.

Roaming

Linza can be found in several random locations. She visits each for five minutes before teleporting to another. Possible locations are:
• Al Kharid, at the furnace
• Dragon Forge in Ancient Cavern
• Crafting Guild
• Daemonheim, chipping at the walls east of the reward shop
• Dorgesh-Kaan, at the anvil found in the southern part of the city
• Keldagrim, at the Blast Furnace anvils
• Keldagrim, near the Giant Dwarf statue
• Mining Guild, western side

Listen
title: Is someone there?
align: right
filename: Linza.ogg

Fixed

Linza may be found at these places before completion of Kindred Spirits:
• Burthorpe mine, standing in front of the entrance.
• On the floor 2 of the Legends' Guild, with all the other Signature Heroes.

Quest and miniquest appearances

Linza appears in the following quests and miniquests:
• In the quest Deadliest Catch, Linza is smithing at the anvils at Hemenster. During the quest, she reminisces about her experiences with hunting the mythical Crackjaw, and helps the player by giving them a giant harpoon in exchange for…

Linza.summary: She takes pride in her reputation as a great smith and is willing to betray people if it would save her loss of face. However she is capable of humility and regret over her actions.

Living Rock Caverns.title: Living Rock Caverns

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Living Rock Caverns are found below the dwarven mines beneath Ice Mountain, near Falador.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Dwarven Mine resource dungeon and then running north and west to the cavern entrance.
• Through a directed skill portal in the Max Guild of Prifddinas. Requires Plague's End and at least one 99 or a Quest Cape.
• The Lassar Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook, the Edgeville Monastery teleport from the combat bracelet, or the Body altar teleport all teleport close to this entrance of the Dwarven Mine. Then run south to the cavern entrance.
• Through the entrance in the north-east corner of Falador or the Mining Guild and then run north and then west to the entrance to the Living Rock Caverns.
• Take the mine cart from Keldagrim to Ice Mountain. From the cart station, go south to the second passage way east. From here, first go east and then north around a chasm. At the top end of this chasm, climb a rope down to the Living Rock Caverns. Players can also travel to the Grand Exchange and White Wolf Mountain on the mine cart system, as well as Dorgesh-Kaan through the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system (if the player has completed Another Slice of…

Living Rock Caverns.summary: There are no quest or skill requirements necessary to enter this area. However, it is a dangerous area, as aggressive level 92 living rock creatures guard the resources, so training skills here may very well be interrupted regularly and dangerous. Wearing the magic golem outfit or fury shark outfit (or any of the component shark sets) will cause the creatures to be tolerant.

Lletya.title: Lletya

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
During Mourning's End Part I, Eluned will teleport you into the city for the first time and give you a crystal teleport seed with 8 charges that lets you teleport back to the city. She will also recharge it for a fee, though this amount goes down the more times you recharge the crystal with her, like with the crystal bow and crystal ward. Additional crystal teleport seeds can be obtained from killing the elves in the city, but they will only have three charges.

Assuming the player has started the quest, players can also make their way to Lletya by sailing to Port Tyras via charter ship system, and passing through the forest until they reach the gates of Lletya. The same method can be attempted by way of the Underground Pass, and the Arandar Pass.

If a player chooses not to teleport into Lletya, there is an entrance from the forest of Isafdar, which is guarded by dire wolves. Trees surround the rest of the settlement, making it the only way out while walking or running.

Players who have completed The Prisoner of Glouphrie may take a safe path that begins near the Ourania Altar entrance, and takes them to the city itself. This path isn't really any shorter and due to the lack of…

Lletya.summary: If a player chooses not to teleport into Lletya, there is an entrance from the forest of Isafdar, which is guarded by dire wolves. Trees surround the rest of the settlement, making it the only way out while walking or running.

Lletya mine.title: Lletya mine
Lletya mine.summary: The mine is protected by a stick trap, which must be carefully walked over. The fastest way to reach the mine is the Tirannwn lodestone, as the mine is within minimap distance from the lodestone.

Lokar Searunner.title: Lokar Searunner
Lokar Searunner.summary: He is considered to be a poor team member, making deals without Captain Bentley's approval, and generally having a bad work ethic. He is also rather confrontational, insulting people he doesn't like by calling them losers and insulting their homes.

Lookout Ekahi.title: Cap'n Ekahi
Lookout Ekahi.quest: Head of the Family, Jed Hunter
Lookout Ekahi.summary: Sometime in the past, Jed saved Ekahi's life, and Ekahi decided to serve Jed after this incident. After becoming the lookout, Ekahi leads the player to Jed, knowing that they are kinder than Jed, under the promise that they do not kill him. Ekahi "kills" the player to get coordinates to Jed, and when the Thalassus eats Jed when he attempts to bail ship, Ekahi still stays by the player, believing that Jed was killed by the will of the sea and not the player.

Lord Handelmort.title: Lord Handelmort
Lord Handelmort.summary: Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort is the owner of Handelmort Mansion in Ardougne and plays a background role in both the Tribal Totem and Dishonour among Thieves quests.

Lowe.title: Lowe
Lowe.summary: In Dimension of Disaster, his zombie counterpart continues to run a ranged shop, and stocks basic ranging gear. He is also a member of the Black Arm Gang. If the player did not join the Phoenix Gang, he advises the player not to go up the ladder. It is later revealed that a phoenix has made its home there and is aggressive towards anyone who enters.

Lowe's Archery Emporium.title: Lowe's Archery Emporium
Lowe's Archery Emporium.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (4 December 2017) | date=4 December 2017 
• Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock now sells ranged armour and weapons up to T40 (excluding crossbows and including javelins).

Lubufu.title: Lubufu
Lubufu.summary: He plays a small role in the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest. He has a monopoly on the karambwan trade, as he is the only fisherman in Karamja who is capable of catching them. During the quest, the player manages to convince him to train them as his apprentice, through which he will give the player a karambwan vessel and teach them the technique to catch karambwan. The player then uses the information he taught them to teach Tiadeche. This ends his monopoly over the karambwan trade. Attempting to…

Lucien's outpost.title: Lucien's outpost
Lucien's outpost.summary:
It can only be reached by activating a Strange teleorb upstairs in Surok's room in Black Knights' Catacombs. Players wishing to enter Lucien's outpost must bring Dagon'hai robes and should also bring Elite black armour:
• The armour renders the elite black knights and other opponents in the dungeon unaggressive.
• The robes are needed to access Surok's room in the dungeon.
• Wearing either the armour or robes will cause the elite black knights in Lucien's outpost to be unaggressive.
Each…

Lumbridge.title: Lumbridge
Lumbridge.teleport:
• Lumbridge lodestone
• Lumbridge Teleport
• Teleother Lumbridge
• Spawning
• Ring of respawn

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
To enter Lumbridge, players can use the bridge to the east of the town over the River Lum.

From the south, there is a path from Lumbridge Swamp that players can use to enter the town.

From the north, players can cross the bridge leading out from the west of the Champions' Guild and through the Mill Road Mill, heading east along the road. 

Players can also, from the west, enter the town through the path leading from Draynor Village passing by the pale wisp colony.

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
• Lumbridge lodestone
• Lumbridge Teleport - Unlike the lodestone, this requires level 31 Magic, a law rune, an earth rune, and three air runes but is faster and does not get interrupted by combat. Casting this spell is a medium Lumbridge achievement, Ease of Access.
• Lumbridge teleport tablet - Members have the additional option of using teleport tablets to reach Lumbridge. This works similar to casting the Lumbridge Teleport spell normally but can be used when any spellbook is active and only takes up one inventory space.
• Ring of respawn - Can teleport the player to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
• Canoe - Provided the player has the Woodcutting level required, they may use the system to reach several locations, including Lumbridge.
• A boat may be taken from the docks south of Taverley, which places players next to the Lumbridge Sage.
• Portal Chamber - Players with at least level 50 Construction can build a Lumbridge Teleportation Portal in the Portal Chamber of their player-owned house. Building the portal requires 100 law runes, 300 air runes, and 100 earth runes.
• Death - A method that requires little to no effort and no requirements, dying can send the player back to…

Lumbridge.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an…

Lumbridge Castle.title: Lumbridge Castle
Lumbridge Castle.teleport:
• Lumbridge lodestone
• Lumbridge teleport
• Slayer cape to Jacqueline
Lumbridge Castle.summary: It is often a busy place, as it is the location of a lodestone, and a respawn point it is one of the few places that you always have the option to respawn at, although members also have the option to respawn in Falador (after completing the Recruitment Drive quest), in Camelot (after completing the Knight Waves training ground activity), or in the Soul Wars lobby (after completing the Nomad's Requiem quest).

Lumbridge Catacombs.title: Lumbridge Catacombs
Lumbridge Catacombs.summary: The Blood Pact must be completed in order to be able to access the lower level of the dungeon.

Lumbridge Crater.title: Lumbridge Crater
Lumbridge Crater.summary: In the following years the crater was used as a site of many events, most notably hosting The Beach for a decade, and underwent several gradual clean ups and graphical updates. On 17 November 2025 it was replaced by a forest closely resembling one that existed in the area before the battle.

Lumbridge Fishing Supplies.title: Lumbridge Fishing Supplies
Lumbridge Fishing Supplies.summary: It is the only fishing store to stock raw crayfish.

Lumbridge General Store.title: Lumbridge General Store
Lumbridge General Store.summary: With the release of the Personalised Shops update, this general store offers hammers, tinderboxes and bronze daggers as free samples once in a period of time, before the free samples restock, though trying to sell a sample back to the shop will result in the sample being replaced and no money gained.

Lumbridge Market.title: Lumbridge Market

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone, then run north-west along the road.
• Lumbridge Teleport, then run north-west along the road.

Lumbridge Market.summary: The market features 10 stalls of five types, with two of each type, useful for low level Thieving training. Three types are available to free-to-play players, while two are members only. A guardsman patrols the market and attack the players he notices stealing from the stalls.

Lumbridge Swamp.title: Lumbridge Swamp
Lumbridge Swamp.teleport:
• Ethereal outfit
• Water altar teleport
• Wicked hood

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport directly to the Lumbridge Swamp by using an Enlightened amulet.
• Teleport directly to the Lumbridge Swamp by using a 'Chipped' Lumbridge teleport or Dave's spellbook.
• Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone and go south through Lumbridge cemetery.
• Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone and go west through Al Kharid jetty.
• Teleport to the water altar through the Abyss.

Lumbridge Swamp.summary: The area also features the entrance to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, house of Father Urhney who provides ghostspeak amulet, the starting point of the Lost City quest as well as a shed leading to Zanaris. There are about a dozen swamp tar spawns south of water altar.

Lumbridge Swamp Caves.title: Lumbridge Swamp Caves

getting_there.heading: Getting to the caves
getting_there.text:
The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.

A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

Lumbridge Swamp Caves.summary: If entering from the surface, a rope is required to descend into the dark hole under the tree. A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is also advised, as several narrow passages within the caves are guarded by wall beasts, who will grab and damage players without the appropriate head protection. Alternatively, movement abilities like Surge can be used to bypass the wall beasts.

Lumbridge forest.title: Lumbridge forest

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone, then run west through the castle and the back gate in the wall.
• Teleport to Draynor lodestone, then run south-east.

Lumbridge forest.summary: With the beginning of the Battle of Lumbridge on 22 July 2013, the entire area was destroyed and became the Lumbridge Crater. Notable features were relocated to other places in the area, while the crater served as a hub for numerous events for over a decade. The forest returned on 17 November 2025 in a largely same but visually refreshed form.

Lunar Isle.title: Lunar Isle
Lunar Isle.teleport:
• Astral altar teleport
• Ethereal outfit
• Moonclan Teleport
• Lunar Isle lodestone
• Seal of Passage

getting_there.heading: Getting to Lunar Isle
getting_there.text:
Players have several ways to reach the isle.

Teleportation

Players can use the following means of teleportation to reach the isle:
• The Lunar Isle lodestone once they have activated
• The astral altar teleport
• The spells Moonclan Teleport and Tele-group Moonclan
• A Ring of Wealth's teleport to Miscellania and then travelling to Rellekka (requires Throne of Miscellania quest to be completed)
• A seal of passage, which has 1 free teleport charge per day

Walking

A seal of passage is not required for this transportation method, however, you must have completed The Fremennik Trials to board the ship.
# Talk to Lokar on the westernmost dock of Rellekka, who will take the player to Pirates' Cove. Without a seal of passage, players can lie to Lokar and say they're only going to Pirates' Cove, then proceed to Lunar Isle, anyway.
# Board the pirate ship, and talk to Captain Bentley to go on to Lunar Isle.

Fairy rings

A seal of passage is not required for this transportation method. It is not needed for players teleporting to the isle.
# Fairy ring CIP to Miscellania, walk south-east to the dock, and ride the southernmost boat to Rellekka.
# Fairy ring AJR to the Fremennik Slayer…

Lunar Isle.summary: The isle has a bank, a magic shop, and a clothes shop. Suqah live outside the town walls. These have a part in Lunar Diplomacy but are otherwise used for training. The isle is home of the Moon Clan, beings with magic coursing through their blood, who are bitterly at war with the Fremennik.

Lunar Isle Mine.title: Lunar Isle mine
Lunar Isle Mine.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Lunar Diplomacy | date=24 July 2006 
• Added to game.

Luthas.title: Luthas
Luthas.summary: Luthas was also one of Meg's clients during her brief period running a detective agency. He reported the theft of several bananas. The agent sent to investigate reported that the thief had arrived by boat and targeted the banana trees closest to the shore. When informed of this, he speculated that it may have been related to the strange ship near Crandor.

Mabel.title: Mabel
Mabel.location: Barn north east of Draynor Village
Mabel.summary: Zenevivia despises her for her weak-willed attitude, and thinks it would have been better had the adventurer forced her to retrieve her own ring.

Mage Arena.title: Mage Arena
Mage Arena.location: North of Lava Maze, West of Deserted Keep

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pull the Wilderness teleport lever in Ardougne or Edgeville, slash through the web to the north and run west to the arena.
• Use a Wilderness sword 4 to teleport to the Wilderness Agility Course, then run north-east.
• Use a portable obelisk, obelisk shard or Ghorrock Teleport (or tablet) to teleport to level 44 Wilderness, run north past the gate and then north-east.
• Use a Slayer cape to teleport to Mandrith, then run east.

To go into the Mage Arena bank, enter the building just north-west of the arena, slash the two webs and pull the lever.

Mage Arena.summary: The Mage Arena is a minigame for members in which the player must travel to the Mage Arena in the deep Wilderness and fight Kolodion, the master of battle magic. Fighting in the arena requires level 60 Magic (temporary skill boost do not work), and the ability to kill increasingly difficult forms of Kolodion using only magic. It is also helpful to have 37+ Prayer, so players can use Protect from Magic. While the minigame is members only, the area, including bank and rune shop, is accessible to…

Mage Training Arena.title: Mage Training Arena

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are several quick ways of getting to the arena:
• Mystical sand seed and running east.
• Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
• Fairy ring teleport to BIP and running south-west.
• Wicked hood teleport to the Fire altar and running north-east.
• A Ring of duelling teleport to Het's Oasis, then going north, north-east.
• Home Teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone and going north east.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to Al Kharid resource dungeon and then running east.

Mage Training Arena.summary: To participate in all the activities, one should bring nature runes, cosmic runes, law runes, and either all types of elemental runes (air, water, earth, and fire runes), or staves to replace them. The recommended staves to bring are the Elemental battlestaff, Mindspike or Tower mindspike, which can be converted into a staff that provides any one of the elemental runes, and a mud battlestaff, since several of the spells require earth and water runes at the same time. The spells cast are…

Mage of Zamorak.title: Mage of Zamorak
Mage of Zamorak.summary: He will only talk to players if they speak to him in Varrock. He will refuse to speak with characters wearing any item representing Saradomin or Guthix, although he will still teleport or trade with players wearing items of another god.

Magic.title: Magic
Magic.summary: Magic is a combat skill that is used to cast various spells, utilising the power of runes. Although it is classified as a combat skill, it has many non-combat uses. It is a highly versatile skill, offering valuable benefits in particular to players with high Magic levels. In combat, magic users (known as "mages") can damage their opponents from a safe distance, as well as freeze them in place, lower their combat stats, and even hit multiple targets at once. It is often used due to the power of…

Magic axe hut.title: Magic axe hut
Magic axe hut.teleport:
• Ardougne teleport lever
• Edgeville teleport lever

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the Spiderweb, then run east to the hut.
• Use a Wilderness obelisk to travel to level 50 Wilderness. Run west past the Rogues' Castle and the Chaos Elemental, then northwest to the hut.

Magic axe hut.summary: A portal to the Spirit Realm can be found just outside it, accessible only during and after completing the Spirit of Summer quest with Jennica's ring. Entering the portal for the first time grants 11,250 Attack experience. Ghostly warriors instead of magic axes are found inside the Spirit Realm version of the hut while a lockpick is still required.

Makeover Mage.title: Makeover Mage
Makeover Mage.quest: Evil Dave's Big Day Out, Land of the Goblins, Recruitment Drive
Makeover Mage.summary: The Makeover Mage also sells Yin yang amulets. They are non-tradeable and offer no bonuses, but can be bought for 100 coins.

Malignius Mortifer.title: Malignius Mortifer
Malignius Mortifer.summary: After A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains quest, he will return the magic secateurs for 40000 coins if the player has lost them. After the competition of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift, the now returned fairy queen can also replace lost magic secateurs for free.

Mammoth iceberg.title: Mammoth iceberg

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Players can access the iceberg by sailing the Fremennik ship from the Fremennik Province coastline pier, north-east of Rellekka and north of the Fremennik Province lodestone close to the Rock Crabs.

Mammoth iceberg.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (30 November 2015) | date=30 November 2015 
• Corrected an issue with fogging/water effects creating black areas at the Mammoth iceberg on ATi cards.

Manni the Reveller.title: Manni the Reveller
Manni the Reveller.summary: As a member of the council, he can vouch for those undergoing the Fremennik Trials to gain membership to the clan. He judges those he considers to be worthy via a drinking contest: should they manage to withstand drinking a keg of beer better than he can, he will vote for them to join the clan, though he gets rather drunk himself in the process, slurring his words and being unable to recall the name of the council. He sobers up after each attempt by drinking a coffee. He will gladly buy those…

Maria.title: Maria
Maria.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Broken Home & Guthixian Caches | date=27 October 2014 
• Added to game.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Wendlewick Teleport (direct teleport after completion of Wiz Kid) or tablet
• Wendlewick lodestone and go south-east
• Fairy ring code BKS and go north-west
• Portal nexus placed in Player owned house may be configured to provide Marigold farm teleport (the altered version of Wendlewick teleport) right next to the farm.

Marim.title: Marim
Marim.teleport:
• Ape Atoll Teleport
• Fairy ring CLR

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Speaking to Daero at the Grand Tree, then talking with Waydar, and finally sailing to Ape Atoll by talking to Lumdo, from where the player should travel north-west to the front gate.
• Using the Ape Atoll Teleport.
• Using the fairy ring CLR.

Marim.summary: Marim is a village on Ape Atoll, inhabited by various monkeys who are ruled over by King Awowogei. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the Monkey Madness quest, and most of the quest takes place there. The village is most likely named after Marimbo, the monkey god. There are various shops and stalls around the village, including one of the only two places that sell dragon scimitars, the other one being Dealga's Scimitar Emporium in Varrock. At the south of…

Martin the Master Gardener.title: Martin the Master Gardener
Martin the Master Gardener.quest: Bringing Home the Bacon, A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains, A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen, A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
Martin the Master Gardener.summary: In the first part of the series, Martin complains about how his crops have been suffering greatly and tasked a passing adventurer with speaking with his fellow G.A.G. members to find out what is causing the problem. When the last farmer they speak to mentions fairies, the adventurer discovers Zanaris and finds out that the crops of Gielinor are failing because the Fairy Queen has lost her magic. The adventurer slays a Tanglefoot and gives the magic secateurs to the Fairy Godfather in the hopes…

Mausoleum.title: Mausoleum
Mausoleum.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Creature of Fenkenstrain | date=31 January 2005 
• Added to game.

Max guild garden.title: Max Guild
Max guild garden.location: Outer circle of the Cadarn district in Prifddinas
Max guild garden.summary: The Max Guild is split into two parts. The outer part, the garden, is accessible with at least one level 99 or a wearable Quest Cape. There are 30 flagpoles, which players can use to unfurl a flag for each skill they have achieved level 99, and one for the quest cape. These are only visible to the individual player.

Mazcab.title: Mazcab

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are few ways Mazcab can be reached:
• The World window 
• Run roughly northwest from the main gate of Menaphos and look for the desert goebie camp
• Otot tablet
• Grouping System
• Casting the Mazcab Teleport spell (requires it to be unlocked)
• A boss portal at War's Retreat or the combat portal at Max Guild that has been attuned to Liberation of Mazcab.

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
• Graveyard
• Kanatah
• Nemi Forest
• Otot
• Pit of Trials

Mazcab.summary: Mazcab is also the location of the Liberation of Mazcab raid.

Mazchna.title: Mazchna
Mazchna.summary:
Mazchna's special task is for the player to slay all the creatures corrupting the Fairy rings in Morytania. The player must go to each of the three fairy rings in Morytania:
• CKS near Canifis (a safe area until Mazchna is contacted)
• ALQ in the Haunted Woods (vampyres and leeches are present).
• BKR in the Mort Myre Swamp (ghasts and the Mort Myre Swamp effect are present; a blessed silver sickle and druid pouches are recommended).
At each ring, the player must contact Mazchna using an…

McGrubor's Wood.title: McGrubor's Wood
McGrubor's Wood.teleport:
• Fairy ring ALS
• Seers' Village lodestone

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players may directly access the fenced-in area using the fairy ring code ALS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen and a Dramen or Lunar staff, or no item is required if the player has completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.)
• Home Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone then run north along the mine cart tracks then go west along the south side of the tracks until you reach a break in the fencing around the woods.
• Using a Combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild, then run north on the paved path to the Seers' Village lodestone, then follow the mine cart tracks north and then west until you reach the loose railings in the fencing.

McGrubor's Wood.summary:
• Seers' Village lodestone
music: Talking Forest

Meilyr Clan.title: Meilyr Clan
Meilyr Clan.summary: At least one other elven family, the Dail, are under auspices of the Meilyr Clan.

Meiyerditch.title: Meiyerditch

getting_there.heading: Getting to Meiyerditch
getting_there.text:
There are 4 ways to get to Meiyerditch:

#From Burgh de Rott by using a boat from the coast south of Burgh de Rott (it's not marked with a travel symbol on the world map). Must have started The Darkness of Hallowvale. This is the slowest route.
#Using Abyss to teleport to the Blood altar and then use portal to Teleport to Meiyerditch Dungeon. Take the eastern path and run to the end of the tunnel. This is quickest, but the most dangerous route and requires full completion of Legacy of Seergaze.
#Starting from Canifis, go down the trapdoor basement to enter Myreque Tunnels. From there, enter chamber of Ivandis Tomb (first cave to the east), but use the small cavern from the south of the tomb's entrance to enter Meiyerditch Dungeon. There, use jutting wall shortcut which connects the Myreque Tunnels to Meiyerditch Tunnels. Run to the end of the tunnels to emerge in Meiyerditch. A large part of Legacy of Seergaze quest and level 65 Agility is required to use this route.
#Teleport using Drakan's medallion, obtained during The Branches of Darkmeyer quest. When it is modified by Safalaan during the quest, players may teleport to the Meiyerditch Myreque base, or to the Meiyerditch…

getting_there.heading: Travelling through Meiyerditch
getting_there.text:
Meiyerditch is one of the largest cities in RuneScape, and many players find it difficult to navigate through the city due to all the ruination and the barricades. Some things that will help players are:
• Shortcut key - upon completion of the quest The Darkness of Hallowvale, players receive this key to help them navigate through the city more quickly. Doors marked with a symbol of the key are scattered throughout Meiyerditch, and this key can open them, cutting down travel time. (See shortcut guide)
• Vyrewatch - players can use the Vyrewatch to their advantage. If a player is stopped by a Vyrewatch, it is possible to choose the option to be sent to the mine. Once there, the player simply needs to mine 15 Daeyalt ores to be released in the northern section of the city. This method is effective for quickly reaching northern Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer.
• Vyrewatch clothing - bought from Trader Sven, it allows the player to "blend in", making it less likely that the vyrewatch will spot the player.
• Citizen clothing - serves the same purpose as vyrewatch clothing, but costs less and is slightly less efficient. They allow the player to appear as a normal citizen, lessening the…

Meiyerditch.summary:
Meiyerditch Myreque base

Meiyerditch (pronounced "My-err-ditch") is Morytania's largest city and part of the Sanguinesti Region. Meiyerditch is Gielinor's second largest known city after Prifddinas and…

Meiyerditch Laboratories.title: Meiyerditch laboratory

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
• The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
• Travel from the southern end of Meiyerditch tunnels

Meiyerditch Laboratories.summary: Various gruesome experiments were conducted in the carven north of the laboratory on humans and bloodveld. In River of Blood it is revealed that it was the laboratory of Mauritys Guile, who discovered how to cure vampyrism and how to cure vampyres from their blood needs. Mauritys stopped his research because he needed to find hybrid blood (which was impossible to find at the time) and the fear to be discovered by Lowerniel Drakan.

Meiyerditch tunnels.title: Meiyerditch tunnels
Meiyerditch tunnels.teleport:
• Blood altar teleport
• Drakan's medallion
• Wicked hood

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The northernmost tunnel entrance is in Canifis, through the trapdoor south of the tavern. For those claimed the shortcut reward for training Zachory Bragg to level 99, they can be deactivated the reward by reading the Temple Trekking noticeboard near Paterdomus and selecting the "reward" option on the Zachory's level 99 "Shortcut" reward.

The tunnel entrance at the southern end of the northern section is in Mort Myre Swamp, through the wooden doors south of the tavern.

The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.

The following are other alternative ways to get to there:
• Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
• The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
• Fairy ring code DLS transports a player to the north-west corner of the tunnels.
• Another quick way to get to this tunnels is to go into the abyss, then through the blood altar and exit it to appear in the cave. However, travelling through the abyss will drain a player's prayer.
• Use a blood altar teleport tablet to blood altar.
• A mask of Broken Fingers…

Meiyerditch tunnels.summary: Players who partially completed the quest Legacy of Seergaze and have level 65 Agility, they can travel through the tunnels via the jutting wall shortcut.

Melzar's Maze.title: Melzar's Maze
Melzar's Maze.summary: To enter the building, players must obtain the maze key from the guildmaster of the Champions' Guild during Dragon Slayer. The key can alternatively be obtained from the shop in the Legends' Guild. Once inside the building, players must go through mazes on each floor and in the basement. However, to proceed to the next floor, players must kill the creature that is holding the key to one of the many doors on the floor.

Memorial to Guthix.title: Memorial to Guthix

getting_there.heading: Getting to the memorial
getting_there.text:
The memorial site is located in the Piscatoris Hunter area, just north of the ferrets and Nickolaus's camp and just south of the Phoenix Lair and the Airut. Players can teleport directly to the shrine through the use of memory strands, Sixth-Age circuit, or a charged engram.

The Memorial to Guthix can also be reached by teleporting to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and travelling north-west.

Get there via the Port Sarim lodestone and select the 'Travel' option at the Squires to the…

Memorial to Guthix.summary: Completing the set of echoes once is a requirement for the completionist cape and the master quest cape. Unlocking the ability to activate five buffs at once by prestiging three times is a requirement for the trimmed completionist cape.

Memory of Nomad.title: Memory of Nomad

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Enter Death's office in Draynor Village. Then enter Death's Door. [Chat: 1 River Noumenon.]

Once inside Icthlarin's headquarters, run north across the bridge over River Noumenon and enter the Fortress Door.

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
leagueRegion: impossible

LocTableBottom

Memory of Nomad.summary: Memory of Nomad is a weekly Distraction and Diversion available after completion of Nomad's Elegy.

Menaphos.title: Menaphos

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Menaphos lodestone teleports players directly to the centre of the city.
• If the Menaphos lodestone hasn't been unlocked yet, players can teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone, then run south.
• If Pharaoh's Folly is completed, Leela's favour may teleport players to various Menaphos destinations.
• The magic carpet system can be used to travel to the gates of Menaphos.
• The camulet can teleport players to Enakhra's Temple, which is underground just north of Menaphos.
• Players can also travel to Sophanem first. Any forms of transportation that originate within Sophanem require completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
• A bridge connects Sophanem and Menaphos, but it is inaccessible from the Sophanem side if the player hasn't completed the quest 'Phite Club.
• Exit Sophanem from the north gate, run north and cross the River Elid, run south, and enter Menaphos through its north gate.
• Alternatively, after exiting Sophanem, take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach, then take another carpet trip to Menaphos.

Imperial district
• The nature's sentinel outfit can teleport players to the acadia trees in the Imperial district.
• The sceptre of the gods can teleport the player…

Menaphos.summary: The city was released alongside four accompanying quests, The Jack of Spades, Crocodile Tears, Our Man in the North, and 'Phite Club. More lore is revealed throughout City Quests, where Menaphos citizens ask the player to assist them.

Menaphos Imperial district.title: Menaphos Imperial district
Menaphos Imperial district.teleport:
• Fairy ring CKQ
• Imperial district teleport
• Menaphos lodestone
• Sceptre of the gods

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use Home Teleport to the Menaphos lodestone and go west to the Imperial district.
• Use a Imperial district teleport to teleport directly into the district.
• The Sceptre of the gods teleports directly into the district.
• Leela's favour, a reward from completing Pharaoh's Folly, teleports directly into the district.
• Any boss portal that directs to Amascut, the Devourer (after Eclipse of the Heart) teleports into the district, next to the Golden Palace.
• The Fairy ring CKQ or soul altar teleport tablet teleports to the far west side of the district.
• The Nature's sentinel outfit can teleport to the acadia trees within the district.
• The skill portal in the Max guild garden, or accessed through grace of the elves, can teleport to the VIP skilling area within the district.

Menaphos Imperial district.summary:
• Imperial district teleport
• Menaphos lodestone
• Sceptre of the gods
music: See music section

The Imperial district is the largest district of Menaphos, and contains the Golden Palace. Its main skill is Woodcutting and features the VIP skilling area. Its associated faction is the Imperial faction whose leader Commander Akhomet (Imperial) is at the foot of the Golden Palace.

Menaphos Merchant district.title: Menaphos Merchant district

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the Merchant district teleport to teleport directly into the Merchant district.
• Using the Menaphos lodestone and walking North.
• Walking through the front gate after using the magic carpet system to Menaphos.

Menaphos Merchant district.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Menaphos - The Gates are Open | date=5 June 2017 
• Added to game.

Menaphos Port district.title: Menaphos Port district

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Port district teleport or Leela's favour (option 3) takes the user to the centre of the Port district.
• Using the Menaphos lodestone and walking South.
• A Charter to the north-western dock in the Port district for 1,500 coins.
• If a Player-owned house is located in Menaphos then using the Teleport to house is also fast and viable option of getting there.
• Slayer codex teleport and the boat to Menaphos can be used via Portmaster Kags.

Menaphos Port district.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=This Week In RuneScape - Double XP LIVE | date=15 February 2021 
• Items will no longer float in the air when dropped in the Menaphos Port District.

Menaphos Worker district.title: Menaphos Worker district

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Worker district teleport takes user to the centre of the Worker district.
• Navigating to the Shifting Tombs from any other district and exiting through the Worker district exit.
• Using the Menaphos lodestone and running West through merchant district.

Menaphos Worker district.summary: Currently, the slaves are in open revolt as their Sophanite counterparts were temporarily relieved of their duties whilst the city was quarantined. Captain Coenus has succeeded in halting the rebellion in the upper quarters of the city, but the Ports and Worker districts are still protesting.

Mill Lane Mill.title: Mill Lane Mill

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the Draynor lodestone and running east.
• Using the Lumbridge lodestone and running north-west.

Mill Lane Mill.summary: It is one of the only free-to-play windmills in RuneScape, the other being located inside the Cooks' Guild, although this requires a Cooking level of at least 32 to enter. The mill has three floors: the floor 1 which includes the flour bin and Millie Miller, the floor 2 which houses the grindstones that grind-up the wheat, and the floor 3 which encompasses the hopper and hopper controls.

Mill Road Mill.title: Mill Road Mill
Mill Road Mill.summary: Later, an adventurer infiltrates the base to free Grubfoot, but, just as they leave, a fully possessed Zanik, the Goblin High Priest and a small group of goblins break into the base and the Assault on Sigmund's Base begins, wherein all goblins and H.A.M. agents are killed, including Sigmund, and the High Priest becomes the Bandos Avatar after Zanik defied him. The basement is destroyed in an ensuing earthquake and can no longer be accessed afterwards.

Mining Guild.title: Mining Guild
Mining Guild.location: Southern section of the Dwarven Mine

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Members with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape to teleport directly into the Mining Guild.
• Members may use a skills necklace to teleport themselves to the ladder just above the Mining Guild.
• The Falador Teleport will transport a player to the Falador town square, just to the north-west of the guild entrance.
• The Keldagrim minecart system can be used to travel to the north-west corner of the Dwarven Mines. From there, players are able to follow the mines south until they reach the below-ground Mining Guild entrance.
• The cabbage-port function of the explorer's ring 3 and 4 lands the player in the cabbage field to the south east of the city, from which point they can run to the guild.
• If one of the boss portals in War's Retreat is attuned to the Giant Mole, then players can enter the portal to teleport to Falador Park and then run south-east to the guild.

Mining Guild.summary: Compared to Old School, this guild does not provide the +7 invisible Mining levels.

Miscellania.title: Miscellania
Miscellania.teleport:
• Fairy ring CIP
• Luck of the Dwarves
• Miscellania Teleport
• Ring of Wealth
• Ring of Fortune

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The ring of Wealth or higher tier luck rings can be used to teleport next to Advisor Ghrim, which is useful for those who do Managing Miscellania, but requires completion of Throne of Miscellania.
• A Miscellania teleport scroll can be used to teleport to the square of Miscellania. They can be bought from the Grand Exchange or obtained from clue scrolls. These scrolls can only be used upon completion of The Fremennik Trials.
• There is a boat run by the Sailor on the second westernmost dock in Rellekka which can be used to travel to Miscellania but requires completion of The Fremennik Trials to use. The enchanted lyre can be used to teleport to Rellekka. The Fremennik Province lodestone (Alt+F while interface is open) is just east of Rellekka. A side entrance to Rellekka is available north-west of the lodestone.
• Fairy ring code CIP will teleport players west of the mine on Miscellania. The code only works on completion of The Fremennik Trials, otherwise the rings treat the code as unrecognised and teleport you just a few spaces from the main ring.

Miscellania.summary:
• Luck of the Dwarves
• Miscellania Teleport
• Ring of Wealth
• Ring of Fortune

Miscellania is a small island off the northernmost part of the Fremennik Isles, just west of Etceteria. Completion of The Fremennik Trials is required to access the island, and after completion of Throne of Miscellania inhabitants will consider the player Prince or Princess Regent, and work for them if their…

Miscellania Castle.title: Miscellania Castle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Ring of Wealth/Fortune or Luck of the Dwarves
• Fairy ring code CIP
• Miscellania teleport scroll
• Sailor in Rellekka

Miscellania Castle.summary: King Vargas initially appears as a yeti, a beast-like creature, that he was transformed into many years ago after an encounter with a gnoeals. Due to this, he seeks a regent to take over the Throne of Miscellania, as he is unfit to rule in his current state. The new regent must then deal with Etceteria, who they are at war with, despite neither nation having a military, broker a peace treaty with Queen Sigrid, and sort out the Royal Trouble.

Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon.title: Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon
Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon.summary: The Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon is a dungeon that runs underneath Miscellania and Etceteria. It can be accessed during and after the Royal Trouble quest. It is accessed via the dungeon entrances on either island. The Miscellania entrance is closest to the subterranean village, while the Etceteria entrance is closest to the sea snakes. A chamber to the Giant Sea Snake is close to the Etceteria exit; however, this cannot be accessed once the Giant Sea Snake is defeated.

Mistag.title: Mistag
Mistag.quest: The Chosen Commander, Death to the Dorgeshuun, The Lost Tribe
Mistag.summary: Located in the Dorgesh-Kaan mine, he can show you the way to Kazgar near the Lumbridge Castle cellar and to Dartog near the Lumbridge watermill cellar after completing Death to the Dorgeshuun.

Mogre Camp.title: Mogre Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: To get to the Mogre Camp speak to Murphy at Port Khazard to go diving. Note that a fishbowl helmet and a diving apparatus are needed, as well as low weight (less than 27kg).

Mogre Camp.summary: Kelp, which can be used to make soda ash in the same way as seaweed and swamp weed, grows here. However, unlike seaweed and swamp weed, kelp cannot be used with the lunar magic spell Superglass Make directly; it must be turned into soda ash first.

Moia.title: Moia
Moia.summary: However, Moia is definitely not to be underestimated, for she is a master in combat, being able to teleport short distances to surprise her victims with powerful magical attacks. Additionally, she is quite skilled with a dagger. Her most dangerous technique is her ability to infiltrate someone's mind and steal their memories, leaving them with no clue of their own identity, while Moia gains all of what was once theirs.

Moldark, Emissary of Zamorak.title: Moldark, Emissary of Zamorak
Moldark, Emissary of Zamorak.summary: After Zamorak's defeat during The Battle of Lumbridge, and after his recovery, Moldark works alongside Moia to salvage the remnant of his army during the battle.

Monastery of Ascension.title: Monastery of Ascension

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The Monastery of Ascension is located north-west of Oo'glog. Fast ways to get nearby are with the Oo'glog lodestone, a ring of duelling, spirit tree or South Feldip Hills Teleport to the southern Feldip Hills, or using the charter ship to Oo'glog. Players can also teleport to the fairy ring AKS and travel south-west to reach the temple.

Monastery of Ascension.summary: The main purpose of the dungeon is for hunting the Ascension crossbow. The crossbow is made by combining a dragon crossbow, the six different Ascension signets dropped by the Legiones bosses, and 100 Ascension shards. The Legiones are accessed by using the Ascension Keystones on their individual laboratories. Ascension Keystones are dropped by all monsters in the dungeon, including the Legiones themselves.

Monk (Devious Minds).title: Assassin
Monk (Devious Minds).summary:
A stealthy assassin. 
• Even with the mask he looks familiar.
examine2: A hooded monk.

Monk of Zamorak.summary:

• Monks of Zamorak now have a chance to drop Zamorak robes.

Mort Myre Swamp.title: Mort Myre Swamp
Mort Myre Swamp.teleport:
• Fairy ring CKS
• Fairy ring BKR

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring BKR is located within the swamp
• Fairy ring ALQ is located in the Haunted Woods. Run southwest to enter the swamp area.
• Fairy ring CKS is located just north of Mort Myre. Run south through the gate to enter the swamp.
• Upon reaching a combined total level of 100 in Temple Trekking, the gate at the north end of Mort Myre may also be used to quick-travel to the Nature Grotto near the south end of the swamp.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. Therefore, not even a full inventory of food will keep players safe here, because ghasts will decompose any kind of food. It is highly recommended for a player to carry a druid pouch with them as they travel…

Mort Myre swamp.title: Mort Myre Swamp

• Fairy ring CKS is located just north of Mort Myre. Run south through the gate to enter the swamp.
• Upon reaching a combined total level of 100 in Temple Trekking, the gate at the north end of Mort Myre may also be used to quick-travel to the Nature Grotto near the south end of the swamp.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. Therefore, not even a full inventory of food will keep players safe here, because ghasts will decompose any kind of food. It is highly recommended for a player to carry a druid pouch with them as they travel…

Mort'ton.title: Mort'ton

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
• A games necklace can be used to teleport to the nearby town of Burgh de Rott after unlocking the destination by playing Temple Trekking.
• Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Teleport to the Barrows via a boss portal.
• A Swamp Boat can be taken directly to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
• From Canifis via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern (after In Search of the Myreque)
• From the BKR fairy ring in the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Running south from Canifis through Mort Myre Swamp. The northwestern gate requires starting the Nature Spirit quest.

clear | left

Mort'ton.summary: The town was once famed for its funeral pyres, though now it is populated by afflicted, strange zombie-like creatures that are the result of a disease which spread through the town some time in the Fifth Age, infecting the population, and Shades of long-dead spirits which were disturbed by the town's affliction.

Morvran.title: Morvran
Morvran.summary: Players can easily reach Morvran by teleporting to the Iorwerth district of Prifddinas via a crystal teleport seed, a ferocious ring, or a Slayer cape, or by teleporting to Prifddinas via the Prifddinas lodestone and walking south-west.

Morytania.title: Morytania

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Canifis

Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus via the mausoleum outside and just north of the Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
• Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
• The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
• Focusing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
• Fairy ring code CKS.
• After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
• After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

Morytania.summary: In order to access Morytania for the first time, players must either complete the Priest in Peril quest or kill a ghoul in the mausoleum below Paterdomus, accessed from the stairs in the graveyard, north of the temple, then go through the holy barrier keeping Morytania's dark forces outside of Misthalin. This should not be hard; even skillers can do this with rings of recoil, and an inventory of food. Players should only need to attack the ghoul once, then equip the ring of recoil and the ghoul…

Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon.title: Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon
Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon.teleport:
• Dungeoneering cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring
• Ring of slaying
• Various Slayer masks
Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon.summary: The dungeon contains 5 caverns, the central one is inaccessible. The two northern caverns each contain a group of 7 dark beasts (14 dark beasts in total). The two southern caverns each contain a group of 8 abyssal demons (16 abyssal demons in total). 13 imps spawn and teleport all around the dungeon.

Mos Le'Harmless.title: Mos Le'Harmless
Mos Le'Harmless.teleport:
• Big Book o' Piracy
• Fairy ring DIP
• Pirate spell sheet
• Rum (Trouble Brewing)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Completion of Cabin Fever is required to access Mos Le'Harmless.
• Use the Big Book o' Piracy to teleport directly to Mos Le'Harmless.
• Use the Charter ship at Port Sarim to travel to Mos Le'Harmless.
• Fairy ring DIP to Mos Le'Harmless after completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and repairing the bridges with 4 regular planks (protean planks do not work) and 8 nails per bridge (totalling 8 planks and 16 nails to fully complete the bridges). One bridge must be repaired from the island side, and one must be repaired from the fairy ring side.
• Speak to Bill Teach on the docks of Port Phasmatys or Pirate on the ship (cross gang-plank at eastern most point) to travel to the island.
• Use a rum from Trouble Brewing to teleport to Trouble Brewing, on the far east side of the island.
• Pirate spell sheet teleport from Braindeath Island (easily accessed with the dungeoneering cape or hoardstalker ring teleport to the Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon)

Mos Le'Harmless.summary:
• Pirate spell sheet
• Rum (Trouble Brewing)
music: * Distillery Hilarity
• In the Brine
• Life's a Beach!
• Little Cave of Horrors
• Mos Ayes Le'

obelisks: 1
