Mos Le'Harmless is the quaint free port run mostly by pirates that players may visit after completion of the Cabin Fever quest. The isle has a few attractions, such as Trouble Brewing—a minigame—and the Mos Le'Harmless Caves where cave horrors may be found.

Mos Le'Harmless Caves.title: Mos Le'Harmless Caves

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using the charter ship
• Teleporting using rum (red) or rum (blue) bought from Honest Jimmy's House of Stuff
• Accessing through the fairy ring DIP
• If using the fairy ring shortcut, the player must first complete A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and repair the bridges connecting the fairy ring island to the Mos le'Harmless mainland. This will require a total of 8 regular planks and 16 nails of any kind. Each bridge must be repaired from a different side, meaning the player must fix it from the Mos Le'Harmless side as well as the fairy ring island side if it is the first time using the shortcut.
• Teleport to Mos Le'Harmless using the Big Book o' Piracy, then use the stepping stone to the east to cross the river

Mos Le'Harmless Caves.summary: Players can only reach the island after completing the Cabin Fever quest.

Mosol Rei.title: Mosol Rei
Mosol Rei.summary:
The easiest way to get to Mosol Rei is by teleporting to the Herblore Habitat by using a juju teleport spiritbag that can be purchased for 2000 coins from Bettamax in Taverley.
clear | left 

Dialogue

Hasdialogue | npc

Moss Giant Island.title: Moss Giant Island

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The fastest (and free) way to get to the island is to home teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run north-west.

clear | left

Moss Giant Island.summary: Many players like to use a cannon on Slayer tasks. A good place to place the cannon is in the clearing on the south of the island. If the player then stands to the west of it, the cannon will rotate and shoot two of the moss giants, while another will spawn on top of the cannon for the player to attack themselves.

Mount Firewake.title: Mount Firewake
Mount Firewake.summary: Mount Firewake is a great volcano located upon the world of Kethsi. It is accessed via the World Gate after completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat and Fate of the Gods.

Mountain Camp.title: Mountain Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Mountain Camp Teleport from the Lunar spellbook requiring 83 Magic. 
• Ring of slaying to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon. Run northwest to the low rock wall.
• Fairy ring AJR to the same location. Run northwest.
• Fremennik Province lodestone. Run southeast to the low rock wall.

Mountain Camp.summary: Due to its remote location and lack of resources, Mountain Camp is rarely visited by players. The only non-quest uses are for some Treasure Trails clues, and as the second location to find Philipe after the Carnillean Rising quest for extra experience rewards. He may be found just outside the camp near the Agility entrance.

Mourner Headquarters.title: Mourner Headquarters

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
Prior to Plague's End, as the Mourner Headquarters is fully under the control of the Mourners, who hide their elven identity and their activities from the humans of West Ardougne, only Mourners are allowed into the building. After partial completion of Mourning's End Part I, the player gains access to a set of full Mourner gear, which the player may use to pretend to be a Mourner and thus be permitted to access the Mourner headquarters. From then on until the completion of Plague's End, full Mourner gear is required to access the facility. 

The player must wear only Mourner gear to be allowed to enter the Mourner Headquarters, with limited exceptions for additional items that may also be worn. Any forbidden items can be kept in the inventory while entering. Attempting to enter while wearing full Mourner gear along with non-allowed items will result in a Mourner denying you entry, telling you that you should know better than to wear "non-regulation gear"-in other words, prohibited items, and you will be advised to take them off, in order to be allowed to enter. Attempting to enter while wearing only partial Mourner gear, or while wearing no Mourner gear, will cause the Mourners to…

Mourner Headquarters.summary: The Mourner Headquarters serves as the base for the military and strategic activities of the Iorwerth elves during the later part of the Elven Civil War. During this time, access to the headquarters is restricted only to those wearing only full Mourner gear, the standard uniform of a Mourner with rare exceptions. After the defeat of Lord Iorwerth, the successful overthrowing of the Mourners in West Ardougne, and the restoration of Prifddinas, the building no longer serves this purpose.

Mourner Tunnels.title: Mourner tunnels
Mourner Tunnels.summary: After completion of Within the Light, players may give their crystal teleport seeds the option of teleporting to the Mourner Tunnels, in the area between the Temple of Light and the Dark beasts by talking to Eluned or Islwyn in Isafdar with a charged crystal teleport seed in the inventory (or in Ithell district if Plague's End is completed). Mourner gear will no longer be required to enter the tunnels.

Mourner tunnels.title: Mourner tunnels
Mourner tunnels.summary: After completion of Within the Light, players may give their crystal teleport seeds the option of teleporting to the Mourner Tunnels, in the area between the Temple of Light and the Dark beasts by talking to Eluned or Islwyn in Isafdar with a charged crystal teleport seed in the inventory (or in Ithell district if Plague's End is completed). Mourner gear will no longer be required to enter the tunnels.

Mourning's End Part I.title: Mourning's End Part I
Mourning's End Part I.summary: Mourning's End Part I is a quest in the Elf (Prifddinas) quest series, continuing directly where Roving Elves left off. During the quest, the player is given access to Lletya, the hideout of the rebel elves, and meets with Arianwyn. The first half of a two-part-quest about stopping the mourners, it revolves around their plans in West Ardougne.

Mouse hole.title: Mouse Hole
Mouse hole.summary: The drops appear larger than normal when the Mice are killed, because the player avatar is very small at the time. However, if picked up and dropped again, they will no longer appear larger.

Movario's base.title: Movario's base

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The entrance to the base is in a ruined building on the Khazard Battlefield. The building can be entered by climbing the broken wall on the south side of the building. Players find the entrance by following a Broav in the While Guthix Sleeps quest. In the quest, the trapdoor to the base is hidden under a broken table. Once found for the first time, the trapdoor remains revealed and the Broav is not required any more.

The quickest way to get to the base is to use a Spirit tree to go to the battlefield. Other practical options are to use an Ardougne teleport, an Ourania Teleport from the Lunar spells, or fairy ring DJP to the Tower of Life. (Several of these methods are available only through quests, but it is virtually guaranteed the player will have completed the appropriate quests before starting While Guthix Sleeps.)

Movario's base.summary: The base has magical interference that blocks use of some spells. Except in the main area, teleportation spells do not work in the base. Throughout the entire base, alchemy spells and possibly some other spells also do not work.

Mr Mordaut.title: Mr Mordaut
Mr Mordaut.summary: After completing the Anachronia base camp tutorial, he can be found in the Anachronia base camp, where he acts as the site manager for the Orthen Dig Site.

Mr Mordaut Tribute.title: Mr Mordaut Tribute
Mr Mordaut Tribute.summary: Although his office is in a pocket universe, it is just big enough for him because of budget cuts.

Mudskipper Point.title: Mudskipper Point

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring AIQ to Mudskipper Point.
• Port Sarim lodestone teleport. Run south past Thurgo’s hut.

Mudskipper Point.summary: Members can slay mogres here after completion of the Mogre miniquest. A fishing explosive is needed to disturb mogres from the ominous fishing spots found around the coast. During Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Pirate Pete the player must obtain 5 mudskipper hides by killing the mudskippers which are found here.

Musa Point.title: Musa Point

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Port Sarim lodestone teleport, then speak to Captain Tobias just east of the lodestone to sail to Musa Point for 30 coins (or for free with the Ring of charos (a)). This is the only method of access for Free-to-play players.
• Amulet of glory teleport to Karamja deposits players in the Banana plantation on Musa Point.
• TokKul-Zo teleport to the main plaza of TzHaar City. Run south and exit the city, then run east from the volcano to Musa Point.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to Karamja Volcano resource dungeon. Exit the dungeon, then run east from the volcano.

Musa Point.summary: Musa Point is the northeast edge of Karamja, located west of Port Sarim. It hosts a dungeon, as well as the only spot to cage raw lobsters, and harpoon raw tuna and raw swordfish in free-to-play outside of the Wilderness.

Myreque Hideout.title: Myreque Hideout
Myreque Hideout.summary: The passageway between Canifis and the hollows contains several other cave entrances. The only other entrance on the eastern wall of the passageway, closer to Canifis, a werewolf town that the player first meets Vanstrom Klause, is the entrance to the tomb of Ivandis Seergaze one of the fabled Seven Priestly Warriors who fell defending Misthalin from the onslaught of the Morytanians, and blessing the River Salve in the process. The player must enter the tomb to create a replica of the Rod of…

Mysterious Old Man.title: Mysterious Old Man
Mysterious Old Man.summary: He has since retired from his job of randomly abducting adventurers to his maze and took up residence in a house in Draynor Village. The players can talk to him to learn about his history and where other random event characters can be found. If talked to about abductions, Evil Bob appears and teleports him away, allowing players to gain access to his basement.

Nails Newton.title: Nails Newton
Nails Newton.summary: Talking of the pompous merchants walking around the city, he says that he utterly loathes them because they have been "gouging" the poor people of their gold, making a profit out of their misery.

Nardah.title: Nardah

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The desert amulet 2/3/4 provides unlimited teleports to Nardah.
• Players can take a magic carpet directly to Nardah from several other desert settlements.
• A Fairy ring (DLQ) is located north of Nardah.
• A The Heart teleport tablet teleports players to the Heart of Gielinor, south-west of Nardah.
• The dominion medallion teleports players to the Dominion Tower, north of Nardah.
• To get there on foot, start from Shantay Pass. Exit the pass, run east, cross the River Elid, then run south-east to Nardah.
• Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.

Nardah.summary:
)

race: Humans

intmap: Map | x=3425 | y=2913 

Nardah is a small drought-stricken desert city in the south-eastern Kharidian Desert. It appears dilapidated and old, almost like a ruin, with many of the sandstone buildings crumbling.

Nature Grotto.title: Nature Grotto
Nature Grotto.summary: It is accessed from the north fence gate west of Canifis. The gate is just south of the Fairy ring (code CKS). Walk or run along the west side of the swamp until you see the island in the south-west corner of the swamp. Jump the bridge on the south side to enter the Nature Grotto; doing so yields 1 Agility experience both ways.

Nature altar.title: Nature altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A nature talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A nature tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A nature talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a nature altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the Karamja gloves 3 or 4 to teleport to the gemstone cavern, take the ladder to the surface, exit Shilo Village by the shortcut to the north, and go north-east to the ruins.
• Use fairy ring code CKR and run north-east to the ruins.

Nature altar.summary: Players need a Runecrafting level of at least 44 to craft nature runes. Crafting a nature rune grants 9 Runecrafting experience. Using protean essence on it grants 160 experience per essence.

Navigator Jemi.title: Navigator Jemi
Navigator Jemi.summary: During Kindred Spirits, she replaces Meg in the player-owned port area, serving as the learning adventurer that asks questions to the player every week. She also served this role during the Mega May event.

Necromancer Tower.title: Necromancer Tower

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The Necromancer Tower is south of East Ardougne and north-east of the Tower of Life. The tower can be easily reached by three teleport methods:
• Ardougne Teleport brings the player to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
• Ardougne cloak 1 teleport brings the player to the Kandarin Monastery, with the tower to the east.
• Fairy ring DJP brings the player right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.

The closest bank without using teleportation is the one south of the marketplace in East Ardougne. The map shows the shortest route between the bank and the Tower of Life, and the same route can be used for the Necromancer Tower. If players can use fairy rings, the bank in Zanaris is closer.

Necromancer Tower.summary: It is constructed on the site of the tomb of Rasial, the First Necromancer.

New Foundations (portal).title: New Foundations (portal)
New Foundations (portal).summary:
• UL | type=hidden | update=Ancient Awakening Launches - This Week in RuneScape | date=9 October 2023 
• Graphically updated.

New Varrock.title: New Varrock

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players must have started Dimension of Disaster to first gain access to the city. Upon starting the quest, Aris will give them a coin, which transforms into a double-headed coin upon investigation. This special double-headed coin must be used on the fountain at the centre square of Varrock, which opens a portal through which you can enter New Varrock.

The double-sided coin will disappear after the first use, but the portal will remain. Players must have banked all of the items, except for the double-sided coin on the first entry, to enter New Varrock.

New Varrock.summary:
Players cannot enter or leave the city by any means other than the fountain located in Varrock Square or New Varrock Square, respectively.
clear | left

Nodon Front.title: Nodon Front
Nodon Front.teleport:
• Boss portal attuned to Kerapac
• Pontifex shadow ring (cathedral)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Nodon Front is located in the western section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through the western cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.

Travel methods include:
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door east of the Rift.
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Kerapac, the bound) or the boss portal in the Max Guild (doesn't require a kill) can be…

Nodon Front.summary: The front has no requirements to access; however, 92 Slayer is required to fight Nodon dragonkin in this part of the dungeon, and 90 Construction is required to repair the siege weapons and use them against the enemy. It is also recommended to have at least level 80 in combat skills, as well as tier-80 equipment. Additionally, the completion of Sliske's Endgame and City of Senntisten is recommended for a better understanding of the story, as the front is considered the next instalment in the…

Nora T. Hagg.title: Nora T. Hagg
Nora T. Hagg.summary: She is a Zamorakian and due to the level of affection she developed for the grotesque creations arising from the experiments she conducts, prefers to keep to herself in order to prevent their discovery, likely as a means to protect them.

Obelisk.title: Obelisk

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:

Obelisk.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (22 July 2019) | date=22 July 2019 
• Familiars special moves can now be cast near obelisks. This in turn, fixes an issue where the Meerkat's Fetch Casket special move couldn't be cast in the Kharidian Desert (south of the Penguin's T.A.R.D.I.S.).

Obelisk (Wilderness).title: Obelisk (Wilderness)

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
The obelisks are found in the following locations:
Wilderness obelisk location

Obelisk (Wilderness).summary: There are six obelisks located at different points of the Wilderness. To activate the obelisk, touch any of the pillars on the side and then go somewhere in the middle. Each obelisk, when activated, will teleport anyone standing on the pad after a few seconds to another obelisk outside of the one used to teleport. If the hard Wilderness achievements have been completed, then the player may select the destination themselves (as a second option, the first, default option will randomise the…

Obelisk of Air.title: Obelisk of Air

getting_there.heading: Travelling
getting_there.text:
The fastest way to get to the obelisk is to use a Hoardstalker ring to teleport to the chaos druids resource dungeon, then run northwest past the deadly red spiders, giant skeletons, and black demons. After charging the orb, players can teleport to their preferred bank to resupply and repeat.

The most efficient way of enchanting large numbers of air orbs is to run to the obelisk from Edgeville bank and teleport back using a charged amulet of glory or Wilderness sword 1, allowing fast banking training.

Once the Hard Wilderness achievements have been completed, players may climb up and down the rocks on the southern side of the platform instead of going through the Edgeville Dungeon. Otherwise, players need to go through Edgeville Dungeon to get there.

Map:Edgeville Dungeon

Obelisk of Air.summary: Charging an air orb is a requirement for Hard Wilderness achievements.

Obelisk of Fire.title: Obelisk of Fire
Obelisk of Fire.summary: The dusty key is needed by players without level 80 Agility (required by the strange floor shortcut) to get through the gate near the blue dragons to reach the deep section of the Taverley Dungeon to the Obelisk of Fire.

Obli's General Store.title: Obli's General Store
Obli's General Store.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Shilo Village Quest online | date=27 January 2003 
• Added to game.

Observatory.title: Observatory

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to reach the Observatory is to use the 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport tablet which can be made by using a watchtower teleport tablet on Dave's spellbook after the quest Evil Dave's Big Day Out.
• Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars then run north, crossing two small bridges. Go up the rope on the north-east side of the observatory (requires completion of the Observatory Quest).
• You could also go down the stairs in the Goblin hut to the north-east and then follow the maze to the staircase to enter the observatory.
• Use the Ourania Teleport to arrive just north of the Observatory. 
• Using the Home Teleport to teleport to Yanille lodestone is free with no requirements but it is a fairly long walk to the north-west.

Observatory.summary: Though the design of the telescope is from Scorpius, the original has gone, and the current structure is a reproduction.

Observatory Dungeon.title: Observatory Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fastest way to get to the dungeon is using the 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport from Dave's spellbook.
• Using ring of duelling to teleport to the Castle Wars and then running North.
• Ourania Teleport and running South.

Observatory Dungeon.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Observatory Quest online! | date=17 March 2003 
• Added to game.

Odd Billy.title: Odd Billy
Odd Billy.summary: He has a deep fascination with birds, and will ask players to watch for rare birds in The Arc and take notes on them to bring to him. He gives hints on when and where to find the birds depending on how many birds the player has inspected. If the player manages to spot all sixteen birds, Odd Billy will reward them with Iago as a follower pet.

Odd Old Man.title: Odd Old Man
Odd Old Man.summary: The Odd Old Man gives you either a bonesack or ram skull helm when you have completed the Rag and Bone Man wish list and enhances them after completion of the Fur 'n Seek wish list.

Ogre Enclave.title: Ogre Enclave
Ogre Enclave.summary: The Ogre Enclave is a dungeon located in Gu'Tanoth. It requires partial completion of the Watchtower quest to enter. The entrance to the enclave is in the western part of the ogre marketplace in the centre of Gu'Tanoth. During the quest, the player must use a cave nightshade on the ogre guard to gain entry. After the quest, this is no longer required. The cave contains the crystals for the Watchtower quest.

Olaf Hradson.title: Olaf Hradson
Olaf Hradson.summary: Eventually, an adventurer found him and agreed to help him fake his success to his family. As thanks, he gave them his grandfather's map, but warned them that it was cursed.

One Piercing Note.title: One Piercing Note
One Piercing Note.summary: One Piercing Note is a novice quest which continues from the legend described in the story of The Song From Before The War. The theme of the quest is that of a murder mystery, specifically uncovering the motives of the murder. The quest was the first to be fully voiced and contains an extensive amount of audio.

Oo'glog.title: Oo'glog
Oo'glog.teleport:
• Master archaeologist's outfit
• Oo'glog lodestone
• Volcanic trapper outfit

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Possible options to reach Oo'glog include:
• Use the Master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Chief Tess directly inside Oo'glog (requires Archaeology Guildmaster Qualification)
• Teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone to arrive north outside its walls
• Travel by Charter ship (requires completion of As a First Resort) from a relevant dock elsewhere. The charter trip costs up to 5,000 coins depending upon the port of departure. The price can be halved twice if the player has done the Cabin Fever quest and is wearing a Ring of charos (a).
• Use the Volcanic trapper outfit (with 39 Hunter) teleport to Wimpy bird hunting area, just outside the entrance of Oo'glog. The teleport option is accessed by selecting the right-click option 'teleport' on the head while wearing the outfit, then 'bird snaring' in the susequent menu.
• Players with 57 Summoning may use a Spirit Larupia to teleport to the Feldip Hills hunter area just north of Oo'glog.
• Teleport to the Warforge Dig Site - either via a Spirit tree, a Ring of duelling, the South Feldip Hills Teleport in the regular spellbook, or the Archaeology fast travel table in the Archaeology Campus (requires 76 Archaeology) - and run east to…

Oo'glog.summary: Oo'glog lies just south of the Feldip Hunter area, a popular destination for hunters and explorers alike. The most common travel hub near Oo'glog is Yanille, which lies beyond the ogre capital of Gu'Tanoth, the dangerous Feldip Hills, and the jungle itself. The sea borders the eastern edge of Oo'glog and the jungle to the west.

Oracle.title: Oracle
Oracle.quest: Dragon Slayer, Perils of Ice Mountain
Oracle.summary: Players doing Treasure Trails clues are sometimes directed to her with the anagram 'Are Col' and are given a challenge scroll. The answer is 48.

Ork's Rift.title: Ork's Rift
Ork's Rift.summary: Ork's Rift is a location where the Battle at Ork's Rift occurred during A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift. After completion of the quest, level 82 cursed Ivory statues reside here.

Orthen Oubliette.title: Orthen Oubliette
Orthen Oubliette.summary: The cell itself rests deep underground to prevent the shadow anima stored there from affecting living things on the surface. The oubliette includes a hologram projection system for the Keeper to broadcast information to visitors, as well as also utilising a security system outside of the main containment chamber that uses a hydraulic lock mechanic as a backup to keep Raksha in place during an escape attempt. This security feature is activated in the Raksha fight during the final phase of the…

Osman.title: Osman
Osman.summary: He used to be good friends with a Sorceress in southern Al Kharid though their relationship has soured to the point where she refuses to give him the sq'irks she grows, which he has a particular fondness for. He rewards players who get him sq'irkjuice from the Sorceress's Garden with Thieving experience.

Otot.title: Otot

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Otot can be found in the North-West portion of the Mazcab overworld.
• From the world window, head north, down the hill. Then, head west at the gates of the Liberation of Mazcab. Then, head north-west through Nemi Forest.
• Interact with the Mazcab guides
• Use an Otot tablet.
• The Master constructor's hat Otot house portal teleport.

Otot.summary: Otot is a city on Mazcab. Quercy can be found in the north-west of the city, is the end point of the supply runs activity.

Ourania Cave.title: Ourania Cave
Ourania Cave.location: North of the Grave of Scorpius

getting_there.heading: Entrance area
getting_there.text: GU | subject=locations | GUL | date=18 September 2007 | update=The ZMI Altar | img=Ourania Cave entrance (18 September 2007).png | name=Ourania Cave entrance | GUL | date=15 January 2024 | update=Kandarin Area Graphical Update - This Week In RuneScape | img=Ouraniaentrance.png | name=Ourania Cave entrance

Ourania Cave.summary: The Ourania runecrafting altar found in this cave has the power to turn pure essence into any type of runes (except combination runes), even the Soul rune. Each rune crafted grants the crafter twice the normal amount of experience that would have been gained by using any other Runecrafting altar. As a result, this dungeon is a popular place for runecrafters to gain experience.

Ourania Hunter area.title: Ourania Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Casting Ourania Teleport is the fastest way to reach the area.
• Teleport to the Battlefield via spirit tree and walk west.

Ourania Hunter area.summary: To trap red salamanders, use a small fishing net and rope on a young tree. Tarromin tar may used to bait the trap and a lit torch may be used on it to reduce the player's scent, slightly increasing chances of catching a salamander.

Ourania Runecrafting Altar.title: Ourania Runecrafting Altar

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Map | mtype=square | x=2453 | y=3232 | caption=Ourania Cave entrance location | align=right 
• Casting Ourania Teleport requires 71 Magic and access to the Lunar spellbook, and places the player on the path to the altar entrance.
• Use Spirit trees option 3: Battlefield of Khazard to teleport to the Battlefield and walk south-west.
• Use Gnome glider option 7: Priw Gnomo Andralo to teleport to just outside of the Tree Gnome Village north-eastern entrance.
• Use a 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport tablet to teleport to the Observatory and walk north.
• Cast Kandarin monastery Teleport, and walk north-west.
• Teleport to Castle Wars with the ring of duelling, and walk north from the lobby.
• Cast Ardougne Teleport, requiring 51 Magic and Plague City, which teleports to the Ardougne market, then head south-west.
• Teleport to either Ardougne lodestone or Yanille lodestone then running to the altar.

Ourania Runecrafting Altar.summary: It converts pure essence into an assortment of random runes without a chance of bonus runes being created. The altar, which requires no talisman, tiara or staff to enter, gives 1.5x the normal experience for every rune crafted. Players do not need a specific Runecrafting level in order to craft at this altar, but the chance of crafting higher-levelled runes increases with a higher Runecrafting level.

Outlaw camp.title: Outlaw Camp

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Outlaw camp is just east of Edgeville, south of the bridge across the River Lum, the Canoe system and a fairy ring. Players can reach the camp by:
• Teleporting to the Grand Exchange with a Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, or Hazelmere's signet ring and running west.
• Travelling from Edgeville across the bridge by the Summoning obelisk and running south.
• Using the fairy ring to Fairy ring | DKR and running south (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen).

Outlaw camp.summary: The Outlaw camp is a small outlaw settlement northwest of Varrock, north of the Cooks' Guild and south of Lucien's dilapidated house. Found here are three tents and many types of trees: dead, normal, and oak. There is also an extinguished fire.

Outpost.title: Outpost

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Outpost lies just off the northwest corner of West Ardougne, and can be reached with a variety of different methods. Many of the fast transport methods in this section require the start or completion of various quests before they can be used. Players should make sure they can use a method before trying to get to the Outpost via that method.

The only direct teleport to the Outpost is the Traveller's necklace's teleport.

Alternative methods include:
• Teleport to the World Gate using the Sixth-Age circuit and run east (requires completion of The World Wakes as well as all the recommended quests).
• Fast transport to the Tree Gnome Stronghold is a quick way to the outpost. From the stronghold, players must walk south to the stronghold's gates and then south-west to the Outpost. Fast transport methods to the stronghold are:
• Spirit tree teleport.
• Balloon transport system.
• Gnome glider.
• Games necklace to the Barbarian Outpost, take the level 37 Agility Shortcut
• Teleports to the Ardougne area are the next closest. From East Ardougne, players must walk north-west to exit the city and then west to the Outpost. Teleports to this area are:
• Ardougne Teleport.
• Using a…

Outpost.summary: The Outpost is an old, now-derelict tower to the north of West Ardougne, and is involved heavily in the Making History quest, which centres around the tower, as well as the Meeting History quest, which is begun there. The Outpost, though now disused, played a very important role in the history of Kandarin and the Ardignas line of royalty.

Oziach's Armour.title: Oziach's Armour
Oziach's Armour.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Patch Notes (12 April 2011) | date=12 April 2011 
• Fixed some clipping issues on the roof.

Papa Mambo.title: Papa Mambo
Papa Mambo.summary: He can provide a number of services for players, including Papa Mambo's Shop, which specialises in Herblore items; building habitats to lure jadinkos; warding off unwanted jadinkos; and converting special jadinko fruits into common fruit.

Papa Mambo's Shop.title: Papa Mambo's Shop
Papa Mambo's Shop.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=Black Friday Bundles - This Week In RuneScape | date=21 November 2022 
• Papa Mambo now stocks five Vine Herb Seeds in his store, up from two.

Party Pete.title: Party Pete
Party Pete.summary: Party Pete is the brother of Prison Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pumpkin Pete and Pious Pete, and cousin to Pirate Pete. This is something of an anomaly, since we would expect siblings' surnames to be identical, not their given names. It is very unusual for parents to have four children and give all of them the same given name. Their last names may be Pete, with their given names being Party, Parroty, Pirate, and Postie. This is supported by Megan when Pete is in prison by referring to him…

Party Room.title: Party Room
Party Room.summary: The Party room, also known as the Falador Party Room, is a building in north-east Falador. It is used to host drop parties where items, regardless of value, can be indirectly given to other players. These items drop randomly from Party Balloons, which players have to pop, in order for the items to appear on the ground.

Paterdomus.title: Paterdomus
Paterdomus.teleport:
• Fairy ring CKS
• Invitation box
• Skeletal horror Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue to Paterdomus.
• Ring of slaying (or ring of slaying (c)) teleport to the Slayer Tower. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue.
• Fairy ring CKS to just west of Canifis. Run west and climb the broken statue.
• Invitation box to the Empyrean Citadel, then clicking it again to teleport to Silvarea. Run east. Requires partial completion of the quest Missing, Presumed Death.
• Skeletal horror Teleport also takes user just west of the Paterdomus.
• Fort Forinthry lodestone. Run south and then east.
• Earth altar teleport to earth altar then run north-east.

getting_there.heading: Paterdomus entrance
getting_there.text: GU | subject=Locations | GUL | date=11 April 2016 | update=Morytania Madness - Plushies - Myreque Memorial | img=Paterdomus Entrance (11 April 2016).png | name=Paterdomus | GUL | date=5 September 2022 | update=Free To Play Area Graphical Updates - This Week In RuneScape | img=Paterdomus Entrance.png | name=Paterdomus

Paterdomus.summary:
• Invitation box
• Skeletal horror Teleport
music: * Outside - Morytania
• Inside - Mausoleum
altars: 1 
featuressection: true
map: See map section
map | x=3411 | y=3492 | zoom=3 

The Temple of Saradomin, or Paterdomus (Latin for "the home of the father"), is a large temple located on the River Salve, the border between the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. It has long been the first line of defence against the evils of Morytania. It is labelled Temple on the world map.

Peksa's Helmet Shop.title: Peksa's Helmet Shop
Peksa's Helmet Shop.summary: The fire in the centre of the shop can be used to cook food on. Peksa, the owner of the store, plays a small role in the Scorpion Catcher quest.

Penda.title: Penda
Penda.summary: Go to Gaius' house in Burthorpe and search the drawers: "Wait till I get my hands on Penda, he's nicked the key again."

Peter.title: Peter
Peter.summary: Taking responsibility, he initially recruited Captain Gloop B Gon to combat his creation, convinced in the slime enthusiast's supposed skill and also due to the low rates offered. To his dismay, the inexperienced captain was consumed almost immediately.

Philipe Carnillean.title: Philipe Carnillean
Philipe Carnillean.summary: Initially he seems quite snobbish and spoiled. When you talk to him, he will demand toys from you and is rude to the player. If you talk to him with purple sweets or a toy horsey in your inventory, he demands that you give him them. He will first demand the horsey, then the sweets, but your character will refuse to give him either.

Phoenix Gang.title: Phoenix Gang
Phoenix Gang.summary: The Phoenix Gang (also known as the VTAM Corporation, which stands for Varrock Thieves and Muggers) is a thief group in Varrock. They are one of the two gangs that players can join in the Shield of Arrav quest. It is led by Straven Enroy. The gang is constantly at war with the Black Arm Gang, a split-off group from their own.

Phoenix Lair.title: Phoenix Lair

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Phoenix Lair is near the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. Players can get to the area by walking or one of these methods:
• Use the Phoenix Lair Teleport scroll obtained from Treasure Trails. It takes players to the entrance of the lair, and is very cheap at NoCoins | GE price | c . This is the fastest method to get to the lair.
• Teleport using the ability of the Mask of the Airut.
• Take the rowboat near the Eagles' Peak lodestone, west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
• Use fairy ring AKQ - Kandarin: Piscatoris Hunter area - (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The closest bank is northwest of the master fairy ring in Zanaris.
• Teleport to the Piscatoris Hunter area using a spirit kyatt's ability (requires Summoning level 57 and a spirit kyatt pouch).
• Use the teleport from memory strands located in the currency pouch and walk north. There is also a bank nearby.
• Teleport to the Piscatoris elder tree via the nature's sentinel outfit and then head west.

Phoenix Lair.summary:
• Use the Phoenix Lair Teleport scroll obtained from Treasure Trails. It takes players to the entrance of the lair, and is very cheap at NoCoins | GE price | c . This is the fastest method to get to the lair.
• Teleport using the ability of the Mask of the Airut.
• Take the rowboat near the Eagles' Peak lodestone, west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
• Use fairy ring AKQ - Kandarin: Piscatoris Hunter area - (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The closest bank is…

Pirate Pete.title: Pirate Pete
Pirate Pete.summary: Pirate Pete is the cousin of Party Pete, Pumpkin Pete, Parroty Pete and Postie Pete. His fifth birthday party is listed as the worst fifth birthday party in the Official History of RuneScape. No such document exists, however Pirate Pete claims cannonballs were swapped with balloons, maiming a significant number of guests.

Pirates' Cove.title: Pirates' Cove

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by the 'Travel-Pirates' Cove' option on Lokar Searunner in Rellekka or by the 'Travel' option on Captain Bentley on Lunar Isle, provided they have reached a certain point in Lunar Diplomacy. There is no fee either way.

There are no teleportation methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zays port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the Lunar Isle lodestone or the Moonclan Teleport found in the lunar spells, which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the enchanted lyre or House Teleport spell (provided their player-owned house is in Rellekka).

Pirates' Cove.summary: The island is totally uninhabited except for a number of hostile moss giants. A number of pirates can also be found wandering the island, although they are presumably crewmen aboard the Lady Zay and not permanent residents. Although the Lady Zays crew typically appear to remain onboard their ship whenever possible, evidence of their activity on the island is obvious; supply crates, basic fences, flags, and other materials can be found dotted around the area, and a number of skeletal corpses can…

Pirates' Hideout.title: Pirates' Hideout
Pirates' Hideout.teleport:
• Ice Plateau Teleport
• Master slayer cape
• Slayer cape

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
While there is no direct teleport to the Pirates' Hideout, there are a couple of relatively safe routes to take as the area is not often travelled by player killers.
• Using Slayer cape or Master slayer cape the player can teleport to Mandrith who is directly east of the Pirate's hideout.
• Using Wilderness sword 4 player can teleport directly to the Wilderness Agility Course and then can travel east to the hideout. 
• Using the Edgeville-Wilderness lever or the Ardougne-Wilderness lever to teleport to the Deserted Keep east of the Mage Arena. After cutting the spider web blocking the top of the exit from Deserted Keep, run west past the Mage Arena until you reach the hideout. In the past this was a popular player killing location so many players would run south of the Mage Arena and swing back north to the hideout which took longer. However, these days the route is fairly safe.
• Players who have completed Desert Treasure may use the Ghorrock Teleport to the Ice Plateau and run north through the gate and then east past the Wilderness Agility Course and then north to reach the hideout. Beware that this route will drop you directly into an area with aggressive Greater Demon…

Pirates' Hideout.summary: Many aggressive pirates are located here. There are also 4 Thieving chests that have to be searched for traps before the player can loot them, and half of a redberry pie (125 life points healing) spawns in the hideout.

Piscatoris Fishing Colony.title: Piscatoris Fishing Colony

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• - Kathy Corkat's boat. Takes the player from near the Eagles' Peak lodestone up the coast to the fishing colony.
• - Fairy ring code AKQ. Takes the player slightly south of the fishing colony.
• plink | Phoenix Lair Teleport - Takes the player south-west of the fishing colony.
• plink | Memory strand - Takes the player to the Memorial to Guthix, south-west of the fishing colony.
• A Spirit kyatt familiar (requires level 57 Summoning) can teleport the player just south of the fishing colony.

Piscatoris Fishing Colony.summary:

Piscatoris falconry area.title: Piscatoris falconry area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• From the Fairy ring AKQ teleport location, walk east. The falconry area has its entrance on the northern side of the fence.
• Teleport to Varrock and use the Spirit tree via the Grand Exchange, teleporting to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and walking on foot. If players have completed Swan Song, players may use Kathy Corkat free of charge for quicker transport, otherwise you can pay her 50 coins.
• Purchasing or obtaining a Phoenix lair teleport from Treasure trails rewards, then walking East.
• Teleport to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and walk north.
• Memory strand teleport to Memorial to Guthix, walk northeast.

Piscatoris falconry area.summary: Both the falcon and the glove will be lost whenever the player leaves the area, although it will not be lost if the player logs out and switches worlds. As long as you are in the immediate area when you log in, you will not lose the Falcon.

Poison Waste.title: Poison Waste
Poison Waste.teleport:

• Fairy ring DLR
• Skill portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
As part of Tirannwn, accessing the Poison Waste requires completion of the Underground Pass quest.
• The system of islands can be accessed by jumping on rocks on the north-east side of the waste, south-west of Lletya. From Lletya, pass the tree and then run directly south to get to the rocks.
• The Tirannwn lodestone is located directly north of the Poison Waste.
• The Tirannwn quiver 3 and its upgrade can teleport the player to the Tirannwn mushroom patch, which is located nearby.
• Fairy ring code DLR transports the player to a small island in the Poison Waste. It can be left via a shortcut, requring partial completion of Plague's End.
• Spirit tree can be used to reach East side of the Poison Waste
• Additionally the skill portals present at Max Guild along with elder divination outfit can be used to teleport to the incandescent wisp colony
• With partial completion of Plague's End, the player can jump along the rocks and islands of the Poison Waste.
• If players go from Lletya, they need to go south of the town (pass the trees that open up at the north-west of the town) to end up at the north-east part of the Poison Waste, and jump along the rocks and islands.
• Players may…

The Poison Waste is a large, marshy area of Tirannwn, south of Isafdar. It is located on the western coast of Gielinor. Needless to say, the name adequately describes the deadly, toxic nature of the sludge permeating this area. The sludge slowly makes its way up, killing all who touch it. A mass of corpses can be found throughout the northern…

Pollnivneach.title: Pollnivneach
Pollnivneach.teleport:
• House Teleport
• Pollnivneach Teleport
• Ring of slaying
• Slayer cape
• Slayer master cape

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
• Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
• House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
• Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
• Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
• The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
• The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
• Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
• Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.

Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:
• There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the…

Pollnivneach.summary: Pollnivneach features extensively in The Feud quest and is also very important for the Smoking Kills quest and the Rogue Trader miniquest. It has a general store shop, a kebab shop and other points of interest.

Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon.title: Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll is the fastest way to get there, as it puts the player very close to the entrance of the dungeon.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona, although this requires completion of Smoking Kills. (Players with the Slayer cape can also use its perk to teleport to Sumona.)
• Use the Desert amulet 2 or higher to teleport to Nardah, then take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach.
• If a player's house is in Pollnivneach, they can teleport to their house. If the player has completed Love Story, a Pollnivneach tablet can be used regardless of the player's house location.
• Using the magic carpets, players can pay a fee (or ride freely using the ring of charos) to Pollnivneach.
• From the Bandit Camp's lodestone, walk east to Pollnivneach, or take the shortcut in the Smoke Dungeon.

Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon.summary: The dungeon can be entered by climbing down a well in the centre of Pollnivneach. Unlike the Morytania Slayer Tower and Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, a dwarf multicannon can be used in this dungeon.

Polypore Dungeon.title: Polypore Dungeon
Polypore Dungeon.location: East of the Mage Training Arena
Polypore Dungeon.teleport:

• Helm of the Ganodermic
• Mask of the Ganodermic
• Dungeoneering Cape

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The cave entrance to the Polypore Slayer Dungeon can be found on a small island located in the River Salve, between Mort Myre Swamp and Al Kharid. Players can access it by:
• Using the fairy ring code BIP. This is the fastest way to get there if a player has died, assuming the player has a quick method to reach a fairy ring and does not need the dramen staff.
• Using a Dig Site pendant and teleporting to the Exam Centre and running south-east.
• Using the Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
• Running north past the Mage Training Arena (along the east side) by Al Kharid. One of the quickest ways to get to the arena using the Het's Oasis teleport ability of a ring of duelling.
• Using the Mask of the Ganodermic or Helm of the Ganodermic to teleport to the bottom floor, very close to the Ramokee Skinweaver.
• Using the Dungeoneering Cape, Dungeoneering master cape or hoardstalker ring to teleport to the area (0,7).
• Using a delver's anklet (or a suitably charged passage of the abyss) to teleport to the third level.

Polypore Dungeon.summary:

Port Phasmatys.summary: There are two main entrances: one from the west, and another from the north. Prior to completion of the Ghosts Ahoy quest, entry to the town requires two ecto-tokens while wearing a ghostspeak amulet. After the quest the player may enter the town at no cost, and a ghostspeak amulet is no longer needed. A ghostspeak amulet is recommended to access the bank, but not needed if you use the "quick-bank" option. Alternatively, players can arrive on a charter ship. The town is populated by ghost…

Port Phasmatys Hunter area.title: Port Phasmatys Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Players can reach it quickly by using an ectophial or Charter ship to get to Port Phasmatys and then run south, or by going east from Canifis.

Port Sarim.title: Port Sarim

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
• Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
• If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
• Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.
• Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
• Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
• Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.
• Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south-east.

Port Sarim.summary: Attempting to travel to Entrana with restricted items will open a full bank interface.

Port Tyras.title: Port Tyras

getting_there.text:
Partial completion of Regicide is required in order to access Port Tyras and the Tyras Camp.
• Tirannwn quiver 2 teleport to the middle of Tyras Camp, run southwest. Requires completion of the medium Tirannwn achievements.
• Charter ship directly to Port Tyras. Requires partial completion of Regicide. Note that departing from the port is not possible until full completion of the quest.
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport, then go through the Dense forest to the west, over the tripwires to the north, run west, and go through the dense forest to the south. Run south through Tyras camp, then southwest to the port.

Portal (player-owned house).title: House portal

getting_there.heading: House portal locations
getting_there.text:
Estate agents can move a player's house portal's default exit location to any of the other house portal locations, although players can always right-click their house's exit portal to select any house portal location to be transported to.

POH Portal Locations

Portal (player-owned house).summary: Houses and homesteads can be accessed through any house portal, marked by the portal icon on the map, that the player meets the requirements for. These locations are Rimmington, Taverley, Pollnivneach, Rellekka, Brimhaven, Yanille, Prifddinas, Otot, and Menaphos. Houses are not tied to any of these locations and any of them can be chosen upon exiting the house, however changing the default exit location through the estate agent has a fee and the same requirements as using them to enter houses.

Postie Pete.title: Postie Pete

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:

Postie Pete.summary: He makes a short appearance in A Clockwork Syringe, when players try to enter their player-owned house he leaves a note, which can be used to start the quest. He also plays a small role in Pieces of Hate and Violet is Blue Too.

Pothole Dungeon.title: Pothole Dungeon
Pothole Dungeon.summary: It is located directly south across the river from the volcano near Musa Point, at the end of a curved cliffside beach accessible only from the east end. There are multiple harpie bug swarms at the start of the beach, which may be aggressive. Search the pile of rocks near the end of the beach and select "yes" to climb down into the dungeon.

Prayer.title: Prayer
Prayer.summary: Prayer is classified as a combat skill and is factored into the combat level formula. Therefore, levelling up in Prayer will contribute towards increasing a player's combat level.

Priest in Peril.title: Priest in Peril
Priest in Peril.summary: Priest in Peril is the first quest in the Myreque quest series. At the command of King Roald, the player must head to the temple of Paterdomus to aid the monk Drezel with recovering the temple.

Prifddinas.title: Prifddinas

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
On foot
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport, then run north out of Isafdar forest, across the river, and into the southern entrance of the city
• From Arandar pass (accessible with the Sixth-Age circuit teleport to the World Gate, the Book of Char teleport, or the Eagles' Peak lodestone), run along the pass west to the eastern entrance of the city

Teleports to the Tower of Voices
• The Prifddinas lodestone is located in the Tower of Voices.
• Players in a clan may use the clan vexillum to teleport to the Clan citadel portal in the Tower of Voices.
• Any of the non-upgraded camouflage outfits can be used to teleport to the Tower of Voices.

Teleports to specific areas
• The crystal teleport seed (and its attuned version) provides teleports to all eight districts.
• The full master camouflage outfit can be used to teleport to all eight districts.
• The House Teleport spell brings players to the Ithell district if players have moved their house accordingly.
• The max cape and completionist cape have unlimited teleports to the Max Guild in the Cadarn district.
• The Tirannwn quiver 4 offers teleports to the harmony pillars in the Meilyr district and Eluned/Islwyn in the Ithell district.

• A gnome glider is located at the northernmost point of the city
• A spirit tree is located in the Crwys district (must have 89 Farming and speak to Glouron before this tree will accept incoming teleports)

Prifddinas Waterfall.title: Prifddinas Waterfall
Prifddinas Waterfall.summary: There are 3 different fishing spots at the top of the waterfall, each requiring different fishing levels. The spot closest to the grappling hook location requires level 93 Fishing. Level 95 Fishing is required for the middle location, and level 97 Fishing is required for the third and farthest away location. The higher the level needed to fish, the more crystal urchin points a player can fish.

Quartermaster Gully.title: Quartermaster Gully
Quartermaster Gully.summary: After the quest, he can be found standing next to the ship Sarim's Revenge, on the northern-most dock at Port Sarim. On the Arc, he can be found on the docks of Waiko, Whale's Maw, Aminishi, Goshima, The Islands That Once Were Turtles, Tuai Leit, and Cyclosis, allowing players to travel between the islands and visit the Uncharted Isles. He can also be found on the north-eastern dock at the Port district in Menaphos.

Queen Ellamaria.title: Ellamaria
Queen Ellamaria.summary: Queen Ellamaria is the queen of Misthalin, ruling alongside her husband King Roald Remanis III from Varrock, Misthalin's capital. She is unpleasant to people, talking down to those she considers beneath her and being difficult to work with and please. She even intimidates her husband. Her ferocity is respected even in Asgarnia, where the Warriors' Guild has a statue of her.

Queen Sigrid.title: Queen Sigrid
Queen Sigrid.quest: Throne of Miscellania, Royal Trouble, Blood Runs Deep
Queen Sigrid.summary: When she was a little girl, she dreamed of being a princess. However, she finds royal life boring, as rarely anything happens on Etceteria, due to the nation being small and insignificant. She spends her days winding up King Vargas, the ruler of the neighbouring nation of Miscellania, usually by insulting him, which causes him to declare war. Despite her treatment of Vargas, she thinks fondly of him and believes them to be a good match.

Queen of Sunrise.title: Queen of Sunrise
Queen of Sunrise.summary: She seems to be cheerful and vivacious, especially when compared to the Queen of Snow, who almost never shows emotions. This is probably done to emphasise their representation of their respective element.

Ramara du Croissant.title: Ramara du Croissant
Ramara du Croissant.summary: Ramara has a distinct accent, although, according to her fellow colonist George Laxmeister, she was born in urban Ardougne. Her father, a baker in Ardougne market, taught her to speak with a fake accent, as he felt shoppers would think the baked goods of higher quality if made by a foreigner. For most of her early life, she learned to bake and work at her father's market stall.

Ranging Guild.title: Ranging Guild

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• A charged combat bracelet will teleport just outside the entrance.
• Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild and walk north-east.
• Camelot Teleport and run west.
• Manor farm Teleport and run north.
• Charter ship to Catherby and run west.
• Fairy Ring ALS into McGrubor's Wood and run south.

Ranging Guild.summary: There are four levels of difficulty, and the archers are aggressive and will attack players regardless of their combat level. Protect from Missiles prayer is recommended for low-level players; this minigame is unsafe and players will lose items if they die.

Rantz.title: Rantz
Rantz.quest: Big Chompy Bird Hunting, One Small Favour, Recipe for Disaster
Rantz.summary: In year 169 of the Fifth Age, Rantz encountered an adventurer and demanded they make him some "stabbers" - ogre arrows specifically. The adventurer provided him with the arrows. Rantz then told them how to lure the chompy birds by using bloated toads from the nearby swamp to do so. When the adventurer returned with the toads, he instructed them to place them in the clearing south of his home. A chompy bird arrived soon after, but Rantz was unable to hit it. The adventurer offered to help, so…

Rasial.title: Rasial, the First Necromancer

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
leagueRegion: Misthalin

LocTableBottom

Rasial.summary: Like Hermod, Rasial can only be attacked with necromancy, though he is not immune to indirect damage such as reflected damage. The effect of slayer helmets does not work against Rasial but is effective against his skeleton and zombie minions. The Undead Slayer perk is effective against Rasial, but the Genocidal perk is not.

Rasial's Citadel.title: Rasial's Citadel
Rasial's Citadel.teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The citadel is accessible during and after the quest The Spirit of War.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Travel by Kharen's gondola in the north-west of the City of Um. This can be reached by running north from the City of Um lodestone, or by running south from the Ed's Boatyard station of the ferry system.

Rasial's Citadel.summary: During Ed's City of Um Boat Tour, Ed mentions that the citadel has an "impressive central chamber, complete with an antique organ".

Raw lava eel.title: Raw lava eel

getting_there.heading: Fishing location
getting_there.text: Get item fishing spot locations

Raw lava eel.summary: Players who wish to reside in Taverley Dungeon for extensive periods of time can bring equipment (logs, tinderbox, oily fishing rod and bait) to fish and cook the lava eels to produce food for combat. This is especially true for players given black demons or blue dragons as a Slayer task.

Recruiter.title: Recruiter
Recruiter.summary: Following the Ardougne Revolution which saw the deposition of King Lathas, he kept his job, recruiting for King Thoros. However, the citizenry continue pelting him with tomatoes due to a general distrust of monarchs.

Red Dragon Isle.title: Red Dragon Isle
Red Dragon Isle.teleport:
• Annakarl Teleport
• Obelisk (Wilderness)
• Obelisk shard
• Portable obelisk
• Wilderness sword 1/2/3/4

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Annakarl Teleport to the Demonic Ruins and run west until you reach the gate (requires completion of Desert Treasure).
• A shortcut, requiring level 54 Agility, allows easier access to the isle. Players may travel to this shortcut via:
• Games necklace teleport to Corporeal Beast's cave, exiting, and running north west.
• Wilderness sword teleport to the Wilderness herb patch and running east.
• Canoe transport to the Wilderness Pond using the Waka canoe (requires 57 Woodcutting) and running east.

Red Dragon Isle.summary: Red Dragon Isle is a location that stretches from level 41 to 47 Wilderness. The landscape is even more charred than the wilderness around it, and big eggs sit on the ground in various spots.

Redbeard Frank.title: Redbeard Frank
Redbeard Frank.summary: Frank is the starting point of the Pirate's Treasure quest, and also plays a large role in the Rocking Out quest. If asked to trade, he'll comment that "Customs is on the warpath."

Reldo.title: Reldo
Reldo.summary: Reldo starts the Shield of Arrav quest, and provides knowledge for the player in many other quests. He also rewards players with the Varrock armour 2 for completing all medium Varrock achievements.

Rellekka.title: Rellekka
Rellekka.teleport: Enchanted lyre, House Teleport (if house is in Rellekka), Rellekka tablet

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Go north on the path between Seers' Village bank and Camelot.
• Fremennik sea boots 4 teleport directly to the Rellekka market square.
• Use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run west into the town.
• House Teleport or Teleport to house (chipped) to the POH portal just south of Rellekka.
• Enchanted lyre teleport to the town's south entrance.

Rellekka.summary: Rellekka acts as a hub for travelling to the various islands of the Lunar Sea, with boats sailing to and from Miscellania, Jatizso, Neitiznot, Lunar Isle via Pirates' Cove, Waterbirth Island and V's Island. It is also located near the Brine Rat Cavern and Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, and hosts a Rellekka Hunter area to the north-east of the town.

Rellekka Hunter area.title: Rellekka Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleporting to the Fremennik Province lodestone places players south of the Hunter area and east of Rellekka.
• The Arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 summoning, can teleport the player to the area.
• Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring DKS (called the Kandarin Snowy Hunter Area in the rings' network directory). The Rellekka Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest is required to use the rings.
• The enchanted lyre, House Teleport (if the destination is set to Rellekka), and Rellekka tablet teleport players south of Rellekka. The Rellekka Hunter area is north-east of the city. The lyre requires completion of The Fremennik Trials quest, while the tablet requires completion of Love Story.
• Players can take the Keldagrim minecart system to Keldagrim, use the Dwarven Boatman to sail to Keldagrim's entrance, and then exit to the surface. The Rellekka Hunter area is north of the entrance. Partial completion of the quest The Giant Dwarf is required.
• Players can use the eagle transport system to fly to the Rellekka Hunter area. Completion of the Eagles' Peak quest as well as level 35 Agility is required.…

Rellekka Hunter area.summary: The Rellekka Hunter area is mainly covered in snow and ice. In fact, the entire upper half is little more than a large iceberg. The southern half is made of solid land and can even support a few dying trees, but is mainly covered in snow.

Rellekka Hunter area dungeon.title: Rellekka Hunter area dungeon

getting_there.heading: Travel
getting_there.text:
The entrance to the dungeon is not marked on either the mini-map or the world map.

There are several fast ways to get to the dungeon:
• Flying by polar eagle is the fastest way to reach the dungeon, as the entrance to their lair is directly east of its entrance.
• The arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 Summoning, can teleport the player to the Trollweiss Hunter area.
• teleport to Fremennik Province lodestone and head north.
• Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring code DKS (called the Kandarin: Snowy Hunter area in the rings' network directory). The Trollweiss Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the rings.

Rellekka Hunter area dungeon.summary: The main chamber is full of aggressive gnoeals that attack with magic and yetis that attack with melee. In this dungeon players can easily be attacked by both combat styles at once. The yetis and gnoeals also attack one another and a pair of fighting monsters will ignore the player if the player leaves them alone. If the player attacks one of a fighting pair, the attacked monster will often (not always) switch opponents and target the player. (This has been confirmed for the yetis but not for…

Relomia.summary:
The emissary of Sliske.

• Here to celebrate Sliske's grand game.

Reuben.title: Reuben
Reuben.summary: Reuben's grandfather told him that the ruined watchtower was once repurposed as a place of worship for followers of the Saradomin. According to his grandfather's account, followers of a rival god later burned the tower and destroyed its shrines, except for an altar where followers of all gods could worship equally. Reuben identifies the surviving altar as the Shrine of Inanna.

Riki the sculptor's model.title: Riki the sculptor's model
Riki the sculptor's model.summary: After the statue of King Alvis was destroyed in a boat crash during The Giant Dwarf, Blasidar volunteers to help rebuild the statue with the help of an adventurer. After the necessary items are gathered to resemble the statue, Riki dresses himself, and from there the statue is rebuilt.

Rimmington.title: Rimmington

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Free to play:
• Walk west from the Port Sarim lodestone or south from Falador.
• Use the explorer's ring 3 or 4 to teleport to the cabbage patch and walk south-west to get to Rimmington, but this takes longer.
• Use Remora's necklace from the Song from the Depths quest to teleport to the entrance of the Grotworm Lair.

Members:
• House Teleport and exit at Rimmington.
• If the Love Story quest has been completed, members can use a Rimmington tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Rimmington house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
• Teleport to the Crafting Guild with a skills necklace and then walk south-east.
• Use one of the free teleports of the Nature's sentinel outfit to teleport to the Elder trees up north.
• Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south.

Rimmington.summary: The town underwent a significant graphical and structural overhaul on 13 July 2026 alongside the wider Player-owned house rework, refreshing the appearance of the portal area and surrounding buildings. It also received a previous graphical update on 22 May 2012, along with the introduction of Song from the Depths and the Queen Black Dragon.

Rimmington mine.title: Rimmington mine

getting_there.heading: Travel
getting_there.text:
• Rimmington player-owned house portal, then directly east
• Remora's necklace teleport, then west (only on a free-to-play world)
• Port Sarim lodestone, then west
• Captain's Log teleport to player-owned port, then west
• Skills necklace to the Crafting Guild, then south-east

Rimmington mine.summary: A spade respawns in the centre of the mine.

Ripper Demon cave.title: Ripper Demon cave

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Object map | objectname=Dark Tunnel | objectid:100255,x:3353,y:3148 | caption=Entrance to the cave 
• Teleport to desert strykewyrms with a Mask of the Yellow Wyrm/Helm of the Parched Wyrm, then run west to the shortcut.
• From Al Kharid lodestone, head out of the east exit of the city, and use the shortcut to get to the entrance.

Ripper Demon cave.summary: Zarosian cultist Jebediah Omnis deceived a mining company into opening up the caves under the guise of a simple paid job. Jebediah suspected that the caves were the final resting place of the Ripper Demon that was killed by St. Elspeth, and sent the miners to both unearth the caves and trap them within so that they could serve as hosts for the freshly resurrected Chthonian parasites.

Rising Sun Inn.title: Rising Sun
Rising Sun Inn.summary:
The Rising Sun - Ozan's Tale

The Rising Sun can be found on the west end of Falador across from the bank. It is run by three barmaids, Kaylee, Emily, and Tina. Kaylee and Tina have the…

River Elid.title: River Elid
River Elid.summary: Despite being amongst Gielinor's longest rivers, the River Elid shows no signs of being used for transport or trade, though Portmaster Kags can take the player from various locations in Menaphos up the river. No ships can be found on it, and the bridges that span it are built so low that few boats would be able to pass under them. This is most likely due to the small population of the desert. Upstream from the Menaphite capitals (Menaphos and Sophanem), the only settlement on the riverbanks…

River Lum.title: River Lum

getting_there.heading: Travelling the river
getting_there.text: Travelling up the river rather than across is possible by using canoes. It is also possible to travel to level 46 Wilderness, though the river is not visible there.

River Lum.summary: When a jetty providing boat transportation to Daemonheim was added south of the hidey-hole, it also provided a bridge to the west gate of Al Kharid. This update eliminated the need for the grapple shortcut but it is still found in game; using it unlocks the achievement A Bridge Not Far.

River Salve.title: River Salve

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
• The only crossing of the River Salve is the temple of Paterdomus.
• A broken statue shortcut is available at 65 Agility and allows players to get to the bridge without going through the whole temple.

River Salve.summary: The River Salve is a river about the length of the River Lum. It is generally the same width all the way down into the south-eastern seas. In the centre there is a large lake with a small island in the south part of it. There is a Fairy ring on the island, accessible with code BIP. The River Salve is a barrier between Misthalin and Morytania, nearly entirely surrounding Morytania by water. According to legend, the river will not allow any evil of Morytania to cross the banks.

Rodney.title: Rodney
Rodney.summary: Lord Rodney is described as a flamboyant socialite whose previous spouses all appear to have met a suspiciously gruesome end. He was an ex-lover of Ellamaria.

Rogues' Castle.title: Rogues' Castle

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use a Wilderness obelisk or a portable obelisk to teleport to level 50 Wilderness, just south-east of the castle.
• Break a Dragonkin Laboratory teleport, enter the Wilderness through the exit to the south, and then run north.
• Cast Annakarl Teleport, run east to pass the wall, then north.
• Use the Slayer cape to teleport to Mandrith. Run east to the castle.
• Pull the lever in Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north, slash the web, then run south-east past the Chaos Elemental to the castle.

Rogues' Castle.summary: Players should be wary when approaching the castle as while the occupiers are non-hostile, the Chaos Elemental, a fairly strong mid-level boss, wanders around to the west, though it may occasionally path outside the castle entrance.

Romeo.title: Romeo
Romeo.summary: During the bank heist portion of the Gower Quest, Romeo is one of five people recruited to aid the player with the job. He is used to swoon Claire Hick, thus distracting her while the player sneaks past. However, he requires five pieces of dating advice, as he's been secluded in Behind the Scenes so long that he is out of practice.

Rommik.title: Rommik
Rommik.summary: Rommik is also the solution to an anagram clue. He will issue the player a challenge scroll asking "How many rocks in the Rimmington mine cannot be used to make bronze?"; the answer is 7.

Rommik's Crafty Supplies.title: Rommik's Crafty Supplies
Rommik's Crafty Supplies.summary: During the 2008 Halloween event players could right click him and select Trick or Treat to try and scare him to get sweets off him.

Rosie (supplies).title: Rosie (supplies)
Rosie (supplies).summary: Rosie also plays a role in the miniquests Head of the Family and Jed Hunter in the Tales of the Arc quest series. During Head of the Family, she is contacted to help gather information regarding whether it is possible to move the Aminishi moai over to Waiko without it dying. During Jed Hunter, she supplies the player with buoyancy materials after they give her the required supplies.

Roving Elves.title: Roving Elves
Roving Elves.summary: Roving Elves is a sequel to the Waterfall Quest and Regicide. It revolves around consecrating the tomb of King Baxtorian on behalf of his and Glarial's grandson Islwyn.

Ruins (The Lost Grove).title: Ruins (The Lost Grove)
Ruins (The Lost Grove).summary: Using the 'Reminisce' option will prompt the dialogue and also unlock the Memories From The Grove music track.

Ruins (east).title: Ruins (east)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The quest version of the ruins in Spirit Realm, Summer's farm, should be accessed from the Spirit of Summer quest start point, just northeast of Varrock. 
• Games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast. Exit the cave and run south. (Requires completion of Summer's End)
• Wilderness Crater lodestone teleport, then run north-east to the ruins.
• Take a canoe into the Wilderness. Run southeast to the ruins.
• Carrallangar Teleport to Graveyard of Shadows, exit east or west, then run north.
• The ancient obelisk along with the obelisk shard and portable obelisk, exit east or west, then run north.

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
The Ruins are in close proximity to the Corporeal Beast's lair, which makes reaching it fairly simple. By using a Games necklace to teleport to it, then walking to the Ruins, it is possible to reach the area very quickly.

Not far to the south, below the Graveyard of Shadows, is a Wilderness obelisk, which allows players to travel to other obelisks found at different locations within the Wilderness. Before completing the hard Wilderness achievements this method of travel is unreliable because players are unable to choose their destination, but afterwards players can right-click the obelisk and choose which one they would like to teleport to. The Graveyard of Shadows obelisk is in Level 18 Wilderness.

Alternatively, players may reach the Ruins by running north from Varrock or north-east from Edgeville.

Ruins (east).summary: In the Spirit of Summer and Summer's End quests, players learn about the Bonde family who built the farm and about the Bonde Farm massacre in which they were killed. The fabric of reality surrounding the farm is naturally weak, and has been further weakened by the Spirit Beast, an entity from a parallel dimension. This has made the farm something of a spacial anomaly, causing constant physical and spiritual overlaps between The Void, the Spirit Realm, and the world of Gielinor itself.

Ruins (west).title: Ruins (west)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Wilderness Obelisk to level 27, run south west
• Wilderness Crater lodestone teleport, then run west past the Dark Warriors' Fortress to the ruins.
• Dareeyak Teleport on the Ancient Magicks spellbook.
• Take a Canoe into the Wilderness. Run southwest to the ruins.
• Trollheim Teleport, then run down the east side of the mountain, using Agility shortcuts as needed, and enter the Wilderness from its western border.

Ruins (west).summary: The building in the north-east also contains a small fishing net, seed dibber, and fishing bait. In the centre to the south-west of the magic tree, there is a flower patch.

Sanctum of Rebirth.title: Sanctum of Rebirth

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Accessing the Sanctum of Rebirth requires the completion of Soul Searching.
• Take the gondola that's located next to where the Suspicious Stranger was sitting, on the City of Um northern docks. Map | mapID=742 | x=1083 | y=1820 | text=Show on map | mtype=pin | type=maplink 
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use the combat portal in the Max Guild (requires level 99 in every skill).

Sanctum of Rebirth.summary: The Sanctum of Rebirth, also known as Jalamenti, is a former temple devoted to Amascut.

Sanfew.title: Sanfew
Sanfew.quest: Druidic Ritual, Eadgar's Ruse, One Small Favour
Sanfew.summary: Thaerisk Cemphier will explain that Sanfew is a supporter of Crux Eqal.

Santa Claus.title: Santa Claus
Santa Claus.summary: Santa is seen not wearing a Santa hat, but a hood (except in 2004, when he wore a hat).

Saradomin.summary:
