Saradomin's Encampment.title: Saradomin's Encampment
Saradomin's Encampment.teleport:
• Boss portal attuned to Commander Zilyana
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Saradomin's Encampment is located in the south-eastern section of the dungeon, which can be accessed by the Agility shortcut leading to the encampment.

Travel methods include:
• Any travelling methods getting to the dungeon
• Boss portal at War's retreat - Requires killing Commander Zilyana at least once
• Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires Max cape and killing Commander Zilyana at least once

Saradomin's Encampment.summary: Saradomin's Encampment is the encampment of Saradomin in the south-east of God Wars Dungeon. It requires 70 Agility to enter.

Sarim's Revenge.title: Sarim's Revenge
Sarim's Revenge.summary: The Sarim's Revenge is a ship built by adventurers during the Port Sarim Invasion and is the main form of transport for players between the mainland and Wushanko Isles, as well as between the islands in the latter. At Trader Stan's suggestion, the player recruits a crew, and embarks on an odyssey to recover his stolen ships and treasure, as well as Evie Higgs' kidnapped brother Jacob Higgs, from the slaver Jed.

Scabaras Dungeon.title: Scabaras Dungeon
Scabaras Dungeon.summary: The dungeon plays a major role in Dealing with Scabaras. Aggressive Scabarites can be found here which attack with melee, ranged, and magic. They are found close together and in high numbers, making this a good place to kill them for Slayer assignments and City Quests, though the Sophanem Dungeon and the coastal region next to the Ullek swamp may be safer alternatives for lower level players.

Scabarite Cavern.title: Scabarite Cavern

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly to Pollnivneach
• Using the Magic carpet network to "North Pollnivneach"
• House Teleport, if players can use the house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal
• Wear the master constructor's outfit and use it to teleport to the house portal (regardless of which house portal their house is located at)
• Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed
• Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape, teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona
• The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well
• The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well
• Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.

Scabarite Cavern.summary: The cave was formerly used by smugglers to transport goods until nearby Profane Scabarites overwhelmed and killed them, who now occupy the cave, with a scruffy note explaining the setup. These require level 87 Slayer in order to be harmed.

Scorpion Pit.title: Scorpion Pit
Scorpion Pit.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Wilderness Reborn & New Quest - This Week In RuneScape | date=1 August 2022 
• Graphically updated with the rest of the Wilderness.

Seers' Village.title: Seers' Village

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are multiple ways to get to Seers' Village:
• Walk west from Catherby.
• The Seers' Village lodestone, which must be activated before it can be used.
• Camelot Teleport, a spell requiring 1 law rune and 5 air runes.
• Camelot teleport, a teleport tablet made on a lectern in a player-owned house.
• Fairy rings:
• ALS, which teleports players to McGrubor's Wood.
• CJR, which teleports players west of the Sinclair Mansion.

Seers' Village.summary: An Achievement Diary for the village was released on 20 January 2009.

Senliten.title: Senliten
Senliten.quest: Crocodile Tears, The Curse of Arrav, Do No Evil, Missing My Mummy, Our Man in the North, Beneath Scabaras' Sands
Senliten.summary: Her true name is revealed during the quest through an inscription on a fake door in the Uzer Mastaba. The inscription reads The follower of the Sun, the servitor of Icthlarin, follower of the great ones, smiter of horrors. Senliten. Her full title is also given in the Mummy's name papyrus.

Senliten's tomb.title: Senliten
Senliten's tomb.quest: Crocodile Tears, The Curse of Arrav, Do No Evil, Missing My Mummy, Our Man in the North, Beneath Scabaras' Sands
Senliten's tomb.summary: Her true name is revealed during the quest through an inscription on a fake door in the Uzer Mastaba. The inscription reads The follower of the Sun, the servitor of Icthlarin, follower of the great ones, smiter of horrors. Senliten. Her full title is also given in the Mummy's name papyrus.

Senntisten.title: Senntisten
Senntisten.teleport:
• Boss portal
• Dig sites map
• Master archaeologist's outfit
• Pontifex shadow ring

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 scm | Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Kerapac, the bound, Arch-Glacor or Croesus or the boss portal in the Max Guild (not requiring the kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to one of the fronts of the dungeon.
• Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
• Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
• Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
•…

Senntisten.summary: Senntisten continued to function as a capital beyond the Second Age, and managed to survive into the late part of the God Wars, with rivalling gods battling over the territories surrounding it. The city's hopes were crushed however, as Zamorakian and Saradominist armies allied in a final attempt to conquer the jewel of the Zarosian empire.

Senntisten Asylum.title: Senntisten Asylum

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.

Options to reach the asylum include:
• Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
• Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
• Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
• Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
• Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
• Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
• Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
• Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
• Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
• Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor…

Senntisten Asylum.summary: Between the abyssal savages and abyssal lords is an asylum gate. The gate requires a gate key to unlock that can be obtained as a drop from abyssal lords. Once the gate is unlocked, players can bring a rope to hang from the broken railing to unlock a permanent shortcut to the lords. It is not required to open the door to access the lords as players can simply run around the asylum to reach the area, although it is longer, and players must run through aggressive abyssal beasts.

Senntisten Temple.title: Senntisten Temple

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
There are five ways of getting to the Temple:
# Use a Dig Site pendant
# Use a gnome glider from the Grand Tree to destination Lemanto Andra
# Use the Senntisten Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook
# Walk from Varrock or Al Kharid to the Varrock Dig Site
#Use the Archaeology Journal and run north

The two parts of the dungeon are in different locations with respect to one another that you would expect from their surface entrances. The northeast winch leads to the chamber that is south-west of the west winch's entrance point. Use the winch at the western part of the Varrock Dig Site to enter the Temple.

getting_there.heading: Dungeon from the west winch entrance
getting_there.text:
This is a single chamber, containing Doug Deeping, two arcenia root spawns, and several iron pickaxe and bucket spawns.

The sacks in the north part of the chamber are the object of a Treasure Trails clue.

getting_there.heading: Dungeon from the east winch entrance
getting_there.text:
A Rope must first be used on this winch before you can use it.

Upon entry, the player is in a small chamber with the rope to the surface and two arcenia root spawns. The chamber to the north-east has a barrel with nitroglycerine in it, a chest which contains ammonium nitrate and a spawn for the book on chemicals.

The southern end of the dungeon differs depending upon the player's quest progress. During The Dig Site quest, the large chamber to the south is blocked by bricks and piles of rocks. The player demolishes this barrier during the quest, using explosive chemicals the player makes. The south part of the dungeon has only a single chamber, which contains the stone tablet. It also contains level 22 skeletons, many bones spawns, and five silver rocks. After completing The Temple at Senntisten quest, the southern end of the dungeon has two chambers. The south chamber no longer has skeletons but, along with holding the Altar of Zaros, there are four tool tables containing bronze pickaxes, hammers, saws, and chisels, which the player may take. The chamber still contains many bones but only one silver rock. The south-west chamber contains level 22 skeletons.

Senntisten Temple.summary: The Temple was once part of Senntisten, the capital of the Zarosian Empire. After Zamorak banished Zaros, the Temple, along with rest of the capital, was overrun by Zamorak forces. The remains of the city were only recently uncovered.

Seren.title: Seren
Seren.summary: Seren, along with Zaros, was created by the Elder God Mah. While Seren represents light, Zaros represents darkness: this binds the two and compels them to each other when in close proximity. Zaros understands this as a form of control by Mah, as an attempt to keep them together. Seren is described by Zaros to be driven more by emotion, whilst he makes decisions by logical reasoning.

Seren's garden.title: Seren's garden

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Archaeology journal teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then head south-west
• Varrock lodestone, then head east

Seren's garden.summary:
• UL | type=patch | update=This Week In RuneScape: Rex Matriarchs & Combat Week! | date=19 April 2021 
• The druids have now cleaned up the area around the Tree of Balance.

Servants' Guild.title: Servants' Guild
Servants' Guild.teleport:
• Manor farm teleport
• Ardougne lodestone
• Ardougne Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The best way to get to the guild is to cast Ardougne teleport. From the marketplace, walk north between the first two buildings. Behind them is the building with the guild.
• Players can also use a Home Teleport to Ardougne lodestone after it has been activated.

Servants' Guild.summary: The Servants' Guild is a building located in the north of East Ardougne. At the Servants' Guild, players could historically hire servants for their player-owned house. At the head of the guild is the chief servant, who provided basic information about how to hire a servant and the various services that they could provide for a player. When players speak to the chief servant, he will tell them that the building is the Ardougne Domestic Service Agency.

Seth Groats.title: Seth Groats
Seth Groats.summary: Seth plays a role in the One Small Favour quest. In order for him to give the player a month's supply of chickens for the H.A.M. leader Johanhus Ulsbrecht, he will ask for three steel bars to be brought to Horvik in Varrock in exchange for five chicken cages.

Shade Catacombs.title: Shade Catacombs
Shade Catacombs.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Mortton Shades and Mage Armour | date=18 October 2004 
• Added to game.

Shadow Dungeon.title: Shadow Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: • Down a ladder east of Baxtorian Falls - ring of visibility must be equipped to see the ladder. The ladder can be found within the fenced area north of the moss giants and south of Glarial's Tomb. These are located slightly west of the Fishing Guild.

Shadow Dungeon.summary: The dungeon can be difficult to navigate, as it has a maze-like structure. Once Damis is killed during Desert Treasure, he will not reappear in the dungeon.

Shady grove.title: Shady grove
Shady grove.summary: The cave, name and monsters were updated along with Zanaris on 13 May 2010.

Shantay Pass.title: Shantay Pass

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• A charged amulet of glory teleport option to Al Kharid teleports the player directly to Shantay Pass.
• A broomstick, obtained during Swept Away, enchanted by the Sorceress' Apprentice, allows members to directly teleport to the Sorceress's Garden (from with you can drink from the fountain and exit near the Shantay Pass) an infinite number of times.
• The Home Teleport spell to Al Kharid lodestone is also free with no requirements, and is the only free-to-play option.

getting_there.heading: Transport to Port Sarim
getting_there.text:
Players can be arrested and placed in a cell at Port Sarim jail. This can be a useful way of effectively teleporting for free, but the delay caused by failed attempts at escaping makes this less attractive than it used to be. To be arrested by the guards, players can do the following:
• Talk to Shantay and say: "What is this place?" - if this is not the first time being arrested, or the player had already been arrested but had not talked to Shantay before, complete the dialogue and then repeat this.
• Say: "I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!"
• You will be put in his tiny jail
• Then, say "Deport me to Port Sarim!"

The player will then be sent to Port Sarim jail. To escape, players can pick the lock on the door. When done successfully, the player will exit the cell.

This will give the player Thieving experience, but only on a members server. Also, no equipment is required and can be done by free players.
Clear

Shantay Pass.summary: Members can pass the gate straight through by walking from north to the south, or vice versa.

Shield of Arrav.title: Shield of Arrav
Shield of Arrav.summary: Shield of Arrav is a quest to recover the ancient shield of the famous Arrav of Avarrocka, after it has been stolen by organised crime empires in Varrock.

Shifting Tombs.title: Shifting Tombs
Shifting Tombs.summary: Shifting Tombs is a skilling minigame that is accessed in Menaphos after the completion of The Jack of Spades. Level 50+ in Dungeoneering, Agility, Thieving, and Construction is required. The minigame may be played solo, or in a group of up to 5 players. Ironmen players may also participate, and may play with other ironmen as well as non-ironmen.

Shilo Village.title: Shilo Village
Shilo Village.summary: Shilo Village is a quest in which the player lays to rest a vengeful spirit that is attacking Shilo Village. It is required in order to access Shilo Village and its cart system. To begin this quest, you need to have completed Jungle Potion.

Shilo Village (location).title: Shilo Village (location)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Shilo Village has two entrances: the gate to the east by using the right-click "Enter-village" option with Mosol Rei, and a tunnel shortcut under the northern wall (requiring completion of the Elite Karamja achievements and level 74 Agility, which is boostable).

Two items, the Slayer cape (by teleporting to Duradel/Lapalok) and the Karamja gloves 3, teleport directly to inside the village.

Karamja lodestone

This method involves the most walking, but it requires no items nor quests completed to reach the gate. Head a short distance south-east from the Karamja lodestone until you reach the musician, then head a long way south, passing west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Keep going parallel to Karamja's west coast until you reach a small bay, then go south-southeast, around Cairn Isle, and then south past the bridge. Go a short distance southeast until you see another musician, then go east along Shilo Village's south wall until you reach the eastern gate.

Shilo Village cart system

Players who have completed the Shilo Village quest may use the Shilo Village cart system, which is run by Hajedy in Brimhaven. For a price of 10 coins, he will take the player to Vigroy in Shilo Village. The…

Shilo Village (location).summary:
Two items, the Slayer cape (by teleporting to Duradel/Lapalok) and the Karamja gloves 3, teleport directly to inside the village.

Karamja lodestone

This method involves the most walking, but it requires no items nor quests completed to reach the gate. Head a short distance south-east from the Karamja lodestone until you reach the musician, then head a long way south, passing west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Keep going parallel to Karamja's west coast until you reach a small bay, then go…

Shilo Village bank.title: Shilo Village bank
Shilo Village bank.location: In the south-east of Shilo Village
Shilo Village bank.summary: It is the only bank on Karamja, though there are also other bankers in TzHaar City. It is very close to Obli's General Store which supplies vials of water and vial of water packs.

Shipyard.title: Shipyard

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• There is a charter ship available in the eastern part of the Yard, after completion of The Grand Tree and partial completion of Monkey Madness(after talking with G.L.O. Caranock in the quest). It is owned and operated by Trader Stan and his helpers as usual.
• The nearest fairy ring is DKP, to the north-west of the Shipyard.
• A Gnome glider lands to the south of the Shipyard for your transportation needs. The crashed glider to the west used in the Grand Tree quest is not part of the network.
• The password is 'Ka' 'Lu' 'Min' when the shipyard worker is asking you.

Shipyard.summary: In the yard, playes will find many level 28 Shipyard workers and many ships under construction. There are also some hammers lying around.

Shiratti the Custodian.title: Shiratti the Custodian
Shiratti the Custodian.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Nardah, Tool Sheds & Spirits of the Elid | date=5 December 2005 
• Added to game.

Shrine of Inanna.title: Shrine of Inanna
Shrine of Inanna.teleport:
• Fang of Mohegan
• Fairy ring BKS

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Fang of Mohegan's Havenhythe teleport [Chat: 5 More options... › 5 More options... › 2 Havenhythe]
• Fairy ring code BKS and go west
• Right-click Wendlewick Teleport to use the Marigold Farm option, then run south
• Wendlewick lodestone and go south-east
• Wendlewick Teleport or tablet
• Use stonevein amulet to teleport to Millipede mural [Chat: 8 Millipede] and go north east.

Shrine of Inanna.summary: The Shrine is dedicated to Inanna, a Guardian of Guthix who watches over Havenhythe. The Shrine contains a stone Inanna statue, an Altar of Inanna that can be used to restore Prayer points and train Prayer, as well as three obelisks that make up the Shrine of the Spirit Wolves, one of which is empowered, for training Summoning. Several magic trees grow in the area. A birdhouse plot and a water source are also nearby. The player speaks to Shrine Tender Joanna at this location as part of the…

Shuruk-Ba.title: Shuruk-Ba

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Bogolin telepearl teleport to Linbog Village, head north.
• Home teleport to Wendlewick, take a canoe to Linbog Village Key press | 6 , head north.
• Home teleport to Wendlewick, take a canoe to Heathervein Key press | 5 , cross the agility obstacles to Divine Fall, run south-east.
• Stonevein amulet and either press
• Key press | Bat located in east Shuruk-Ba, south of the Crimson Throne Room.
• Key press | Unicorn and walk north east.
• Fairy ring code DIQ and head north (must first be repaired with 5 Bogwart mushrooms).
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash), and either:
• #* Head north-east through Berylbrook to the Exalted Quarry, traverse the River crossing (63 Agility) and Slippery stone (73 Agility) next to the Heathervein canoe station, head south-east.
• #* Head south-east through Berylbrook and Moonsylvar Wood, then head east and run north of Fenmoor.

Shuruk-Ba.summary: Shuruk-Ba is a location on the island Havenhythe, whose ruins contain the entrance to The Ghrazi Blood Knights boss fight.

Signpost (Canifis).title: Signpost (Canifis)
Signpost (Canifis).summary: During the quest, the signpost reads:

Silvarea.title: Silvarea
Silvarea.summary: Silvarea is a winding mountain pass northeast of Varrock, the capital city of Misthalin, that serves as the main passage between Misthalin and Morytania. Silvarea has become somewhat synonymous with Paterdomus, the Saradominist temple that dominates its eastern side.

Silvarea quarry.title: Silvarea quarry

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Skeletal horror Teleport
• Fort Forinthry Teleport, then run east
• Varrock teleport, then run to the site
• Fairy ring (code CKS) near the entrance to Mort Myre Swamp, then go through the underground or take the level 65 Agility shortcut.
• Senntisten Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site with Ancient Magicks, then north, then east
• Dig Site pendant, then north, then east
• Bonesack (e) or ram skull helm (e), to Odd Old Man, then walk south (can only be done once a week, after completing the Fur 'n Seek wish list).
• Invitation box

Silvarea quarry.summary: Limestone rock can be used with a chisel to produce a limestone brick directly from the inventory, however it has a chance to fail below level 40 Crafting.

Sinclair Mansion.title: Sinclair Mansion

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• There are two nearby fairy rings: CJR is closest to the mansion, while DJR is at the west end (requires partial completion of Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The forest near the first ring has some wolves in it.
• Camelot teleport (using the tablet or the spell which requires 45 Magic) and run north.
• Seers' Village lodestone and run northeast.

Sinclair Mansion.summary: Sinclair Mansion has cabbage, wheat, and raw potato respawns, along with a range, dairy churn, dairy cow, chickens, cows, water sources, and a barrel with unlimited amounts of free flour (use an empty pot on the barrel in the kitchen). This makes the location near ideal for up and coming cooks.

Sir Amik Varze.title: Sir Amik Varze
Sir Amik Varze.summary:
Players may start the following quests by speaking to Sir Amik Varze:
• Recruitment Drive
• Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze.
• Wanted!

Sir Ceril Carnillean.title: Ceril Carnillean
Sir Ceril Carnillean.summary: If the adventurer helps Ceril, they will find that Butler Jones is part of the cult and tells him about it. They are unable to find any proof at first, so Ceril dismisses them as a scoundrel and demands they leave his mansion. The adventurer eventually discovers poison and an amulet of Hazeel, showing it to a shocked Ceril, who has Jones arrested for burglary and attempted murder. He then apologises to them for his actions and compensates them in gratitude.

Sir Tiffy.title: Sir Tiffy Cashien
Sir Tiffy.summary:
Head of recruitment for the Temple Knights.
• Keep calm and have a cup of tea.

Sir Vant.title: Sir Vant
Sir Vant.summary: Players who completed Unstable Foundations can find him on the floor 1 of White Knights' Castle.

Sister Catherina.title: Sister Catherina
Sister Catherina.summary: She applied to join the abbey on the same day as Isabella and they were both interviewed by Sister Anna, though Sister Anna's intensity caused Isabella to reconsider. Despite her dedication to the order, Sister Catherina found it hard to give up some of her wants and habits considered undesirable by the order. She was particularly fascinated by a troubadour who had set up camp outside the abbey. She often assisted Sister Debora with maintaining the clock tower.

Skaldrun.title: Skaldrun
Skaldrun.summary: After players unfreeze Skaldrun, they can find him again at the camp. He is west of Marmaros the rewards trader and Thok of Daemonheim, and north of the fire.

Skulgrimen's Battle Gear.title: Skulgrimen's Battle Gear
Skulgrimen's Battle Gear.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=The Fremennik Trials | date=2 November 2004 
• Added to game.

Slayer.title: Slayer
Slayer.summary: Slayer experience is granted in addition to regular combat experience. When fighting against normal monsters, the player to "tag" the target first will receive full slayer and combat experience regardless of how much damage they dealt to it. When fighting against unique monsters or bosses, the tagging effect does not apply and players must deal the most damage to gain slayer experience. Many monsters have unique drops (either to themselves or shared), with some of these unique drops only being…

Slayer Tower.title: Slayer Tower

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are a number of ways to get to the tower.
• The fastest way to get to the Slayer Tower is to use the Mask of the Abyss.
• Other items offering teleports that lead relatively close to the site are ring of slaying, the Mask of Broken Fingers, the Mask of Stench, and the Mask of Mourning.
• Teleport to Canifis lodestone and then run west.
• Fairy rings can be used to access code CKS which leads to a spot just south of the tower.
• Players with the Dungeoneering cape or a hoardstalker ring can directly teleport to the entrance to Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon.

Slayer Tower.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that…

Slug Citadel.title: Slug Citadel
Slug Citadel.summary:
• UL | type=update | update=Salt in the Wound | date=5 July 2011 
• Added to game.

Smoke Dungeon.title: Smoke Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon can be reached from the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon by travelling through the dark stairs. Alternately, the dungeon can be reached by climbing down a smokey well west of Pollnivneach.

The dark stairs are located in the south-east corner of the Smoke Dungeon side and directly west of the entrance from the well in the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon side. The dark stairs turn into a dark hole once you go down them. In order to use the dark hole to leave, it must first be used from the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon side. The player will refuse to use the dark hole from the Smoke Dungeon side first as they do not know where it leads.

On the west side of the Smoke Dungeon is a rope that leads to a smokey well in the desert. Access to the Smoke Dungeon via the well entrance can be unlocked in the quest, Desert Treasure. The well can also be reached by heading directly east from the mystical mirrors, which surround the Bandit Camp lodestone.

Smoke Dungeon.summary: On the west side of the Smoke Dungeon is a rope that leads to a smokey well in the desert. Access to the Smoke Dungeon via the well entrance can be unlocked in the quest, Desert Treasure. The well can also be reached by heading directly east from the mystical mirrors, which surround the Bandit Camp lodestone.

Snake pit.title: Snake pit
Snake pit.summary: The dungeon is visited during the Recipe for Disaster subquest Freeing King Awowogei. Upon entering the dungeon for the first time, 150 damage is suffered. A rope is already provided to descend into the dungeon for subsequent visits. A rope is in place to exit the dungeon. Logging out or lobbying will also put the player outside the dungeon. A few level 9 snakes are found above ground near the entrance to the dungeon; both types of snake are not aggressive to higher levelled players.

Snow imp (follower).title: Snow imp (follower)

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text: LocTableBottom

Snow imp (follower).summary: He first appeared in the 2008 Christmas event, where he aided the player in defeating Jack Frost, and he has since appeared in most subsequent Christmas events, keeping the name he had in previous events. These include the 2008, 2009, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2015, and 2023 Christmas events, as well as the 2011 Easter event and the Violet is Blue Too quest. He may also be mentioned when speaking to Saradomin during The Death of Chivalry.

Sophanem.title: Sophanem

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Access to Sophanem requires partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
• After starting Icthlarin's Little Helper, enter the small cave near the Wanderer's tent, north of the city.
• Pharaoh's sceptre teleport to Jalsavrah Pyramid. Exit the pyramid.
• Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport brings players just south of Sophanem
• Magic carpet network to Sophanem
• Menaphos lodestone teleport, then run east across the bridge to Sophanem (requires completion of The Jack of Spades and Contact!)
• Elder divination outfit teleport to the luminous wisp colony
• Master camouflage outfit Pyramid Plunder teleport
• Leela's favour to Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, after completion of Pharaoh's Folly quest.

Sophanem.summary: Sophanem was founded in the Second Age, shortly before the reign of Pharaoh Queen Senliten. It remained a relatively small village well into the Third Age, at which point the Kharidian Desert Campaign forced refugees from besieged settlements such as Uzer and Ullek to flee further south for survival. This re-location of most of the desert's populace essentially left Sophanem at the Menaphite nation's centre, eventually leading to its incorporation as part of a joint-capital with Menaphos.

Sophanem Dungeon.title: Sophanem Dungeon
Sophanem Dungeon.teleport:
• Pharaoh's sceptre
• Sceptre of the gods
Sophanem Dungeon.summary: This dungeon is a dark area; a light source is required to be able to attack monsters and prevent damage from swarming insects.

Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.title: Sophanem Slayer Dungeon

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
• The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
• Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
• The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
• Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
• Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
• Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
• Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
• There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
• Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
• Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to…

Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.summary: Upon attempting to enter the dungeon, players will receive a warning if they do not have any Feathers of Ma'at on them, or if they do not meet the Slayer level requirements to kill the monsters.

Sorcerer's Tower.title: Sorcerer's Tower

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The best ways to get there are:
• Manor Farm teleport.
• Home teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and run south by south-east.
• Fairy ring code BLR to the Legends' Guild and run north.
• Combat bracelet teleport to the Ranging Guild and run east.
• A sixth-age circuit teleport to Guthix's Cave and run east.
• It can also be accessed by entering the west portal on the floor 3 of the Wizards' Guild which completes the Hard Ardougne achievement, Nice View.
• Teleport to Stormguard Citadel Dig Site (unlimited with Master archaeologist's outfit or dig sites map, or Archaeology teleport bought from Ezreal) and run a short distance east.

Sorcerer's Tower.summary: The Sorcerer's Tower is a tower south of Seers' Village and north-east of East Ardougne. It is the residence of Thormac the sorcerer.

Soul Wars.title: Soul Wars

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
Object map | objectname=Soul Wars portal | objectid=42219 | x=3083 | y=3473 | align=right | caption=The location of the portal to access Soul Wars. 

To get to Soul Wars, one must enter the Soul Wars portal in Edgeville. It is located south-west of the bank, and west of the abandoned mausoleum. After going through the portal, the player will arrive at Nomad's camp, where players can exchange Zeal for rewards, learn how to play Soul Wars, or join one of two teams to play Soul Wars.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Ring of respawn - teleports directly into the Soul Wars waiting area, next to bank. Completion of Nomad's Requiem is required to unlock this respawn location.
• Edgeville lodestone - teleports to Edgeville slightly north west of the Soul Wars portal.
• Slayer cape - teleports to Vannaka east of the Soul Wars portal.
• Wilderness sword - teleports outside of Edgeville bank.
• Amulet of glory - teleports outside of Edgeville bank.
• Paddewwa Teleport - teleports the player into the Edgeville Dungeon, just a few steps away from the exit.

Soul Wars.summary:
• They will need to battle other people and monsters. Higher combat levels would be advantageous, but they are not absolutely necessary.
• Fighting the avatars and monsters is easier with higher Slayer levels; pyrefiends and jellies have Slayer requirements of 30 and 52 respectively, while higher Slayer levels can be used to kill the other team's avatar faster. Soul altar.title: Soul altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A soul talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A soul tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A soul talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Fairy ring CKQ teleports into the west side of the Menaphos Imperial district, near the fountain entrance.
• Menaphos lodestone teleport and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).
• Leela's favour to imperial district and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).

Players with tier 6 reputation in the Imperial district can access the bank chest near the entrance of the Grand Library. The Imperial district teleport tablet places the player close to the chest, allowing players to use the two in conjunction to charge the altar without the use of the Abyss or fairy rings.

Soul altar.summary: Players need a Runecrafting level of at least 90 to craft soul runes. Unlike other altars, the soul altar must be charged before runes can be crafted. Edgeville Dungeon

Edgeville Dungeon is considered a convenient place to slay in relative peace, as there are three spawns, enough to sustain one player. It is recommended to stick to the north side of the room to avoid being harassed by aggressive skeletons and poison spiders. There is also a ladder to the north that goes up to a safe zone with the Obelisk of Air. It is useful for whenever players need a reprieve to heal or use Home Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone for banking.

Dungeoneering cape's teleport to Edgeville Dungeon chaos druids dungeon is fairly close, as well as the shortcut to the Obelisk of Air, which is north of Edgeville and east of Black Knights' Fortress, if the hard Wilderness achievements are completed. getting_there.heading: Getting to charter ships
getting_there.text:
While travelling by charter ship can be convenient for players who can afford it, it can be a bit time consuming to get to the ship in the first place, as there is only one teleport that goes right next to a ship. Some of the quickest ways to get to the ships are:
• Using the 'Chipped' Camelot teleport unlocked after Evil Dave's Big Day Out takes you directly to Catherby docks. (This is currently the fastest method at 2 seconds)
• The Lunar spell Khazard Teleport takes you west of the Port Khazard docks. (18 seconds away)
• The Lunar spell Catherby Teleport takes you just north of the docks. (21 seconds away)
• Use the Port Sarim lodestone, run east and pay fare to Captain Tobias to reach Musa Point. From there, run slightly north to the Charter Ship (30 second trip or 20 seconds if you use a quick teleport).
• Catherby lodestone and Port Sarim lodestone are both close to charter ships. (29 seconds away or 19 seconds if you use a quick teleport).
• Using the Tirannwn quiver 2 to teleport to Tyras Camp and run west to the docks. (24 seconds away)
• Use a Menaphos tablet or (if your house is in Menaphos) House Teleport and run north (25 seconds).
• Use an Amulet of glory to teleport…

desert heat.title: desert heat
desert heat.summary: Desert heat is a damaging effect that players may suffer from while in the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. The heat causes players to dehydrate and take damage if they do not drink from a waterskin or rehydrate from an enchanted water tiara. Wearing desert clothing helps to keep players cool and reduces the player's need to drink water as often, while wearing equipment with combat stats causes the player to require a drink more often.

dust devil.summary: Dust devils use Ranged attacks to fight, and a Slayer level of at least 65 is required to kill them. Their Smoke Dungeon habitat also deals rapid damage to unprotected players. To prevent this, it is mandatory to wear protective face gear; a face mask, masked earmuffs, any slayer helm variant, a mask of Dust, or the helm of Devilry. Any of these will block both the environmental and the dust devil's stat-lowering attacks, meaning only Ranged damage will be dealt.

eagle transport system.title: eagle transport system

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
To use the eagle transport system, you need to get to one of the eagles. Methods include:
• Option 3 on a traveller's necklace leaves you at the entrance to the desert eagles' eyrie.
• Use a spirit larupia teleport and run northwest to the jungle eagles' eyrie.
• Fairy ring AKS (Feldip Hills hunter area) and run southwest to the jungle eagles' eyrie.
• Use the Dominion medallion teleport and run northeast from the Dominion Tower to the desert eagles' eyrie.
• The Eagles' Peak lodestone provides quick access to the base of the mountain.

eagle transport system.summary: The eagle transport system is unlocked after completion of the Eagles' Peak quest. Players may use it to travel quickly to different Hunter areas as well as to the jade vine maze and the Eagles' Peak. There are eyries in five locations: Eagles' Peak, Rellekka Hunter area, Uzer Hunter area, Feldip Hunter area, and the jade vine maze in Karamja.

earth altar.title: earth altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• An earth talisman
• An elemental talisman
• An omni-talisman
• An earth tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• An earth talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a earth altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• The Fort Forinthry lodestone teleports to Fort Forinthry, then go south to the altar.
• The Archaeology journal teleports to the Archaeology Guild, then go north to the altar.
• Alternatively, from the Archaeology guild, use the dig sites map (or an Archaeology teleport) to teleport to the Infernal Source Dig Site and go south-east to the altar.
• The landing site of the balloon transport system lands close to the altar. The fastest access to the balloon transport system is using a skills necklace to the Crafting Guild.

earth altar.summary: Players need a Runecrafting level of at least 9 to craft earth runes. Crafting an earth rune grants 6.5 Runecrafting experience. Using protean essence on it grants 35 experience per essence.

earth warrior.title: earth warrior

getting_there.heading: Locations
getting_there.text:
LocTableBottom 

In the Edgeville Dungeon, level 12 Agility is required to cross the stepping stones over an abyss. They reside in the members-only, level 7–10 Wilderness section of the dungeon.

The Chaos Tunnels are not in the Wilderness. Players can get there:
• By crossing low-level Wilderness to reach the rifts entering the tunnels.
• Teleporting to the Chaos Tunnels resource dungeon using a hoardstalker ring or a Dungeoneering cape and then using the nearby western portal.
• Teleporting to dust devils or gargoyles using a Mask of Dust/Helm of Devilry or a Mask of Granite/Helm of Grotesquery, respectively, and following the route to the earth warriors.
• Using the route opened during What Lies Below.

Players planning to fight earth warriors in Edgeville Dungeon and Chaos Tunnels will find that, after a period of time, they no longer are aggressive. However, it is possible to make them aggressive again by leaving their area and coming back (or by using an aggression potion). In the case of the Edgeville Dungeon, this means running south, crossing back over the stepping stones (gives 7.5 Agility experience) and running all the way to the south wall of the deadly red spider…

earth warrior.summary: Earth warriors were once commonly used by players for training, as they have a good amount of life points and do not commonly hit very high on players; nowadays there are better methods of training. Some players attack the warriors in hopes of gaining the very rare Earth Warrior Champion's scroll, for the Champion's Challenge. Otherwise, they are a decent source of various seeds and grimy herbs.

getting_there.heading: Quick access
getting_there.text:
One may quickly access the fairy rings in any of the following ways:

No item required (requires activation of Lodestone Network):
• By teleporting to the Yanille lodestone and then running north
• By teleporting to the Edgeville lodestone and then running east across the bridge and south
• By teleporting to the Fremennik Province lodestone and then running northeast

Unlocks required:
• After building Grove tier 2, teleporting to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and then running east
• After completing the Easy Ardougne achievements, casting the Kandarin monastery Teleport spell at no cost and then running east
• After placing a fairy ring (furniture) in your player-owned house, using the House Teleport (requires no runes with level 50 Construction) and then running to wherever you've placed the fairy ring

Item required:
• By using the skill portal attuned to the Zanaris fairy ring from a grace of the elves (Fastest method without portable fairy ring)
• By teleporting to the Abyssal Area with the Mask of the Abyss, which teleports you one square from the fairy ring
• By using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
• By using a cape of legends to teleport…

fairy ring.summary: The fairy ring transportation system is unlocked after starting the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather. It consists of teleportation rings spread across the world and provides a relatively fast means of accessing often remote sites across Gielinor, as well as providing easy access to other worlds.

To reach the water pool for making holy water:

holy water.summary: Holy water is exceptionally useful when fighting tormented demons, as it lowers their fire shield just as Darklight would. Traditionally, Darklight would be used on the shield instead, but their melee prayer would have to be dealt with first. Because the demons do not initially protect against Ranged, one can simply throw a vial of holy water and immediately proceed to fight as normal. Holy water is also useful in that one can swap between magic and range without entering melee distance or…

ice troll female.summary: Ice troll females are most commonly found near the smaller ice troll runts. Their damage dealt is reduced by equipping a Fremennik round shield made during The Fremennik Isles. However, the shield doesn't affect the accuracy of the attacks. Their accuracy seem to neglect all defence bonuses from stats and equipment; hence, they almost always are able to deal some damage.

ice troll male.title: ice troll male
ice troll male.summary: Ice troll males inhabit the islands north of Jatizso and Neitiznot and can also be found in the Chaos Tunnels. They use melee attacks that hit a maximum of 196 life points. Yak hide armour is especially effective against them, as the armour lowers their maximum hit.

Mining mineral deposits also produces 2.7 reputation in Menaphos, increasing up to 5.4 reputation upon unlocking all of the reputation multipliers.

He was, in life, a loyal follower of Saradomin, and one day discovered an ancient and abandoned temple that appeared to be very old. On investigating inside, he unearthed the legendary god-weapon, the Staff of Armadyl. Rushing away to deliver the sacred artefact to Saradomin, who Valdez assumed would want to use to increase his dominion in Gielinor, Valdez was assailed on his journey back to Entrana by…

nature altar.title: nature altar

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A nature talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A nature tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A nature talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a nature altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the Karamja gloves 3 or 4 to teleport to the gemstone cavern, take the ladder to the surface, exit Shilo Village by the shortcut to the north, and go north-east to the ruins.
• Use fairy ring code CKR and run north-east to the ruins.

nature altar.summary: Players need a Runecrafting level of at least 44 to craft nature runes. Crafting a nature rune grants 9 Runecrafting experience. Using protean essence on it grants 160 experience per essence.

nechryael.summary: A nechryael's main attack is a two handed clawing move that hits up to 276 life points. When engaged in melee combat, a nechryael may randomly summon up to two level 95 death spawns to assist it. These death spawns have a meagre 500 life points but are very accurate and can deliver hits upwards of 300 life points. Death spawns can be ignored by higher level players, and will subsequently disappear if they are left alone, but they may be a nuisance for lower level players.

observatory.title: observatory

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to reach the Observatory is to use the 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport tablet which can be made by using a watchtower teleport tablet on Dave's spellbook after the quest Evil Dave's Big Day Out.
• Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars then run north, crossing two small bridges. Go up the rope on the north-east side of the observatory (requires completion of the Observatory Quest).
• You could also go down the stairs in the Goblin hut to the north-east and then follow the maze to the staircase to enter the observatory.
• Use the Ourania Teleport to arrive just north of the Observatory. 
• Using the Home Teleport to teleport to Yanille lodestone is free with no requirements but it is a fairly long walk to the north-west.

observatory.summary: Though the design of the telescope is from Scorpius, the original has gone, and the current structure is a reproduction.

range.summary: All ranges have lower burn rate than fires, and the Cook-o-matic 25 range in Lumbridge Castle has an even lower burn rate for low-levelled foods once unlocked after completion of Cook's Assistant. Foods which benefit from the decreased burn rate are listed in the cook-o-matic manual. However, this does not eliminate the player's risk of burning food until the player has reached the necessary Cooking level not to burn that item, as normal.

ranger (Amberfell bridge).title: ranger (Amberfell bridge)
ranger (Amberfell bridge).summary: He serves as the starting point for the Secrets of Amberfell quest, where he delivers an S.O.S. note sent from Amberfell during the night. Additionally, the bridge is repaired during the quest, where he remains stationed. After the quest, he thanks the player for re-establishing contact with Amberfell.

rock cake.title: rock cake
rock cake.summary: A rock cake is required as a bribe in order to access the central parts of Gu'Tanoth, which is necessary during the Watchtower quest. The player must give a rock cake to an ogre guard in order to be allowed to climb over a battlement that blocks the way to a rope bridge.
